about: Every wish from the player panels, merged, checked against the code, and tracked until it is resolved. Edit this file, then run `python dev/wishlist.py` to regenerate docs/wishlist.md.

rounds.what: Five player agents each created a level 1 character on sw5e.com, played a scripted session in the sheet, levelled to 3, played a second session, levelled to 4, synced and played a round on a phone. 373 wishes, merged into the items below; two reviewers checked every item against the code.

players.style: Long-time D&D 5e player, new to SW5E; lives in powers, force points and concentration

praise: Load from SW5E found and loaded my brand-new character in about 5 s, and every number matched the builder (AC 12, HP 7, saves, DCs, force points).

Force Casting card: Light, Dark and Universal DC and attack side by side, plus each power's save DC, Concentration tag, points cost and Cast button. The power picker shows prerequisites ('needs Force Push/Pull').
Cast spends the force points and shows a concentration chip and an Effects entry with End. The 'Cast Guidance. Concentrating.' toast is clear.

Dice dock: advantage with the losing die struck through, recent rolls per character, 'Hit: roll damage' / 'Critical damage' after an attack, a 'Natural 20' badge, and death save → 'Record a failure' in one click.
Medpac Use → 'On me' rolls d6 + Con in the dock, then 'Heal 5' → 'Healed 1 (of 5; at maximum)', and the stack goes down. Very smooth.
Damage / Heal / Temp HP with Undo of the last action. Temp HP is absorbed first and the massive-damage rule is known.
Buying shows the price and weight, 'Pay … cr from credits', any price allowed, and a clear 'Not enough credits: 600 cr needed, 150 cr available.'

Tweaks keep their reasons. Changed numbers are underlined, and the hover tooltip ('Without tweaks or effects 3 → now 4 · +1 Wisdom score · Empathic feat… · Tweak (not synced to SW5E yet)') is exactly what I want.
Personality & Appearance in one edit form, Notes with Markdown, and the XP box accepts '+300'.
Long rest toast ('Long rest: regained uses of Force Recovery.') and Undo: Long rest.

Load from SW5E kept everything from Session 1 across each level-up (when the level wasn't frozen): XP 900 over the site's 300, 6 tweaks with reasons, inventory incl. the datapad, notes, personality; current HP rose with the max (7/7 → 12/12 → 17/17 → 22/22).

Power and Force-Empowered Casting pickers in the class card: counted against the table (9/11 → 15/15), grouped At-will / 1st / 2nd, prerequisites shown, each pick expands to its rule text, and picks travel to sw5e.com with Sync. Much nicer than the builder's reordering dialog.
The class table's 'Now / Next' rows tell me exactly what the next level gives.

Force Shield appeared at level 2 as a 2/2 counter with a Start button; Force Casting shows Light/Dark/Universal DC + attack, the per-power save DC, a level select with point costs, and spends FP on Cast.

Strength Stim 'Use → On me': STR, Vibrostaff attack and damage, and carrying capacity all updated, the hover explains it ('+2 from Strength Stim (Basic) (temporary)'), Effects shows its duration, and the item is removed.
Focus Generator (Fine) with Attuned ticked on add: force attack +6 → +7 everywhere, attunement 1/2, 'while attuned' in Effects, with zero typing.
Long rest toast 'regained 16 HP, 10 force points, one level of exhaustion gone.' with Undo; temp HP absorbed first; 'Undo: Took 18 damage'.
Sync to SW5E worked every time and the site's copy matched (level, HP, FP, 15 powers, War Caster, 450 cr, attunement 1/2). The 'Not synced to SW5E: Class choices, …' banner lists what's pending.
Phone frame: strip with ♥ HP and AC, the 🔍 filter jumps straight to the Vibrostaff, the dock slides up, attack → damage in two taps; damage/heal in the tracker didn't make the page jump.

Custom items from sw5e.com's builder show up in the inventory with a 'custom' tag.
The fighting style picker has the full list, shows the style's text after picking, and catches over-picks ('⚠ 2 chosen, 1 allowed').

Buying is clear: 'Not enough credits: 600 cr needed, 100 cr available.' Pay accepts any price, Qty resets after each add, stacks merge (power cells 3 + 10 = 13), × asks 'Remove?', and type → Enter → Enter adds an item quickly.

The Personality form is one place for everything, Notes render Markdown, and the XP box accepts '+300'.

Load from SW5E after the first builder level-up (Fighter 2 + Operative 1) kept every local change: XP, credits, all 18 items including the custom coded datapad, 8 tweaks with reasons, notes, personality, fighting style. It brought in the new class, HP, hit dice per die size (1/1 d8 and 2/2 d10 as separate tracker rows), the Action Surge counter, superiority dice and the Sneak Attack die.

Operative's Expertise, missing from SW5E's data, was filled in 'from class text' with a Your choices box. Writing 'Stealth + Perception' there gave correct numbers (Stealth +7, Perception +5, Passive 15) and an Effects line.

Superiority & Maneuvers section: Physical/Mental/General DCs and attack bonuses correct by my math, maneuver texts shown, and an honest note that sw5e.com doesn't compute superiority.
Sneak Attack is a checkbox on the damage roll and can be ticked after rolling: the weapon die keeps its number, only the d6 is added ('amended').
Strength Stim: Use → On me → STR +2 flowed into the unarmed attack, carrying capacity and a sidebar chip; End restored everything.
The long rest message lists exactly what came back: 'regained 27 HP, uses of Second Wind, Action Surge, one level of exhaustion gone.'
Credits '+400' / '−100' apply instantly; Medpac 'On someone else' just consumes it.
Choosing a host weapon for the nightstinger's +1 applied immediately (1d8+4, underlined).

Sync to SW5E carried tweaks (HP +4, Dex +1, skill proficiencies), maneuvers, archetype, strategy, credits, inventory and custom items to sw5e.com. Export all (backup) contains everything, including tweak reasons and version history.
Editing a tweak value (HP bonus 1 → 3 → 4) is instant and HP updates within seconds.
Phone frame: Damage/Heal are one tap each; the 🔍 filter plus the dice bottom sheet made a quick attack easy; it opened on my character.

praise: Dice dock on the phone: tap any skill, save, initiative or attack; Advantage shows both d20s; extra dice can be added after the roll (Target Lock +d6 → 'amended'); custom roll box ('1d4'); recent rolls per character.
Weapon attack → 'Hit: roll damage' / 'Critical damage' with Double dice / Max + roll is fast and clear.
Death save → 'Record a success' → 'Death saves: 1 ✓, 0 ✗.'; healing from 0 clears death saves automatically; the message at 0 HP tells you what to do.
Medpac 'Use' → 'On me / On someone else / Cancel' → rolls d8 + Con → 'Heal 6' → '✓ Healed 4 (of 6; at maximum)' and the count drops: excellent flow.
The '♥ HP' chip in the strip jumps to Combat & Vitals; the state chip ('● Target Lock') jumps to Effects where End is one tap.
Casting a power from the card spends tech points, says 'Concentrating', and lists the power under Effects with its duration and start time.
Short rest restores Engineer tech points (rule correct); Long rest says 'Long rest: done.'; each action has an Undo.
Add an item from SW5E: exact-match detail line (type, cost, weight), Equipped/Pay options, and stacks merge (power cells 2 → 7 → 17).
The '+n / −n' syntax works for both credits and XP.
Tweaks: the add form stays in place under the thumb, each tweak takes a reason, and changed numbers are underlined with a tap-to-explain breakdown.
Notes support Markdown and render lists nicely; Personality edit fields are comfortable on a phone.
No horizontal page scroll at 390 px anywhere except the class table; cards and the dock fit the phone width.
The 'Not synced to SW5E: play state, Inventory, Tweaks, … Class choices' banner says exactly what differs from the site, a big improvement on part A's 'Same as sw5e.com's copy'.

Load from SW5E stayed on my character this time, and my local data survived builder level-ups: XP, credits, 11 items, notes, personality and 7 tweaks (Int 18 > tech points 8, then 10, then 13 all correct).

The Classes card is clear: 'Tech powers 6 / 7' in orange, a red '9 / 7 ⚠ 9 known, the table gives 7', the power list grouped by At-will / 1st / 2nd level, 'HP by level 8 (max), 5, 5', and a Now/Next class table.
Archetype modification picker: 'Armstech Modifications 0 / 4', modified weapon chosen from my inventory, prerequisites shown inline ('Bayonet (needs Blaster)', 'Accuracy Focus (5th level)').
Death save flow at 0 HP: Roll > 'Record a success' > 'Death saves: 1 ✓, 0 ✗.'; healing clears the saves automatically; massive damage handled correctly.
Consumables: Use > On me / On someone else / Cancel. The stim applied 'STR +2' with its duration and the sheet jumped to Effects; carrying capacity followed the stim's Str.
Long rest notice: 'regained 18 HP, 2 tech points, uses of Potent Aptitude, one level of exhaustion gone.'
Effects provenance: 'FROM EQUIPMENT · Armor (Fine) AC +1 while equipped', 'FROM CLASS FEATURES · Bonus Proficiencies…'.
The 🔍 filter on the phone took me straight to the Credits box or the Medpac row; +n/−n works for credits and XP.
State chip > Effects > End is still the quickest way to end concentration or a stim.
Each power now has a level dropdown next to Cast (ready for upcasting); the dice dock still allows adding dice after the roll ('amended').
Nothing overflowed horizontally at 390 px all session.

items.title: Create the character in the extension (guided, works on a phone)
items.story: When I create a new character, I want the extension to walk me through species, class, ability scores, background, skills/tools/languages and equipment, with every choice as a picker and live numbers, and usable at 390 px, so that I don't build it in sw5e.com's builder in a desktop tab and then repair half of it with tweaks.
items.evidence: Builder problems both players hit: the red '!' on the gear only means 'Character has unsaved changes', and you find that out only by opening it. Saving happens silently when you press CHARACTER SHEET. Point Buy is hidden behind the gear. The Add Equipment search needs a second click/tap before typing registers, every time, and the feat dropdown needs a second tap. The equipment dialog shows cost and weight but no AC, armor type, damage, range or properties. 'Explorer's pack' gives 'No data available'. There are no pickers for species choices (Zabrak Coercive, Crafters), the feat's +1, the background's 2 skills/tool/language, the class's 2 skills or the fighting style, and no starting package. Jun (phone-only) also needed a desktop tab. In the builder the power chooser moves checked powers to the top under his finger, an expanded row stays open by position when the level filter changes (Detonator became Overload), and the URL stays 'temp-…?isNew=true' until you go back to My Characters. Afterwards Tomas fixed his Zabrak Fighter with 8 tweaks plus Notes, and Jun his Sullustan Engineer with 7 tweaks. The individual missing steps are tracked separately: W-002 (ability scores), W-003 (equipment), W-024 (skills), W-025 (tools/languages), W-026 (feat increases), W-006 (builder power picker).
items.repro: sw5e.com My Characters > + > +. Build a Zabrak Fighter (Soldier, Weapon Expert) or a Sullustan Engineer (Scientist, Techie), then Load from SW5E and compare the sheet with the rules.
items.expected: One creation flow in the extension that uses SW5E's lists for each choice and shows final scores, HP, AC and attacks live, at phone width too. sw5e.com's rules engine still computes the numbers.
items.workarounds: Built it on sw5e.com, used Load from SW5E, then fixed it with tweaks and Notes.

verified.where: viewer.js (no creation flow); README 'Your data' section
verified.note: No creation flow exists. The viewer only loads finished characters (viewer.js:loadFromSw5e, importFiles), and the README still calls sw5e.com's builder 'the place for rules-heavy changes'. The data a flow would need is already in the cached rules modules (bridge.js:sw5ePageExtract, mode 'rules'): species traits, classes.skillChoicesList/numSkillChoices/equipmentLines/startingWealthVariant/quickBuildText, backgrounds.skillProficiencies/toolProficiencies/languages/equipment/featOptions and the personality tables. The builder problems the players list are sw5e.com's own; they argue for building this. The individual steps are W-002, W-003, W-024, W-025 and W-026.

items.resolution: New character wizard (More ▾ → New character…, or the first page): name and species with its increases, class with skills and tools, ability scores (standard array, point buy, manual/rolled) with species and feat bonuses shown, background with skills, tools, languages, feat and its +1, starting equipment or wealth, personality, and a review of what's open. Kept here; 'Save to sw5e.com' creates it on the account (decisions 35-39).

items.title: Ability score step: show base + species + feat = final score and modifier
items.story: When I assign ability scores, I want to see base + species + feat = final score and modifier live, with where each bonus comes from (and a hint about which abilities my class wants), so that I know I'll end up with Wis 18 / Int 18 / Str 18 before I commit.
items.evidence: The builder's Determine Ability Scores step has only six standard-array dropdowns (15/14/13/12/10/8). None of the bonuses are shown on that step. Mira: Kel Dor +2 Wis/+1 Dex and Empathic +1 Wis. Jun: Sullustan +2 Int/+1 Dex and Techie +1 Int. Priya: Togruta +2 Wis/+1 Str and the feat's +1. Sam: Wookiee +2 Str/+1 Con and Brawny +1 Str. Sam, a first-time player, only learned from the sheet that Str would be 17 (18 with Brawny), and asked for a 'Str then Con' hint for his class. All four checked the final numbers afterwards on the sheet or by mental maths.
items.repro: sw5e.com builder > Ability Scores > Standard Array, with any species chosen.
items.expected: A live final score and modifier for each ability, with every bonus listed by source. Part of the in-extension creation flow (W-001).
items.workarounds: Mental maths, or reading the sheet afterwards. Sam followed the class page's 'Quick build' text.

verified.note: There's no ability-score step. After the fact, renderAbilities shows 'base N · +X from species/ASIs/feats/tweaks', which lumps all sources into one number. Background-feat increases aren't applied at all (W-026). The rules data for a live breakdown is cached: species 'Ability Score Increase' traits, feat texts, and classes.primaryAbility/quickBuildText for the hint. Build it as part of W-001.

items.resolution: The ability score step shows base + species + feat = score and modifier for every method, with the point-buy total.

items.title: Starting equipment: class/background (a)/(b) choices or a starting-wealth roll
items.story: When I finish creation, I want the class and background starting equipment offered as their (a)/(b)/(c) choices, with packs unpacked and background credits added, or a starting-wealth roll instead, so that I don't rebuild my kit item by item and I know what I'm allowed for free.
items.evidence: For all four, the builder's Equipment step starts at 'CREDITS: 0' and offers nothing from the class or background. Mira (Consular): '(a) a simple lightweapon or (b) a simple vibroweapon; (a) a scholar's pack, (b) an explorer's pack, or (c) a diplomat's pack'. Force Adept gives 'common clothes, a sturdy knife, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr', and the variant wealth is 5d4 x 100 cr. Jun (Engineer): each item took +, two taps on search, typing, scrolling (the plain 'Wristpad' comes after 12+ enhanced variants), Equipped and Add. The blaster pistol dialog showed no damage, range or properties, and the Scientist's 100 cr had to be added by hand. Priya (Guardian): (a) mesh armor / (b) combat suit + light shield, lightweapon + shield / two weapons, priest's / explorer's pack, plus the Jedi's gear and 150 cr. That was about 6 actions per item, and packs give 'No data available'. Sam: the Mercenary's 100 cr went in via Adjust Credits. He also added a 950 cr Vibroaxe for free, and nothing tells you whether that is allowed as starting kit or is cheating (Sam-A6).
items.repro: sw5e.com builder > Equipment step, for any new character.
items.expected: (a)/(b) choices for each line of the class and background lists. Packs are added as their contents and background credits are included. Alternatively, roll starting wealth. Starting-kit items are flagged, so free adds are clearly allowed.
items.workarounds: Added items one at a time in the builder and the sheet, typed credits by hand, and followed the class equipment list from memory.

verified.note: There's no starting-kit step. renderBackground only prints the background's equipment sentence. Class equipmentLines ('(a)… or (b)…') and startingWealthVariant are in the rules data but never used. Packs aren't in SW5E's item catalog (W-079), so unpacking needs a hand-made contents table. Items can be added free today (the 'Pay' box is optional), but nothing marks them as starting kit, which is Sam's 'is this cheating?' question.

items.resolution: Each class line's (a)/(b)/(c) choice and the background's list are resolved to SW5E's items (kinds like 'simple blaster' become a list to pick from, 'light or medium physical shield' either); packs and story items become renamable custom items; credits from 'a pouch containing 100 cr'; or starting wealth with its roll (decision 38). Packs aren't unpacked (W-079).

items.title: Validation says 'All checks passed' while creation choices are missing
items.story: When my new character is missing skills, tools, languages and feat/species bonuses, I want Validation to list what's missing, so that I fix it before playing instead of being told everything is fine.
items.evidence: Settings, Tweaks & Data > Record shows 'Validation: All checks passed'. Jun's character at that point had 0 of 3 Engineer skills, 0 of 2 Scientist skills, no tools and no extra languages, and the Techie Int +1 wasn't applied. Sam's was missing Brawny, Menacing, Hide, Claws and the class/background skill choices. In part B, Jun's Validation still said 'All checks passed' while his class level had been silently reverted (W-011). Jun rated it high and Sam low.
items.repro: Load a fresh builder character, then open Settings, Tweaks & Data > Record.
items.expected: Messages such as 'Engineer: choose 3 skills (0 chosen)', 'Scientist: 2 skills, 1 tool, 1 language', 'Techie: Int +1 not applied', 'Mercenary: 2 skills not chosen', 'Brawny: +1 Str not applied'.

verified.note: Confirmed. The Record card shows snap.validation.message, which is SW5E's getCharacterValidation run on the site's copy at load time (bridge.js:sw5ePageExtract). It isn't run on the edited copy, although state.derived[key].validation exists and is never shown. The viewer adds no checks of its own. That explains 'All checks passed' while Jun's local class edit held the old level (W-011). Needed: the sheet's own checks (class/background skill counts, tools, languages, feat increases), plus showing the derived validation.

items.resolution: The creation review lists what's still to choose, and Overview lists every open choice of an existing character (skills, tools, languages, feat +1s, empty ASIs, archetype, options, maneuvers and powers below their counts), each linking to its section.

items.title: Pick or roll the background's suggested characteristics
items.story: When I fill in personality, I want to pick or roll from my background's suggested trait, ideal, bond and flaw tables, so that I don't invent and type everything (on a phone keyboard, too).
items.evidence: Force Adept, Scientist, Jedi and Mercenary all have SUGGESTED CHARACTERISTICS d8/d6 tables, which only appear in sw5e.com's 'View background details' dialog. Personality & Appearance > Edit has only empty text boxes. Jun typed all four fields on the phone keyboard, and Sam copied text from sw5e.com.
items.repro: Personality & Appearance > Edit.
items.expected: A Pick / roll button for each field, fed from the background's tables.
items.workarounds: Typed their own text, or copied it from sw5e.com.

verified.note: The Personality editor has only free textareas. The rules data already holds each background's personalityTraitOptions, idealOptions, bondOptions and flawOptions (with roll numbers; checked in dev/dumps/rules.json, e.g. Scientist), so Pick and Roll buttons are cheap to add.

items.resolution: Pick or roll each personality trait, ideal, bond and flaw from the background's tables, in the wizard and in the Personality editor.

items.title: Builder's power picker moves rows under the cursor and hides casting stats
items.story: When I tick powers while creating a character, I want the list to stay still with chosen powers shown apart, and a header showing my casting ability, attack, DC and force points per alignment, so that each click ticks the power I aimed at and I pick powers that fit my scores.
items.evidence: In sw5e.com's Choose Force Powers dialog, a ticked power jumps to the top and the list re-renders. Mira's 3rd and 4th clicks hit the wrong rows: Force Shunt got ticked instead of Force Push/Pull, and Mind Trick was missed. Jun saw the same reshuffle (W-001). The dialog has only level and alignment filters. DC, attack and force points appear only on the finished sheet: Light DC 13 / +5 and Dark DC 11 / +3 at Wis 17, Cha 12. Light = Wis, dark = Cha, universal = either is never explained.
items.repro: Builder > Class > Consular > Choose Force Powers. Tick Guidance, then Turbulence, then click where Force Push/Pull was.
items.expected: In the extension's creation flow: a picker whose rows don't move, a separate 'chosen' list, and a header such as 'Light: Wis +3 → DC 13, attack +5; Dark: Cha +1 → DC 11; Force points 7'.
items.workarounds: Unticked the wrong power and ticked the right ones by script. Read the casting stats on the sheet afterwards.

verified.note: The reshuffling dialog belongs to sw5e.com's builder. In the extension, the class-card picker (renderPowerBlocks) is a static grouped <select> that doesn't move rows, but adding by keyboard has the W-027 bug. Light/dark/universal DC and attack appear only in the Force Casting section (renderCasting), not beside the picker. This argues for a casting header in the creation and level-up flow (W-001, W-007).

items.title: Level up in the extension (HP, features, choices, multiclassing)
items.story: When my XP reaches a new level, I want a Level up button that walks me through the level in order, so that I never have to rebuild a level in sw5e.com's builder and Load it back (which lost levels for everyone, W-011). The steps: the class to level (a new class with its prerequisite checked); HP rolled or taken as the average, with Con and species bonuses shown; the new features with their text; then that level's choices (powers up to the table count, maneuvers, instincts, fighting style, aura, archetype at 3rd, ASI/feat at 4th).
items.evidence:
There is no level control anywhere: the players checked Classes & Progression, the More menu and Overview, and Tomas and Sam grepped the code. The class table already shows what's next, e.g. 'Next (2nd): Force-Empowered Casting, Force Shield, 11 powers known, 8 force points' (Mira), 'Next (2): Infuse Item (+1), Tool Expertise, 7' (Jun), 'Next (2nd) +2 Reckless Attack, Berserker Instincts 2' (Sam). The README says sw5e.com's 'builder is still the place for rules-heavy changes (levels, multiclassing…)'.

Builder problems all five hit while levelling 1→2→3→4:
- The 'Number of levels in this class' dropdown needs two clicks.
- It silently sets 'Current Experience' to the level's minimum (300, 900, 2,700). It showed 'Current Experience: 0' first, because the site never got the XP recorded locally.
- The HP dropdown is preset to the average (4/5/6/7) with no roll, and no Con or Toughness shown. 'Hit Points Calculation: Manual' is hidden under the ⚙.
- Force-Empowered Castings, Fighting Style, Guardian Aura and Berserker Instincts have no picker, only text ('You've honed two instincts…').
- A red '!' badge appears on the gear with no explanation.
- There are hidden duplicate 'Character Sheet' buttons (8 of them, Tomas).

Multiclassing (Tomas): ADD NEW CLASS → Operative ran no Dex 13 check and offered no multiclass proficiency picks. It listed no Expertise, and nothing said that Fighter 3 / Operative 1 gets no ASI at level 4.

Cost: about 15 actions across two tabs per level (Tomas). Mira needed 3 builder trips for levels 2–3 and 2 for level 4. Sam, a first-time player, found the instinct picker in the sheet only by himself. Sam-B19 asks for an HP step that explains 'take 7 (average) or roll 1d12, + Con 2 → HP max 14 → 23'.
items.repro: Set XP to 300 or 900 on a level 1 character, then look for any way to add a level in the sheet.
items.expected:
A 'Level up' button next to the XP bar, then these steps:
1. Class: an existing one, or a new one with its prerequisite checked (Operative Dex 13, Fighter Str or Dex 13) and the multiclass proficiency pickers.
2. HP: Roll in the dice roller, or Take the average, with Con and Toughness shown along with the new maximum.
3. The new features with their text.
4. The existing pickers for that level's choices, with counts.
5. ASI/feat, only when a class reaches 4/8/….
6. A summary of what changed.
It never changes XP behind the player's back, sw5e.com's rules engine still computes the numbers, and it works in the 390 px layout.
items.workarounds: Levelled in sw5e.com's builder, then used Load from SW5E. That only works if you Sync first whenever you have class choices made in the sheet (W-011).

verified.note: Confirmed: there is no level control anywhere. renderClasses shows the next table row read-only. The README sends players to the builder. The data for a flow is present (levelChanges, hitDiceDieType, feature texts, choice slots in choices.js), and the existing pickers could be reused for step 4. It must write classes[i].levels/hitPoints/abilityScoreImprovements in a way that survives Load and Sync; today any local classes edit freezes levels (W-011). HP average and roll could use the roller.

items.resolution: Level up (Classes & Progression, or the XP line): class or a new class with SW5E's multiclass minimums, hit points (average or roll), the ASI or a feat, the archetype at its level, and what the level brings; Undo; XP raised to the level's threshold like the builder (decision 36). New powers/maneuvers/options are then picked in the class card.

items.title: Choose ASI (+2 / +1+1) or a feat in the extension
items.story: When I reach 4th level (or 8th, 12th…), I want the Ability Score Improvement card to let me choose +2 to one ability, +1 to two, or a feat (searchable, with its text, prerequisites and own picks), with a preview of the result against my real scores, tweaks and the 20 cap included, so that I don't need the builder and I land where I expect.
items.evidence: The sheet shows the ASI card ('Ability Score Improvement · Level 4 · You can increase one ability score by 2…') with only a Notes box (Mira, Jun). The result appears only as a read-only chip, 'Ability score improvements · Ability Score Improvement: Strength +2' (Priya, Sam). Nothing appears under Feats. In the builder, 'Choose an option' → ASI / Feat gives two ability selects with no current scores and no cap warning. The feat list is alphabetical and shows names only; the text appears only after picking (Mira typed 'War' and got 'Exalted Awareness, War Caster'). The builder thinks Int is 17 (Jun) and Str 19 (Sam) because Techie and Brawny exist only as tweaks in the sheet. So Int +2 and Str +2 landed exactly on the 20 cap with no warning. Priya's and Sam's ASI from the builder was then thrown away by Load (W-011).
items.repro: Level a character to 4, then open Classes / Class Features / Feats in the sheet.
items.expected: An ASI/feat picker on the class card at levels 4/8/12/16/19. It shows each score and modifier and the result ('Str 18 → 20: attack +7 → +8, damage +5 → +6') and caps at 20, counting feats and tweaks. Feats are searchable, with text and prerequisites. The card then shows the choice.
items.workarounds: Chose in sw5e.com's builder, saved and loaded. Priya and Sam then needed a javascript_tool merge, because Load dropped the result (W-011).

verified.note: Confirmed. ASIs show only as chips from classes[i].abilityScoreImprovements, and the ASI feature card has just the generic notes box (featureNoteBox). There's no picker, preview or 20-cap check. The feat list is in the rules data, and choices.js already handles feat prerequisites and feat slots (choiceSlots step 3), so a picker can reuse those. Writing ASIs to classes[] runs into W-011 until the merge is fixed.

items.resolution: The level-up's Ability Score Improvement: +2 to one, +1 to two (abilities that would pass 20 are off) or a feat with its text.

(wording copied from sw5e.com's builder). Clicking the chip does nothing (Sam), and nothing below it is clickable. Classes & Progression only has the 'Next (2nd)' table row. items.repro: Overview > Edit > XP 900 on a level 1 character.
items.expected: '900 XP: enough for level 3 (you are level 1, 2 levels to take). Next: level 4 at 2,700', linked to the level-up flow.

verified.note: renderOverview uses SW5E's xp.nextLevel for the current level and prints `Math.max(0, next - cur)`. With 900 XP at level 1 it says 'next level at 300 (0 to go)'. Nothing computes which level the XP reaches or how many levels are owed. Fix: compute from the XP table (SW5E's thresholds), say 'enough for level 3, 2 levels to take', and link to W-007.

items.resolution: The XP line counts from the XP table (SW5E's characterAdvancements): the level the XP reaches, levels owed, and the next level's threshold.

items.title: Load from SW5E silently discards a level-up made on sw5e.com once any class choice was made in the sheet
items.story: When I level up in sw5e.com's builder after making any class choice in the sheet (a power, maneuver, instinct or archetype) and press Load from SW5E, I want the new level, HP and ASI to come in and my sheet choices to stay, or at least a warning naming the conflict, so that the documented level-up workflow doesn't silently leave me a level behind.
items.evidence:
All five hit it, after picking powers (Mira, Jun, Priya), a maneuver (Tomas), or instincts and an archetype (Sam). After Load, the site's raw numbers show for 2–5 s (Jun: Engineer 3, HP 24/24, 3/3d8). Then 'Recalculated with your changes · 17:08:49' puts the sheet back to the old level (Engineer 2, HP 17/17, 2/2d8, 'next level at 900 (0 to go)').

What each player saw:
- Mira: the site had Consular 3, but the sheet still showed 'Level 2', HP 12/12, HD 2/2d6, 'Now (2nd)' and powers 11/11.
- Tomas: the site had Fighter 3; the sheet showed 'Fighter 2, Operative 1 · Level 3', HP 33/33.
- Priya, twice: Guardian 2 went back to 1, and Guardian 4 (hitPoints [6,6,6], ASI Str +2) stayed at 3.
- Sam, twice: Berserker 3 went back to 2, and Berserker 4 + Str +2 stayed at 3.

Cause, which the players read from state: the local 'Class choices' edit stores the whole `classes` value (OBJECT_FIELDS in viewer.js, 'edited as a whole value'). withEdits() lets 'your own values win', so the edit replaces the site's class entry, levels and hitPoints included. Jun's edit, for example, was classes [{Engineer, levels 2, hitPoints [5], … 'Homing Rockets'}].

Nothing on screen says the site's level was ignored. The character select reads 'Kel Dor Consular 3', 'Fighter 3, Operative 1' or 'Wookiee Berserker 3' while the sheet shows the lower level (Mira-B19). The banner only lists 'Class choices', with no hint that this freezes the levels (Jun-B2), and Validation still says 'All checks passed'. There is no good way out. 'Revert to SW5E's copy' wipes tweaks, inventory, notes, XP and personality. Sync pushes the old level back to the site (W-013) and needs a working sign-in (W-012).
items.repro:
1. Load a character.
2. In Classes & Progression, learn a power or pick a maneuver, instinct or archetype.
3. Without syncing, add a level in sw5e.com's builder and save.
4. Press Load from SW5E. After the recalculation, the sheet is back at the old level.
items.expected: Merge the class entries field by field: levels, hitPoints, ASIs (and the archetype if it was set on the site) from sw5e.com; power, option, maneuver and archetype picks from the sheet. If they can't be merged, ask: 'sw5e.com has Consular 3, your copy has Consular 2 because of your class choices. Take the site's levels and keep my picks / Keep mine'. The character select and the sheet always show the same level. At minimum, let me revert just 'Class choices' (W-016).
items.workarounds: Sync to SW5E before every builder level-up (Mira, Tomas, Jun and Priya did this in B1), then redo the level in the builder and Load again. That cost about 15 minutes and an extra trip each time. Jun, Priya (B7) and Sam used javascript_tool with the viewer's setEditedFields to drop or patch the class edit. A real player can't do that.

verified.note: Confirmed exactly as the players read it. 'classes' is in OBJECT_FIELDS and is edited as a whole value (editClass clones all of raw.classes). withEdits/setPath replaces raw.classes entirely, so the site's levels, hitPoints and ASIs are hidden. loadFromSw5e/addSnapshots replace snap.raw but never merge or prune edits. renderPicker labels the character from s.complete (the site's computation), which is why the dropdown shows Consular 3 while the sheet shows 2. Fix: merge classes per field on load (levels, hitPoints, abilityScoreImprovements and a site-set archetype from SW5E; picks from the local copy), or detect the conflict and ask.

items.resolution: Load merges instead of discarding: class membership, levels, hit points and ASIs always come from sw5e.com (also when shown and synced, so characters already stuck show their real level); other edited fields are merged three ways against the copy last loaded, and clashes keep the local value and are named in the load message. Decision 24.

items.title: Sync to SW5E hangs forever when the sw5e.com sign-in has expired (no timeout, no message)
items.story: When my sw5e.com sign-in has expired, or a sync stalls for any reason, I want Sync and Load to time out with a plain message ('Your sw5e.com sign-in expired. Sign in there, then try again. Your data is safe here'), say whether anything reached the site, and offer Cancel, so that I don't sit watching 'Syncing…' for minutes thinking my character is lost.
items.evidence: Priya made 4 attempts between 18:11 and 18:23. Each showed 'Syncing…' and 'Opening sw5e.com in a background tab…' for 20 s to more than 3 min. One ended with 'Could not sync to sw5e.com: Frame with ID 0 was removed.' after she navigated her sw5e.com tab; the others never ended. The site's copy stayed unchanged, while Load kept working ('Recalculated with your changes · 18:16:22'). Sam's first sync ever (18:55) ran for 90+ s with no error, timeout or Cancel, and the Revert button disappeared while it ran. Cause, seen by both: the site's own store still says isLoggedIn=true, but every save redirects to sw5e.b2clogin.com 'Sign up or sign in'. The bridge's message 'Not signed in on sw5e.com. Sign in there, then save again.' only checks that flag. Load from SW5E while signed out only said 'Recalculated with your changes · 18:29:22' (Sam). Local edits were kept throughout.
items.repro: Let the sw5e.com session expire (the builder's CHARACTER SHEET button then redirects to Sign up or sign in). Make a change in the viewer and press Sync to SW5E.
items.expected: Detect the failed token refresh or login redirect and show the sign-in message. Time out (e.g. after 60 s) with 'sw5e.com didn't confirm the save; nothing was changed there; try again'. Offer a Cancel button. Never show raw text like 'Frame with ID 0'.
items.workarounds: Reload the viewer page to get the Sync button back (data intact). Nothing could be synced, because the panel doesn't sign in.

verified.note: There are four causes. (1) Sign-in is checked only via the store flag `G['authentication/isLoggedIn']`, which stays true after the token expires. (2) `await store.dispatch('character/saveCharacter', next)` comes before the 20 s confirmation timer. If token refresh redirects or stalls, it never resolves, and runInSw5eTab has no timeout around chrome.scripting.executeScript (its 60 s deadline is only checked between polls). dev/bridge-proxy.js has no timeout either. (3) Navigating the tab surfaces Chrome's raw 'Frame with ID 0 was removed.' (4) viewer.js:saveChangesToSw5e has no Cancel, and renderPending hides Revert while saving.

items.resolution: The page function bounds its waits (fetch 20 s, save 25 s + the 20 s confirmation), the extension backstops a page that stops answering, a tab that moved to the sign-in page is reported as 'sw5e.com asked you to sign in again', and Chrome's 'Frame with ID 0 was removed' becomes a readable message. The dev proxy gives up after 3 minutes. No Cancel button yet.

items.title: Sync to SW5E silently lowers a higher class level on sw5e.com
items.story: When Sync would overwrite something newer on sw5e.com (like a higher class level), I want it to list what will change ('Consular 3 → Consular 2') and ask first, or merge, so that I don't undo a level-up without knowing.
items.evidence: After the Load that ignored the site's new level (W-011), Sync went straight through with no confirmation and no warning. Mira's sync showed 'Synced to sw5e.com · 15:46:14' and 'Same as sw5e.com's copy. Changes are kept here.', and the site then showed 'Kel Dor Consular 2' again (900/900 XP). Tomas's went 'Syncing…' → done, his dropdown changed from 'Fighter 3, Operative 1' to 'Fighter 2, Operative 1', and the site showed HP 33. Both used this on purpose as the only workaround for W-011, then levelled again in the builder.
items.repro: Make a class choice in the sheet, level up in the builder, press Load, then press Sync, and reload the sw5e.com character page.
items.expected: Before syncing, list the fields that would go down or be overwritten on the site and ask: 'Keep sw5e.com's levels / Send mine'. Or merge the levels as in W-011.
items.workarounds: Accepted the revert and levelled again in the builder.

verified.note: The conflict check compares the server copy with `expected: snap.raw`. After a Load, snap.raw is already the site's newer copy, so nothing conflicts, and fields.classes (the stale local classes, W-011) overwrites next.classes whole. Nothing lists the fields that would change or go down before sending. Fix: diff the edited fields against snap.raw (levels especially) and confirm, or merge as in W-011.

items.resolution: Sync sends class levels, hit points and ASIs from the site's copy (never older ones), and a conflict merges the newer copy in (decision 24).

items.title: Load from SW5E doesn't switch to the character I just created
items.story: When I press Load from SW5E after creating a character on sw5e.com, I want the sheet to switch to that character (the one open in my sw5e.com tab, or the new one), or ask 'New: Kadro Vos (Panel). Open it?', so that I don't load or hunt for someone else's character in a list of 9–12.
items.evidence: All five hit it in part A. The status said 'Loaded 5/7/8 characters from sw5e.com', but the sheet stayed on another player's character (Thirza Vitchess, Kadro Vos, Tikk Plonr or Maasha Vaal), even with the new character open in the sw5e.com tab. Mira saw the reverse: 'Consular Test (local)' switched to Thirza by itself after about 5 s, though her sw5e.com tab was on the Consular rules page (it seems to pick the most recently changed character). On the phone, Jun saw 'Opening sw5e.com in a background tab…' disappear with no result message, then a native dropdown of 10 with names cut off ('Kadro Vos (Panel) — Zabrak Figh'). Priya saw no notice within 6 s. In part B, Jun's Load stayed on his own character, which was already selected ('part A's complaint fixed'). So what's left is the case of a new character or another character being selected.
items.repro: With character X on screen, create character Y on sw5e.com, leave the sw5e.com tab open on Y, and press Load from SW5E.
items.expected: Switch to the character open on sw5e.com or the one just created. Otherwise show a lasting notice: 'New: Y. Open'. The result message stays readable on phones.
items.workarounds: Picked the character from the dropdown (on the phone, by typing its name).

verified.note: loadFromSw5e keeps state.current if it was loaded, otherwise falls back to keys[0] (the first character in the site's order). selectId is passed only when the viewer was opened from a sw5e.com tab (main()). preferredTabId picks the tab, never the character. The bridge already returns meta.sourceUrl (the sw5e.com tab's URL) but it's ignored. Newly appeared keys aren't detected either. Mira's switch happened because her 'local:' key became an 'id:' key after saving, so it fell to keys[0]. On phones the result toast fades after 5 s (setStatus).

items.resolution: Load switches to the character open in the sw5e.com tab, or else to a character that's new there (the newest), and says so in its message.

items.title: Sync status wording misleads; destructive 'Revert' / 'Use SW5E's values' links sit next to everyday buttons
items.story: When I glance at the sync line or the banner, I want it to say honestly that my changes are saved here and what isn't on sw5e.com yet ('Saved in this browser; not on sw5e.com yet. Sync is optional'). I also want 'Revert to SW5E's copy' and 'Use SW5E's values' kept away from the rest and Sync buttons, with a confirmation listing what I'd lose. That way I neither think my data is unsaved nor wipe a session with a stray tap.
items.evidence: Jun (step A8): after a short rest, the tracker line read 'Same as sw5e.com's copy. Changes are kept here.' while 7 tweaks, inventory, notes, personality and credits were not synced. At other times it read 'Differs from sw5e.com's copy. Use SW5E's values · [Sync to SW5E]', with 'Use SW5E's values' right under Short rest / Long rest. Priya: the same link sits next to 'Sync to SW5E' and the rest buttons mid-fight. Sam (new player): the banner 'Not synced to SW5E: play state, Tweaks, Personality Traits, … Inventory, Notes, Credits, XP', with 'Sync to SW5E' and 'Revert to SW5E's copy' side by side, read to him as 'your data isn't saved', and he didn't dare touch either. Priya: the edit-form footer 'Markdown works here. Changes stay in this browser until you save them to SW5E.' contradicts the README (the viewer's copy is the character's data). Jun's part B log praises the new banner, which lists exactly what differs, as much clearer than part A's line. Jun and Sam rated it medium, Priya low.
items.repro: Change inventory or tweaks and take a short rest, then read the tracker line and the banner. Open Personality > Edit and read the footer.
items.expected: Wording such as 'Play state same as sw5e.com; 12 other changes not synced' and 'Saved here. Sync to SW5E is optional; export a backup.' Destructive links moved away from frequent buttons, with a confirmation that lists what would be discarded.

verified.note: The wording is misleading in two places. renderTracker's 'Same as sw5e.com's copy. Changes are kept here.' compares only play state (t.local) and ignores edits. renderEditor's footer 'Changes stay in this browser until you save them to SW5E.' contradicts the README ('this viewer's copy is your character's data'). Both destructive links sit next to everyday buttons, though each has some guard: 'Use SW5E's values' (data-track=sw5e) can be undone ('Reset to SW5E values'), and 'Revert to SW5E's copy' needs a second click ('Really revert?'). Neither says what will be lost.

items.resolution: Banner reads 'Saved here; not on sw5e.com yet: …'; the tracker line only appears when HP and uses differ ('saved here, not on sw5e.com yet'); the editor footer and Done message say the data is saved here and Sync is optional. 'Revert to SW5E's copy…' and 'Use sw5e.com's values' are small links set apart, and Revert's confirmation names what it drops.

items.title: Take sw5e.com's value for one field only ('Use SW5E's' per field in the Not synced banner)
items.story: When one field (like Class choices) is out of step with sw5e.com, I want to take the site's value for that field only, so that I don't have to choose between losing everything (Revert) and pushing my stale copy (Sync).
items.evidence: The banner lists 'play state, Class choices, Feature notes, Feature choices, Tweaks, Personality…, Notes, Inventory, XP', but its only buttons are 'Sync to SW5E' and 'Revert to SW5E's copy' (all or nothing). Reverting just this field is what would have rescued the lost level in W-011; Jun also asked to 'at minimum revert just Class choices'.
items.repro: Make several kinds of local changes and look at the banner.
items.expected: Each listed field is clickable and shows the difference, with 'Use SW5E's' and 'Keep mine'.
items.workarounds: Sync first, then redo the level on the site.

verified.note: The banner lists field labels (fieldLabel) but offers only Sync or Revert-all (discardEdits deletes state.edits[key] entirely). Reverting one field is easy (delete edits[key].fields[path]); showing the difference per field is the larger part. This would have been the escape from W-011.

items.resolution: 'One at a time…' in the banner takes sw5e.com's value for a single field, with Undo.

items.title: Show what's new after a Load that adds levels
items.story: When a Load brings in new levels, I want a 'What's new at level 3' list (HP change, new features, choices still owed, each linked to its picker), so that I don't miss a choice.
items.evidence: After the Load, the sheet silently became 'Fighter 2, Operative 1 · Level 3', HP 31, with new tracker rows (Superiority dice, Action Surge, a d8 hit die). It didn't mention the choices now owed: 1 maneuver, 2 Expertise picks, 1 multiclass skill and 1 tool. Tomas had to read the whole page to find them.
items.repro: Level up on sw5e.com, then Load from SW5E.
items.expected: A summary panel or toast: 'Level 3: HP +17 (6 Fighter + 5 Operative + Con), new: Action Surge, Combat Superiority, Sneak Attack, Expertise; to choose: 1 maneuver, Expertise (2), Operative multiclass skill + tool'. The same summary would end the level-up flow (W-007).

verified.note: A Load replaces the snapshot and reports only 'Loaded N characters'. Nothing compares old and new levels or lists new features or owed choices. The pieces exist (missingClassFeatures, choiceSlots counts, countChip '0/1'), so a summary can be computed from the before and after models. It belongs at the end of W-007 too.

items.resolution: A Load that brings a level added on sw5e.com says which, and what it brings ('New on sw5e.com: Fighter 4 (new: …)').

items.title: Numbers without tweaks flash for 3–5 s during every recalculation
items.story: When the sheet recalculates (after Load, an XP edit, a sync), I want it to keep showing my last good numbers, so that a glance mid-fight isn't wrong and I don't think my tweaks were lost.
items.evidence:
Between 'Loaded N characters… (totals not recalculated yet)' and 'Recalculated with your changes', the sheet shows the numbers without tweaks:
- Tomas: HP 13/13 and Passive 11, then 14/14 and 13.
- Priya: Force points 2/4 and Passive Perception 12, then 3/5 and 15. In part B it also happened after an XP edit (FP 4/4 → 5/5, Passive 12 → 15), so it isn't only after Load.
- Sam, looking at Maasha's sheet: FP 4/4 and Passive 12, then 5/5 and 15.
Jun's logs show the same thing: tech points 5/5 instead of 6/6 during an XP recalculation, and AC briefly 13 during a sync.
items.repro: With tweaks on HP, Perception or an ability, press Load from SW5E or edit XP, and watch the summary and tracker.
items.expected: Keep the last computed values until the new ones arrive (or dim them / show 'recalculating').

verified.note: buildModel only uses the last recalculation when `state.derived[key].at > snap.loadedAt`. addSnapshots (Load, Sync) and recomputeCurrent set loadedAt = now. Until the next recomputeDerived finishes, the sheet falls back to SW5E's plain snap.complete, without local tweaks or effects: Jun's AC 13 during a sync, FP 4 vs 5 after Load. Fix: keep the last derived values (dimmed) regardless of loadedAt. Check the 'after an XP edit' reports: an XP edit alone keeps `last`, so they probably followed a Load or a failed recalculation.

items.resolution: Until a recalculation arrives, the last one is shown (with the banner saying it's being updated) instead of SW5E's plain copy without tweaks.

items.title: Text-only edits trigger a full sw5e.com recalculation
items.story: When I type a note, personality text or a free-text choice, I want it saved without opening sw5e.com and recalculating, so that the sheet stays calm and fast.
items.evidence: Typing 'Lend Aid' in a feature's 'Your choices' box (Priya), or pressing Done on Personality & Appearance (Sam), showed 'Opening sw5e.com in a background tab…' and then 'Recalculated with your changes'. This happened even with a sw5e.com tab already open, and again after every power, tweak and item change (Priya).
items.repro: Edit any feature note or personality field.
items.expected: Free-text changes are saved locally without a recalculation. Reuse an open sw5e.com tab when one is needed.

verified.note: The recalculation basis is canonical(fx.raw), the whole edited character including notes, characteristics and featureNotes. needsDerived is true for almost any character (feature effects, tweaks), so every text edit invalidates the cache and recalculates. Fix: drop text-only fields from the basis (featureNotes still matter where they change effects, but those changes show up as tweaks in fx.raw anyway). The 'background tab despite an open tab' part is plausible only: bridge.js:acquireSw5eTab reuses non-discarded sw5e.com tabs, so check whether that tab was discarded or in another profile.

items.resolution: Notes, personality/appearance, feature notes and credits are left out of the engine's basis, so editing them doesn't recalculate (decision 34).

items.title: No clear confirmation after Sync to SW5E
items.story: When I press Sync to SW5E, I want a lasting 'Synced to sw5e.com · 16:50 (Tweaks, Class choices, Notes)', so that I know it worked, and what was sent, before I level up on the site.
items.evidence: Tomas saw 'Syncing…' → 'Recalculating with your active effects…' → 'Recalculated with your changes · 16:50:49', and only the banner disappearing told him it worked. Jun saw the same sequence; the only confirmation was in Settings > Local version history ('17:39:05 latest · Synced to SW5E'). The Sync in Mira's tracker did show 'Synced to sw5e.com · 15:46:14', so the message exists on one path but not on the banner's.
items.repro: Make a local change, then press Sync to SW5E in the banner.
items.expected: A success message with the time and the fields sent, which stays until tapped on phones.
items.workarounds: Reload the sw5e.com sheet to check.

verified.note: On success the status reads 'Synced to sw5e.com · time'. Then `finally` calls scheduleRecompute, and recomputeDerived overwrites the status about 1–2 s later with its own messages and 'Recalculated with your changes · time'. The banner and the tracker call the same function; Mira saw the message only because no recalculation was needed then. The fields sent aren't listed. Fix: a sticky success notice, and don't let the recalculation status replace it.

items.resolution: Progress and success messages of a background recalculation are quiet: they don't replace a message the player's own action gave in the last 15 s, so 'Synced to sw5e.com · time' stays.

items.title: Explain why sw5e.com shows different numbers after a sync
items.story: When I compare sw5e.com's sheet with mine after syncing, I want to know which numbers differ and why, so that I don't think the sync failed or one of them is broken.
items.evidence: Tomas, site vs sheet: Blaster rifle 1d8+3 vs 1d8+6 (Brute Force +2, the nightstinger +1); Stealth +5 vs +7 and Perception +3 vs +5 (Expertise from the feature notes); Passive 13 vs 15. Jun: the site shows AC 13 'Combat suit', the sheet 14, because Armor (Fine) is an effect and effects are never sent (per the README). His Armstech modifications aren't on the site either.
items.repro: Sync, then open the character on sw5e.com.
items.expected: After a sync: 'sw5e.com will show different values for: … because it doesn't apply these features/effects (Armor (Fine) AC +1, modifications, tweak reasons)'.

verified.where: viewer.js:saveChangesToSw5e; README 'Effects are never saved to sw5e.com'
verified.note: This is by design: effects and feature effects are local (applyEffects), and only raw fields are sent. Nothing after a sync explains why sw5e.com's numbers differ. The list is easy to build from m.fx.effects (kind item, feature or temporary) and the bumped paths (m.bumps).

items.resolution: After a sync the notice says what sw5e.com shows without: 'sw5e.com shows some numbers without what this sheet adds (its engine doesn't apply them): Shield (Fine): AC +1; Strength Enhancer: STR 21; Expertise: Persuasion: expertise…', up to six and a count. Long notices stay up to 20 s and are in Recent messages.

items.title: 'Not synced' banner lists XP although both copies have the same value
items.story: When the banner lists what differs from sw5e.com, I want only real differences, so that I know what a sync would change.
items.evidence: The builder raised the site's XP to 900, the same as the local 900. After Load, the banner still said 'Not synced to SW5E: … Notes, Credits, XP'.
items.repro: Edit XP locally, set the same XP on the site (the builder does this when adding levels), then Load.
items.expected: Drop fields whose local value now equals the site's.

verified.note: pruneEdits, which drops edits now equal to SW5E's copy, is only called after a sync (saveChangesToSw5e). loadFromSw5e never calls it, so an XP edit of 900 stays listed after the site also reaches 900. Fix: call pruneEdits(key, raw) for each loaded snapshot.

items.resolution: Load prunes (and merges) edits for every loaded character, so a field now equal to the site's drops out of the banner.

items.title: 'Recalculated with your changes' on a character I haven't changed
items.story: When I first open a freshly loaded character, I want a neutral message, so that I don't think something was changed behind my back.
items.evidence: The first notice for her new, untouched character was 'Recalculated with your changes · 14:27:15'.
items.repro: Load a new character and select it.
items.expected: 'Calculated · time', or say what changed.

verified.note: The success message is fixed: 'Recalculated with your changes'. A recalculation runs for any character whose model has effects; feature effects such as class weapon proficiencies exist for nearly everyone, even untouched ones. Fix: word it by cause ('Calculated', or name the edits or effects).

items.resolution: The recalculation's message is 'Numbers updated · time', and it's quiet (see W-020).

items.title: Class and background skill pickers (instead of hand-made proficiency tweaks)
items.story: When I set up a character, I want a 'choose 2 of 7' class-skill picker and a '2 of 4' background-skill picker on the class and background cards (or a proficiency toggle on the Skills table), limited to the allowed lists, with the source filled in and a warning or expertise when two sources give the same skill, so that my proficiencies are real data instead of 5–7 hand-made tweaks.
items.evidence:
Every character arrived with no proficient skills, and neither the builder nor the sheet asks for them. Lists the players had to apply by hand:
- Mira: Consular 'Choose two from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Lore, Medicine, and Persuasion', plus Force Adept 2 of 4.
- Tomas: Fighter 'Choose two from Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, Lore, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, and Survival', plus Soldier 'Athletics, Intimidation, Persuasion, and Piloting'.
- Jun: Engineer 'Choose three from Investigation, Lore, Medicine, Nature, Piloting, and Technology', plus Scientist 'two from Lore, Medicine, Nature, and Technology'. Jun's wishes also ask for the class/background tool and language picks (W-025).
- Priya: Guardian 2 of 9, plus Jedi 'two from Insight, Investigation, Lore, and Persuasion'.
- Sam: Berserker 2 of 6, plus Mercenary 2 of 4. Athletics from the class plus Brawny should make expertise.

Cost: each tweak means Add a tweak to… (type to select) > mode 'proficient' > typed reason > Add, about 5–6 actions. Tomas spent about 40 actions on 5 skills, Priya about 20, and Jun made 7 tweaks. Clicking the proficiency circle on a Skills row only opens the dice dock (Mira, Sam). The tweaks show as 'tweak (not synced to SW5E yet)', not as proficiencies (Jun), and the tweak list sorts oddly (Priya). The Background card shows 'Choose two from Deception, Insight, Perception, and Persuasion' as plain text (Mira).
items.repro: Create any character on sw5e.com, Load from SW5E, and look at Skills and the class and background cards.
items.expected: Pickers like the fighting-style one ('2/2'), applied as proficiencies with automatic reasons ('Consular skill', 'Soldier skill') and synced as normal data. A warning or automatic expertise when two sources give the same skill. Also part of the creation flow (W-001).
items.workarounds: 'proficient' / 'expertise' tweaks with typed reasons. They work and show where they come from on hover.

verified.where: viewer.js:renderSkills, renderBackground; roller.js click handler (row → roll)
verified.note: Confirmed missing. The data exists (classes.skillChoicesList/numSkillChoices, backgrounds.skillProficiencies text), but nothing offers picks. Proficiencies can only come from tweaks (addTweak) or feature notes. Clicking a Skills row rolls by design (roller.js document click handler). It needs a storage decision (a field sw5e.com keeps; bridge.js fieldType whitelists only the fields it lists), duplicate-source handling, and sync. Reuse renderSlot's counted-picker UI.

items.resolution: Pickers for the class's skills (classes[0].skills), a multiclass skill, and the background's skills (background.skills), which SW5E's engine applies; a skill isn't offered twice (decisions 35, 37).

items.title: Add tool and language proficiencies (pickers for 'of your choice')
items.story: When my class, background or species gives me tools or languages 'of your choice', I want to pick them (from SW5E's lists, or by typing) in Proficiencies & Languages or on the source card, replacing the raw sentence, so that they're on the sheet and features like Tool Expertise can apply to them.
items.evidence: Proficiencies & Languages has no add control, although its legend says '✎ = custom proficiency added on the character'. The tweak list covers only abilities, saves, skills and numbers. The Tool row shows raw sentences as if they were tools: 'Two of your choice of artisan's implements, gaming sets, or musical instruments' (Mira; this chip also makes the phone page scroll sideways, W-120), 'One type of gaming set' (Tomas, Sam), 'One of your choice' (Jun). Jun's class card shows 'Tools Tinker's implements, one of your choice' as plain text. New in part B (Jun-B11, high): Engineer 2's Tool Expertise ('You gain expertise in any tool proficiencies you gain from this class.') has nothing to apply to. Missing species languages are tracked in W-142.
items.repro: Load any character whose background says 'choose a tool/language' (Force Adept, Soldier, Scientist, Mercenary) and open Proficiencies & Languages.
items.expected: Add custom tools and languages, with pickers that replace the 'of your choice' text. Tool proficiencies are recorded, so Tool Expertise applies and tool checks can be rolled with the right bonus.
items.workarounds: Written in Notes, e.g. 'Tools (Force Adept): Chance cubes, Ommni box'; 'Tinker's implements, Slicer's kit, Chemist's kit'; 'Sabacc deck'.

verified.note: renderProficiencies displays raw.customProficiencies and customLanguages (hence the ✎ legend) but has no control to add them. 'One of your choice' chips are SW5E's c.proficiencies shown as-is. Syncing them needs the bridge's save whitelist extended: customProficiencies and customLanguages aren't allowed there. Tool Expertise can then read class tools. clsFeatureEffects already gives expertise from notes.

items.resolution: Tool pickers for the class, a multiclass class and the background (customProficiencies, marked with their source) and language pickers for the background (background.languages) and species (customLanguages).

items.title: Feat ability increases and granted skills aren't applied; choice feats have no picker
items.story: When my feat says 'Increase your Wisdom score by 1' or 'You gain proficiency in the Insight skill', I want the sheet to apply it. When it says 'Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution' or 'an ability score of your choice', I want a picker. That way my scores, DCs, points and skills are right without tweaks.
items.evidence:
Neither sw5e.com nor the sheet applies a background feat's fixed increases or skills:
- Empathic Wis +1 and Insight (Mira): Wis 17 'base 15 · +2 from species/ASIs/feats/tweaks', Insight +3. Once fixed: Wis 18, FP 8, DC 14, Insight +6.
- Techie Int +1, Technology and the repair droid power (Jun): Int 17 instead of 18, tech attack +5 / DC 13 instead of +6 / 14, 5 tech points instead of 6, Technology +3. Repair droid is missing on sw5e.com's sheet.
- Brawny +1 Str and Athletics (Sam): Str 17, Athletics +3. Sam's wish also covers the Wookiee species traits Menacing (Intimidation) and Claws (1d4); see W-140 and W-147.

Feats that let you choose the ability have no picker anywhere: Weapon Expert 'Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1' (Tomas) and Formfighting Dabbler 'Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20' (Priya).

The feat cards show '+ Wisdom', '+ Intelligence', '+ Strength + Dexterity + Constitution' or '+ Any' tags that look applied or clickable. Clicking one only collapses the card (Tomas, Priya). Feats have no 'Your choices' box.
items.repro: Load a character with the Empathic, Techie, Brawny, Weapon Expert or Formfighting Dabbler background feat, then check the ability score and the skill.
items.expected: Fixed feat increases and granted skills and powers are applied like class features (or at least flagged 'not applied by SW5E'). Feats that let you choose get an ability picker (max 20), applied like an ASI. The breakdown shows a line such as '+1 from Techie'.
items.workarounds: Ability score +1 and proficient/expertise tweaks with reasons.

verified.note: Feat texts are never run through clsFeatureEffects. featureEffects covers class and archetype features, option picks and slot picks only; defensesOf reads feats only for defenses and advantages. So 'Your Wisdom score increases by 1' and 'proficiency in Insight' from a feat change nothing. The '+ Wisdom' tags in renderFeats are plain chips in the card head, so clicking toggles the card. Fixed increases could reuse clsFeatureEffects with its cap; choice feats need an ability picker. Note clsFeatureEffects already raises needsChoice for 'A or B' abilities.

items.resolution: A feat's +1 is a picker: the background feat's goes in background.feat.abilityScoreImprovements (SW5E applies it), an ASI feat's is applied by the sheet; feats' proficiencies and numbers ('You gain proficiency in the Insight skill') apply.

items.title: Add/Learn/Choose selects add every option passed while typing or using the arrow keys
items.story: When I pick a power, maneuver, fighting style, aura or archetype by typing its name or using the arrow keys, I want only the option I confirm to be added, so that I don't collect wrong picks (or switch archetype) and have to remove them one by one.
items.evidence:
Every 'Add…', 'Learn…' and 'Choose…' select in Classes & Progression acts on each change:
- Fighting style (Tomas, part A): typing 'Sharp' added Secured Style and Sharpshooter Style, '⚠ 2 chosen, 1 allowed'.
- Maneuvers, about 130 (Tomas, part B): 'Precision Attack' + Enter added Parry (Improved), Precise Movements and Precision Attack ('3 / 1'). Alt+↓, 'Ret' + Enter added Rally, Reassure and Return Fire ('4 / 2').
- Tech powers (Jun): 'Homing' added Haywire, Hologram and Homing Rockets ('9 / 7'). On the Archetype list, two arrow presses fired change events for 'Armormech Engineering' then 'Armstech Engineering' (caught with a listener).
- Force powers (Priya, part A): 'Guidance' added Give Life and Guidance ('6 / 5').
- Priya, part B: 'Force Leap' added Feedback (Dark), Force Disarm and Force Leap. Guardian Aura 'Aura of Pre' added Aura of Conquest and Aura of Presence ('2 / 1').

Each removal starts a recalculation of about 5 s, and the next row's × slides under the pointer (W-128). Rated medium in part A, raised to high in part B as it hit more lists.
items.repro: Classes & Progression → 'Add a maneuver…' or 'Learn a force power…' → focus it or press Alt+↓ → type a name → Enter.
items.expected: Add only on Enter, a click or an Add button. Better: a searchable list that shows each option's text (W-028).
items.workarounds: Remove the extras with ×, or type a single first letter that lands straight on the option. Jun and Priya set the select's value with javascript_tool.

verified.where: viewer.js:wireUi document 'change' listener (ds.clsAdd, ds.slotAdd, ds.pwAdd, ds.clsArch)
verified.note: The listener adds a pick (addClassChoice, addSlotPick, addClassPower) or sets the archetype (setArchetype) on every change event. In Chrome, a closed <select> fires change on each arrow key or type-ahead match. Each add re-renders (renderAll), refocus puts focus on the new select, and the next keystrokes add again. Fix: commit on Enter, click or blur, or an Add button, or use a combobox.

items.resolution: A keyboard change (arrow keys, type-ahead) in the Add/Learn/Choose/Archetype lists waits for Enter; leaving the list puts it back; a click or tap in the open list commits at once (decision 29).

items.title: Read an option's text before choosing it (powers, styles, maneuvers, strategies, instincts, archetypes)
items.story: When I learn a power or choose a fighting style, maneuver, strategy, instinct, Force-Empowered Casting or archetype, I want to read each option's text and tags (level, casting time, concentration, duration, maneuver type, prerequisites) before committing, so that I compare options instead of picking by name and removing it if it's wrong.
items.evidence:
All the pickers are plain selects of names:
- 'Learn a force power…' shows names, alignment and '(needs …)' only; no concentration or casting time (Priya).
- 'Add from Force-Empowered Castings…'.
- Archetype (12 Ways).
- 'Choose a fighting style…' (32 names).
- 'Add a maneuver…' (about 130).
- 'Add from Fighter Strategies…' (8).
- 'Add from Berserker Instincts…' (9; the options have no title).
The text appears only after adding.

Sam, a first-timer, read sw5e.com's Berserker page in another tab. Tomas learnt what Cover Strategist does only after taking it; sw5e.com's fighting-style pages didn't load, and its Fighter page doesn't list the strategies. Mira chose Battle Precognition, Sanctuary and Way of the Seer from D&D memory. Priya picked Battle Precognition in the builder and only learned on the sheet that it 'has no effect if you are wearing armor'. Sam rated it high, the others medium.
items.repro: Open any Add/Learn/Choose select in Classes & Progression.
items.expected: A searchable list with expandable rows or a preview pane: a one-line summary ('Predator's: speed +10 ft', 'Dewback's: resist 3 damage types while raging'), the full text, the type and prerequisites.
items.workarounds: Pick, read, then remove with × if it's wrong. Read sw5e.com in another tab.

verified.note: Every Add, Learn or Choose control is a plain <option> list of names with '(needs …)' or level tags. The text appears only in the <details> of a pick after adding. The texts are available (o.text, p.description, mv.description), so a searchable list with a preview pane is a UI build, not a data one.

items.resolution: 'Read the options' under each list (maneuvers, class options, slots, powers, archetypes) shows every option's text with a Choose button.

items.title: Multiclass Operative: no pickers for 'any one skill' and 'one tool'
items.story: When I multiclass into Operative, I want to pick the skill and tool the multiclass grants, so that they're proficiencies on the sheet instead of tweaks and Notes.
items.evidence: SW5E PHB multiclassing table: 'Operative — Light armor, any one skill, one tool from the class's list' (prerequisite Dexterity 13). The sheet's Operative card says only 'Multiclass grants Light armor'. The same card also lists 'Saves Dexterity, Intelligence', 'Tools One specialist's kit of your choice' and the full single-class weapon list, which a multiclass doesn't get. The save numbers themselves are right.
items.repro: Fighter character + Operative 1 → Classes & Progression → Operative card.
items.expected: Pickers for the multiclass skill and tool, applied as proficiencies. Grey out or hide what a multiclass doesn't get (saves, the class's skills, other tools).
items.workarounds: A 'Stealth (DEX) proficient' tweak with the reason 'Operative multiclass: any one skill'. The tool (Security kit) went in Notes.

verified.note: SW5E's data for Operative multiClassProficiencies is just ['Light armor'] (dev/dumps/rules.json), so 'any one skill, one tool' isn't in the data, and the card prints that list. The same card prints the full single-class saves, tools and weapons for any class index; only 'Multiclass grants' is added for idx > 0. Weapon effects already use the multiclass list (featureEffectsUncached). It needs a hand-written multiclass table and pickers.

items.resolution: A second class gets its multiclass skill and tool pickers from SW5E's Multiclassing Proficiencies table (Operative: any one skill, one tool).

items.title: 'Your choices' boxes stay orange after the choice is made elsewhere, and appear where there's nothing to choose
items.story: When I've picked my fighting style or archetype in Classes & Progression, I want the feature card to show the choice ('Chosen: Frenzied Approach') instead of an orange empty box, and no box on options that have nothing to choose, so that I know what's really left to do.
items.evidence: Tomas: the Fighting Style card's 'Your choices' box stays orange and empty, while Fighting styles (1) shows Sharpshooter Style and the picker says 1/1. Mira: the Consular Tradition card stays orange although Way of the Seer is chosen in the Archetype select. Sam: the Berserker Approach card still shows an empty 'What you chose (e.g. Persuasion + Forgery kit)' after he picked Frenzied Approach. Mira: Twinned Power's row offers 'Your choices for it, if any (e.g. Persuasion + Forgery kit)', although it has no choices.
items.repro: Pick a fighting style or archetype with its picker, then open Class Features.
items.expected: Show 'Chosen: … (change in Classes & Progression)' and count the feature as answered. No choices box on options that have no choices.

verified.note: featureNoteBox marks the box orange (`asks && !note`) whenever the feature text contains choose, choice or select. It never checks the slot picks (fighting style), the archetype select or the option lists, so Fighting Style, Consular Tradition and Berserker Approach stay orange. renderClassChoices gives every option pick a cls-note input with the 'Persuasion + Forgery kit' placeholder, Twinned Power included.

items.resolution: A feature whose choice is made in a picker shows 'Chosen: … · change it in Classes & Progression' (or 'Not chosen yet') with a plain Notes box: slot picks (fighting style, forms), the archetype feature, class option lists named by the feature. Option picks only get a choices box when the option's text asks for a choice.

items.title: Free-text 'Your choices' should be real pickers (choose-one features, Expertise)
items.story: When a feature says 'choose one of…' or 'choose two of your proficiencies', I want radio buttons or a counted picker limited to the valid options, so that I don't have to type names exactly and a typo or an invalid pick can't slip in.
items.evidence: Force Affinity shows the chip 'Choose one of Ashla, Bendu, Bogan' and a free-text box (placeholder 'What you chose (e.g. Persuasion + Forgery kit)'). Typing 'Ashla' cleared the chip (Mira, low). Operative Expertise: typing 'Stealth + Perception' worked (Stealth +7, Perception +5, Passive 15), but nothing says it must be 2 proficient skills or tools, and nothing would flag a misspelling (Tomas, medium). Related free-text choices: Dewback's damage types (W-072), Channel the Force (W-033).
items.repro: Class Features → Force Affinity or Operative Expertise → Your choices.
items.expected: Radio buttons for choose-one features (Bendu could then add the Cha modifier to FP automatically). Expertise as '2 of: Insight, Intimidation, Perception, Persuasion, Piloting, Stealth, [tools]' with a count, like the fighting-style picker.

verified.note: Choices are parsed from free text. clsNoteNames picks skill and ability names out of the note, which works for 'Stealth + Perception' as Tomas saw. Nothing limits it to valid options or a count, and a misspelling just leaves the needsChoice chip. Radio buttons or counted pickers could reuse the renderSlot UI. Bendu's Cha to FP isn't modelled.

items.resolution: Feature choices are pickers with a count on the feature's card: Force Affinity offers Ashla, Bendu or Bogan (Bendu adds the lower of Wis/Cha to force points: Consular Test 23 → 25), ability increases, 'Persuasion or Intimidation', tools of a kind, weapons, damage types. The picks go into the feature's notes, so earlier notes still work. Expertise is one picker in the class card with skills and proficient tools ('Stealth + Perception' written before shows as chosen). Also fixed: 'one of the following skills: A, B, or C' gave every listed skill.

items.title: Archetype bonus proficiencies don't show on the Proficiencies card
items.story: When my archetype gives me armor or weapon proficiencies (Armstech: medium armor and martial weapons; Soresu Form: heavy armor), I want them listed on the Proficiencies and class cards, so that I know what I can use when the party splits loot.
items.evidence: Jun (Armstech Engineering): the Proficiencies card shows 'Armor Light armor' and 'Weapons Simple blasters, simple vibroweapons', and the class card the same. Only Combat > Effects > FROM CLASS FEATURES shows 'Bonus Proficiencies: Proficient: martial blasters · martial vibroweapons · armstech's implements · medium armor'. Priya (Soresu Form): the feature says 'You gain proficiency in heavy armor.', but Proficiencies & Languages and the class card footer still say 'Light armor, medium armor'.
items.repro: Pick Armstech Engineering or Soresu Form at 3rd level, then open Proficiencies & Languages.
items.expected: The Proficiencies card and class card list the archetype's proficiencies, marked with their source.

verified.note: Feature effects carry e.armor and e.weapons; the Bonus Proficiencies texts parse into these, e.g. Armstech 'medium armor, martial blasters, and martial vibroweapons'. renderProficiencies only adds m.fx.tools, so armor and weapons appear only under Effects (renderEffects featRow). The class card footer prints the class's own ref.armorProficiencies and weaponProficiencies.

items.resolution: The Proficiencies card lists armor and weapons from class and archetype features ('medium armor · Bonus Proficiencies'). The class card footer still shows the class's own list.

items.title: Channel the Force: choose Cause Harm / Lend Aid and use it
items.story: When my class lets me pick a Channel the Force effect, I want a real choice and a Use button per effect that spends a use and shows the healing, damage and DC (on me or someone else), so that the feature works at the table.
items.evidence: The builder has text only. In the sheet, the Channel the Force card has a 2/2 counter and a free-text 'Your choices' box (placeholder 'What you chose (e.g. Persuasion + Forgery kit)'), where she typed 'Lend Aid'. There's no Use for Lend Aid ('guardian level + your Wisdom modifier', or neutralise a poison or disease) or for Cause Harm (a Con save at the universal DC, 'guardian level + Charisma modifier' necrotic damage).
items.repro: Features > Channel the Force.
items.expected: A radio choice (plus the Focus's extra effect at 3rd level), and Use buttons that spend a use and roll or show the numbers, on me or someone else. Lend Aid could also end Poisoned (W-062).
items.workarounds: A text note, and the counter changed with −.

verified.note: There's only the use counter (clsUsage) and the free-text notes box. Nothing models Lend Aid or Cause Harm: no choice, no Use, no healing or damage roll, no DC.

items.resolution: Channel the Force asks which effect you start with (Cause Harm or Lend Aid; saved in the feature's notes) and adds your form's effect. Each has a Use button that spends a use and gives the save DC and amount; Lend Aid offers Heal N on yourself.

items.title: Armstech modified weapon and its mods not shown where I attack
items.story: When I fire my Armstech-modified blaster, I want the attack row to show it's modified (mods, attunement), so that I remember what it can do mid-fight.
items.evidence: After choosing Blaster pistol with Celerity Oscillator and Expanded Magazine, the Weapons & Attacks row is unchanged ('Blaster pistol +4 1d6+2 Energy'). Attunement stays 0/2, although the rules say 'Your modified weapon is enhanced, requires attunement'. Jun praised the modification picker itself, with its inline prerequisites.
items.repro: Armstech 3 > Modified Weaponry: Blaster pistol + 2 mods. Open Weapons & Attacks and Equipment.
items.expected: 'Blaster pistol (modified · 2 mods)' with the mods' notes, and attunement counted.

verified.note: Modification bonuses do land on the modified weapon (featureEffectsUncached adds weapon mods by k.modifiedItems), but renderAttacks shows no 'modified · N mods' marker. Attunement is counted only from inventory items with `attuned` (completeWithEdits), so the modified weapon's 'requires attunement' isn't counted.

items.resolution: The modified weapon is marked 'modified' in Weapons & Attacks, with 'Modified Weaponry · attuned · 2 mods' opening the mods and what they do. A modified item that requires attunement counts toward attunement (shown under Attunement).

items.title: Infuse Item: Start with an item picker, ended by the next long rest
items.story: When I use Infuse Item at the end of a long rest, I want to pick the item and have the +1 applied until my next long rest, so that I don't have to remember it mid-fight.
items.evidence: There's only the tracker row 'Infuse Item long rest 1/1', the feature text and Notes. Effects > 'Infuse' gives 'No SW5E item with an effect matches.' A tweak ('Vibrodagger: attack/damage') would be permanent, and the vibrodagger isn't even listed in Weapons & Attacks (not equipped). Jun tapped − on the counter and the infusion was tracked nowhere.
items.repro: Engineer 2+, take a long rest, try to infuse the vibrodagger.
