items.expected: Start → a list of unenhanced armor, shields and weapons → +1 AC or +1 attack/damage under Effects until the next long rest. It spends the use.
items.workarounds: Tapped − on the counter and remembered it.

verified.note: Infuse Item has only the counter from clsUsage. There's no Start with an item picker and no long-rest-limited effect. Ending the effect on a long rest would also need a hook in applyTrackerAction('long'): effects aren't ended by rests today.

items.resolution: Infuse Item picks the armor, shield or weapon you carry: +1 AC, or +1 to attack and damage on that weapon (+2 at 10th, +3 at 15th), until the end of your next long rest; it spends the use.

items.title: Show the general lightsaber form rules next to Adopt
items.story: When I adopt a lightsaber form, I want to see the general form rules (action type, duration, weapon needed), so that I can check that Adopt follows them.
items.evidence: The form card only shows the form's own effect. The general rules aren't on the sheet, and sw5e.com/rules/phb/customization/lightsaberForms and /characters/lightsaberForms showed nothing.
items.repro: Feats > Lightsaber form > Soresu Form.
items.expected: A short 'Lightsaber forms' rules text, or a link, next to the picker and Adopt.

verified.note: Only the form's own text is shown. The general form rules aren't in the dumped Customization chapter (dev/dumps/phb), so they'd need a hand-written note or a link. chFormState's comment ('adopted… by using your bonus action') is the only trace in the code.

items.resolution: Form cards (next to Adopt) and the form pickers have 'Form rules': adopted on your turn as a bonus action, replaces the form you were in, lasts as its text says, each form chosen once, forcecasters only, no particular weapon in the general rules (PHB chapter 6).

items.title: Feature note boxes are one-line inputs that cut off text
items.story: When I keep notes in a feature's box (e.g. my foretelling rolls and how I used them), I want it to wrap or grow, so that I can read it back on the card.
items.evidence: 'Foretelling rolls: none left (11 used on boss save, 13 on my concentration save)' shows as 'Foretelling rolls: none left (11 used on boss s…' on the Force Visions card.
items.repro: Type a long note into any feature's 'Your choices' box.
items.expected: A textarea that wraps, or the full text shown on the card.

verified.note: Notes exist but are single-line <input> elements (feat-note, cls-note), so long text is cut off. A textarea that grows, or showing the full note in the card text, fixes it.

items.resolution: Feature note boxes are text areas that grow with their text (up to 12 lines).

items.title: Form Basics picker labels: doubled words and a suffix that reads like an unmet prerequisite
items.story: When I pick the second form from Form Basics, I want clear labels, so that I don't think I'm missing a prerequisite.
items.evidence: The picker shows 'Lightsaber form 0/1 · Soresu Form Form Basics' and 'You already knew Soresu Form (Feat: Formfighting Dabbler (Background (Jedi))): choose another…'. Every option says '(only if you already know the feature's form)', even though the sheet just said she does.
items.repro: Pick the Soresu Form archetype on a character who has Formfighting Dabbler → Soresu.
items.expected: 'Soresu Form — Form Basics'. Show the condition only when it isn't met.

verified.note: from = `${sourceName} ${name}` gives 'Soresu Form Form Basics'. The hint embeds the nested feat source ('Feat: Formfighting Dabbler (Background (Jedi))'). renderSlot tags every option outside s.allowed with '(only if you already know the feature's form)' even when insteadAny is already met. Fix: check whether the allowed form is known before adding the tag, and use a separator in from.

items.resolution: Slots name their source 'Soresu Form: Form Basics'; the hint names the source without the nesting ('from Feat: Formfighting Dabbler'); the '(only if you already know…)' tag is left off once the hint says you do.

items.title: Archetype list and form list name the lightsaber forms differently
items.story: When I compare the Archetype dropdown with the lightsaber form list, I want to understand why there are 'Shien/Djem So Form' and separate 'Shien Form' and 'Djem So Form', so that I pick the right one.
items.evidence: The Archetype dropdown has Juyo/Vaapad Form, Shien/Djem So Form and Vonil/Ishu Form. The Form Basics list has 19 separate forms (Djem So, Shien, Juyo, Vaapad, Ishu, Vonil, Bakuuni Hand, Drallig, Trispzest, Twilight…). This comes from SW5E's data, but nothing explains it.
items.repro: Compare Classes & Progression > Archetype with the Form Basics list.
items.expected: A note explaining archetypes vs the forms from chapter 6.

verified.note: Both lists come straight from SW5E's data: archetypes module vs lightsaberForms module. Nothing explains that combined-name archetypes (Shien/Djem So Form) differ from the individual forms. A one-line note is enough.

items.resolution: The Guardian's archetype picker explains that the '… Form' archetypes are guardian paths with their own features, and the lightsaber forms you adopt (chapter 6) are separate picks.

items.title: Archetype list has deprecated near-duplicate entries
items.story: When I choose my archetype on a phone, I want one entry per archetype, so that I don't have to guess between 'Cybertech Engineering', '(Depreciated)' and '(Old)'.
items.evidence: Engineer Archetype dropdown: … Cybertech Engineering, Cybertech Engineering (Depreciated), Cybertech Engineering (Old), Astrotech Engineering, Astrotech Engineering (Companion) … A phone player can't tell three near-identical names apart.
items.repro: Engineer → Classes & Progression → Archetype.
items.expected: Hide deprecated and old variants, or label them ('older rules, don't pick').

verified.note: chClassInfo lists every archetype of the class from SW5E's data, sorted, with no filtering, so 'Cybertech Engineering (Depreciated)' and '(Old)' appear (the data does contain these names). Options: hide deprecated or old variants unless the character already has one; label them '(older rules)' and sort them last; or keep them as is.

items.resolution: Older versions ('(Depreciated)', '(Old)') are kept, sorted last and labelled '— older rules'.

items.title: Archetype can be picked before 3rd level
items.story: When I'm level 2, I want the Archetype select locked or labelled 'from 3rd level', so that I don't pick it early by mistake.
items.evidence: At Berserker 2, Classes & Progression shows 'Archetype — none —' with 15 approaches, all selectable. The Berserker Approach comes at 3rd level.
items.repro: Berserker 2 → Classes & Progression → Archetype.
items.expected: Disabled with '(3rd level)', like the greyed-out higher-level instincts.

verified.note: The Archetype select offers every archetype at any level, with no disabled state. Option lists, by contrast, disable options with minLevel above the level. The archetype level is in each class's table Features column ('Berserker Approach' at 3rd), so it can be gated the same way.

items.resolution: The Archetype list is disabled ('— at 3rd level —') before the level the class table names, unless one is already set.

items.title: Maneuver with an unmet prerequisite added without a warning on its row
items.story: When a maneuver I add needs another maneuver, I want its row flagged, so that I don't keep an illegal pick.
items.evidence: 'Parry (Improved) (needs Parry maneuver)' was added (by the type-ahead bug, W-027) without Parry known. Tomas saw no warning on the row, only the red '3 / 1' count. He removed it quickly, so a warning may have appeared later.
items.repro: Add 'Parry (Improved)' without Parry.
items.expected: 'Needs Parry' shown on the row, as the README describes for prerequisites.

verified.note: Class maneuvers get only a count (chClassInfo returns max, sources and chosen). No problems are computed and maneuverBlock shows none: the prerequisite appears only as a faint 'Prerequisite:' line inside the pick's details. Slot maneuvers do get 'X needs the Y maneuver' (choiceSlots problems), so reuse that check for class maneuvers.

items.resolution: A class maneuver whose 'X maneuver' prerequisite isn't known shows 'needs X' on its row.

items.title: Power cards don't roll their damage or healing
items.story: When I cast Turbulence, Heal, Force Throw or Ion Blast, I want the card to roll its dice with my casting modifier and the chosen level (Heal at 2nd = 2d8+4; cantrip scaling), show the save DC or attack with the result, and offer 'Heal N' for healing on myself, so that powers are as quick as weapons.
items.evidence: Mira: Turbulence ('take 1d6 force damage') has no Cast and no roll; she typed '1d6' and got 1. Heal: Cast gives 'Cast Heal at 1st level (2 force points).' and no roll. She typed '1d8+4' → 11, but a typed roll has no Heal button (unlike the medpac's roll), so she typed 11 into the tracker as well. Force Throw's '2d8' isn't rollable either. Jun: the Ion Blast card shows 'Dexterity save DC 14' and '…or take 1d4 ion damage' with no roll button, and Electroshock only 'Attack +6'; he typed '1d4' → 2. Weapons, by contrast, are rollable.
items.repro: Open Force/Tech casting and try to roll Turbulence damage, Heal healing or Ion Blast damage from the card.
items.expected: A damage or healing roll from the card: dice taken from the text, the casting modifier, extra dice for higher levels, cantrip scaling at 5th/11th/17th. An attack roll for attack powers. 'Dex save DC 14' shown with the damage. A 'Heal N' button on healing for myself.
items.workarounds: Typed formulas in the dice dock and the results into the tracker.

verified.note: Power cards roll only the attack (when the text says force/tech attack) and print the save DC (powerRoll). Damage and healing dice aren't parsed, nothing scales with level or cantrip tier, and powers.js has no damage handling. A typed roll in the dock gets no Heal button: applyButtons handles only hitdie, supdie, itemheal and death.

items.resolution: Power cards show their damage, healing or damage reduction as a roll ('Damage 1d6 force', 'Healing 1d8+5'), at the level cast (Force Potency, Overcharge Tech) and with at-will damage growing at 5th, 11th and 17th level. Cast offers the roll at the level chosen; a healing roll has Heal N (on me), capped at what you're missing.

items.title: Self-buff powers don't ask for a target or apply their effects (Heroism, Battle Precognition)
items.story: When I cast a buff such as Heroism or Battle Precognition, I want the sheet to ask 'on me or someone else' and, on me, apply its numbers while it lasts (AC formula, temp HP at the start of each turn, immunities) and list its benefits under Effects, so that I don't fake them with permanent tweaks or type temp HP every turn.
items.evidence: Heroism: Cast gives 'Cast Heroism at 1st level (2 force points). Concentrating.', and Effects says only 'Heroism (concentration) cast, lasts up to 1 minute, since Sat 12:34 · Concentrating on Heroism.' It never asks for a target, and the frightened immunity and 'temporary hit points equal to your forcecasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns' aren't mentioned. Mira typed Temp HP 4 by hand in part A and again in part B rounds 2–3; Priya typed 3 every turn. Battle Precognition (Mira-B5): FP went 16 → 14 and an Effects entry appeared, but AC stayed 12. The rule says 'your base AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier', which is 15 without armor. Battle Meditation's '+d4 to attack rolls and saving throws' isn't offered in the roller either (W-095).
items.repro: Cast Heroism, or Battle Precognition with no armor, and look at Effects, AC and temp HP.
items.expected: A me/someone else choice. On me, the effect carries its numbers like a stim does: AC 15 while it's active; a '+4 temp HP' button or prompt at the start of my turn; the immunity under defenses. Temp HP from the power are removed when it ends.
items.workarounds: Typed temp HP every turn. Mira added a permanent 'AC set to 15' tweak, which would have synced, and removed it by hand after the long rest.

verified.note: castPower starts a concentration effect with `mods: []` and the note 'Concentrating on X', or a duration reminder with `mods: []` (Battle Precognition). There's no target choice and no numbers: no AC formula, no per-turn temp HP, no immunity. effects.js parses 'AC becomes 13 + Dex' for items only (parseItemEffect), not powers. It needs a power-effects parser and a me/someone else choice.

items.resolution: A power whose benefits are yours applies them while it lasts: Battle Precognition's AC 13 + Dex as an unarmored AC formula, Saber Ward's resistance, Target Lock's and Battle Meditation's dice. One that helps its target (Heroism, Guidance) asks 'It's on me: apply it'. Heroism then makes you immune to being frightened, and its temporary hit points are offered at once and each round.

items.title: Cast doesn't offer Force-Empowered Casting options (Quickened, Twinned) or count their points
items.story: When I cast a power, I want to add one of my Force-Empowered Casting options with its cost, so that the force points spent are right without extra '−' clicks.
items.evidence: The Heroism and Heal level selects only offer '1st level · 2 points | 2nd level · 3 points'. The Force Casting section never mentions Twinned or Quickened (checked in its text: twinned:false, quickened:false). For Quickened Heroism and Quickened Heal, Cast spent 2 points each and Mira pressed Force points '−' twice more each time (14 → 12 → 10, 8 → 6). Those '−' presses also wiped her HP Undo (W-058).
items.repro: Learn Quickened Power in Classes & Progression, then Cast any power that takes an action.
items.expected: A Force-Empowered Casting choice on Cast, listing only the options I've learned, one per power. Its cost is added (Quickened +2, Twinned +the power's level or +1 for an at-will), and the toast names it ('Cast Heroism, Quickened: 4 force points').
items.workarounds: Spent the extra points with the tracker's '−'.

verified.note: Cast offers only the level and its cost (pwCost). Force-Empowered Casting picks (k.options) are never consulted when casting, so the extra points are spent by hand. Those '−' presses also clear Undo (W-058).

items.resolution: The Force-Empowered Casting options you know are a select next to Cast, with their cost (Quickened +2, Twinned +the power's level). The cast spends the points on top and says so; an at-will or once-per-rest cast pays only the option.

items.title: Saber Ward and Saber Reflect have no Cast / Use
items.story: When I use an at-will defensive power, I want a Cast or Use button, so that its resistance or damage reduction is tracked like other powers.
items.evidence: Guidance, Heal and Heroism have Cast. Saber Ward ('Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against kinetic, energy, and ion damage dealt by weapons') and Saber Reflect (a reaction with a '1d6' reduction and 'Attack +5') have none.
items.repro: Force section > At-will powers.
items.expected: Saber Ward > Cast puts the resistance under Defenses until the end of my next turn. Saber Reflect > Use rolls 1d6 and offers the +5 reflect attack.

verified.note: At-will powers get a Cast button only if they need concentration (Guidance). Saber Ward and Saber Reflect are at-will without concentration, so castControls returns nothing. A Use that starts a timed resistance effect (defenses) and rolls Saber Reflect's 1d6 is needed. Open decisions also list 'Soresu's saber ward' as staying text.

items.resolution: At-will powers that last a while or roll something have Cast: Saber Ward applies its resistance for its round, Saber Reflect offers its 1d6 reduction roll.

items.title: A feat's power (Techie's Repair Droid) shows as two cards with empty pickers
items.story: When a feat gives me a fixed power that I can also cast once for free, I want one card with 'Cast (2 points)' and 'Free cast 1/1' and no empty picker under it, so that I don't think I have another power to choose and the phone list stays short.
items.evidence: Feats → 'Choices from your feats' shows 'Power given 1/1 · Repair Droid from the feature · [Choose a tech power…]' and 'Power given, once per long rest (once per long rest) 1/1 · Repair Droid · [Choose a tech power…]' ('once per long rest' twice). Tech casting lists two cards: 'Repair Droid · Feat: Techie · 1st level · 2 points [Cast]' and 'Repair Droid · Once per long rest · cast only · [Cast at 1st level (available)]'.
items.repro: Load a Techie character and open Feats and Tech casting.
items.expected: No picker when the count is full. One merged card.

verified.note: Techie's text produces two given slots: 'Power given' and 'Power given, once per long rest'. renderSlot adds ' (once per long rest)' to a title that already says it, and it shows the select because `full` counts only non-auto picks, so given (auto) picks never fill a slot. knownPowers adds one card per mode (points and once), giving two cards. Fix: count auto picks toward full, and merge the cards by power name.

items.resolution: A power the feature gives leaves no picker and the title says 'once per long rest' once; Force/Tech Casting shows one card per power with each way to cast it.

items.title: Known powers listed in the order they were learned
items.story: When I read my known powers in the Classes card, I want them sorted by level and name, so that I can check them against the table quickly.
items.evidence: The list reads Heal, Heroism, Saber Reflect, Saber Ward, Guidance, Force Leap, Force Jump, Saber Throw, Sanctuary, Burst of Speed (the order she learned them).
items.repro: Learn several powers over two levels and open the Classes card.
items.expected: At-will powers first, then 1st level, alphabetical within each.

verified.note: The class-card list renders `chosen` in stored (learned) order. The Force/Tech Casting section already sorts by level and name (renderCasting), so applying the same sort to the class card is a one-liner.

items.resolution: The class card lists known powers at-will first, then by level, alphabetical within each.

items.title: Damage has no type, so resistances and damage reductions never apply
items.story: When I take typed damage (kinetic, energy, poison…, sometimes split, like 8 energy + 5 poison), I want to enter the type, and whether it came from a weapon, for each part, so that active resistances, immunities and one-time reductions apply automatically and the toast explains it ('8 energy → 4 (Rage), 5 poison → 2 (Dewback's)').
items.evidence:
The play tracker has only Amount + Damage / Heal / Temp HP.
- Sam, raging (Defenses: 'Resistance to kinetic and energy damage'): 6 damage → HP 8/14 ('Undo: Took 6 damage'); it should have been 3. In part B, with Rage plus Dewback's (poison, acid, fire), he halved 8 energy → 4, 5 poison → 2 and the crit 18 → 9 by hand.
- Priya, with Soresu Form active ('…that damage is reduced by half'): 6 damage took HP 12 → 6. She pressed Undo and typed 3. Soresu stayed 'Active' after its one-time benefit was used. In part B, in The Way of the Mynock, she halved 8 → 4 and 18 → 9 by hand (W-070).
- Mira's Kel Dor necrotic resistance can never apply (it isn't shown either, W-141).
- Tomas and Jun entered their 13- and 6-point hits untyped.
Priya and Sam rated it high, the others medium or low.
items.repro: Start Rage (or adopt Soresu Form), type 6, press Damage.
items.expected: An optional damage type for each entry, and several entries per hit. Resistance halves, immunity zeroes, vulnerability doubles, and one-time reductions are used up. A note in the toast says what was applied.
items.workarounds: Undo and retype, or do the maths before typing.

verified.note: The tracker takes a bare amount. defensesOf knows resistances (Rage's kinetic/energy, Dewback's, forms), but nothing applies them, and one-time reductions (Soresu) aren't consumed. It needs a typed, multi-part damage entry, resolution against active defenses, and a toast explaining it. W-072 must be fixed so Dewback's types are known.

items.resolution: The tracker's damage has a type; resistance, immunity and vulnerability apply when the character's defenses name it, conditional ones are mentioned (decision 43).

items.title: No concentration save prompt when taking damage while concentrating (War Caster's advantage unknown)
items.story: When I take damage while concentrating, I want the sheet to offer the Constitution save at DC max(10, half the damage), with advantage pre-selected if I have War Caster, and to end the power on a failure, so that I never forget concentration.
items.evidence:
Mira: with Heroism active, 6 damage took HP 7 → 1 with no prompt; she rolled the save herself (20 + 1 = 21). Jun: with Target Lock active, 6 damage → 4/10, no prompt. He scrolled to Abilities, rolled 7 vs DC 10 (failed), then went chip → Effects → End. Priya: 6 and 4 damage, no prompt. She rolled 21 and then 6 (failed) and ended Heroism by hand; the roller doesn't know a DC, so it can't say pass or fail.

Part B (Mira): still no prompt after 13 or 18 damage. With War Caster ('advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration'), the CON save dock still pre-selects 'Normal'. No '(concentration)' alternative shows on the save, and Combat & Vitals has no Defenses entry for it.

The rule: 'Whenever you take damage while you are concentrating, you must make a Constitution saving throw… DC equals 10 or half the damage you take, whichever number is higher.'
items.repro: Cast a concentration power, then enter damage in the tracker.
items.expected: A dock or toast: 'Concentration save DC 10 (Con +1) [Roll]', with War Caster's advantage pre-selected. A failure ends the power ('Target Lock ended'); a success keeps it. The CON save row shows 'adv. to keep concentration (War Caster)'.
items.workarounds: Rolled the CON save from Abilities, compared it with the DC by hand, and ended the effect from Effects.

verified.note: This is the documented decision 10: 'Concentration… damage doesn't end it.' No save prompt or DC exists. War Caster's 'advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration' isn't captured either: clsFeatureEffects' advantage regexes exclude 'that…' clauses, so the roller preset (startRoll) stays Normal.

items.resolution: Damage while concentrating offers the Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage) with War Caster's advantage; a failure offers to end the power (decision 44).

items.title: Round / turn counter: durations in rounds, start-of-turn effects, once-per-turn resets
items.story: When I fight, I want a round counter or a 'start of my turn' button that counts durations in rounds, applies start-of-turn effects (Heroism's temp HP), resets once-per-turn features (Weapon Expert, Sneak Attack) and ends marks and states that run out, so that '1 minute' means 10 rounds instead of a wall-clock time.
items.evidence: Effects show durations as clock times, which mean nothing in combat: 'lasts up to 1 minute, since Sat 12:34' (Mira), 'Rage · Melee STR damage +2 · started, lasts 1 minute, since Sat 15:23' (Sam). Heroism's per-turn temp HP is manual (Mira). Tomas tracked once-per-turn features (Weapon Expert) and his Sharpshooter mark in his head. Sam, a new player, didn't know when Rage ends, or that it ends early if he neither attacks nor takes damage.
items.repro: Cast Heroism or Start Rage and play several rounds.
items.expected: A round counter with 'Next round' / 'Start of my turn', durations like '10 rounds left', and reminders.
items.workarounds: Head and paper. Ended Rage by hand after the fight.

verified.note: There's no notion of rounds or turns. Effects store startedAt and a duration text and end only with End. Decision 10 says forms must be ended by hand. A round counter would let durations, per-turn temp HP, once-per-turn reminders and form expiry work.

items.resolution: Combat → Start counts rounds; Next round ends the effects that have run out (turns, minutes); End combat (decision 45). Once-per-turn uses aren't tracked.

items.title: Second Heart (Zabrak) has no counter and isn't offered at 0 HP
items.story: When I drop to 0 HP as a Zabrak, I want the sheet to offer 'Use Second Heart: drop to 1 HP instead (1/long rest)' and track the use, so that I don't need Notes or a fake heal.
items.evidence: 13 damage at 8 HP gave 'HP 0/14, 0 HP: roll death saves' and the status 'Down to 0 hit points: roll death saves (Death saves → Roll).' Second Heart isn't mentioned and has no tracker counter. Long rest says only 'Long rest: done.'
items.repro: Zabrak at 8/14 HP: Amount 13 > Damage.
items.expected: A 'Second Heart 1/1 (long rest)' counter, and a prompt on dropping to 0 that sets HP to 1 and spends the use.
items.workarounds: Heal 1, with the use noted in Notes.

verified.note: Species traits are explicitly skipped when building use counters, so Second Heart ('You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest') gets none. Dropping to 0 offers nothing. Adding species traits to featureUses is S; the 0 HP prompt adds the rest.

items.resolution: Species traits with uses get counters (Second Heart: 1, long rest), and at 0 HP 'Use Second Heart: 1 HP instead' is offered (decision 46).

items.title: Second Wind: a Use button that rolls 1d10 + level and heals
items.story: When I use Second Wind, I want one click to spend the use, roll 1d10 + my fighter level and heal me, as the medpac does, so that the bonus action takes seconds.
items.evidence: The tracker row 'Second Wind 1/1 short rest' and the Class Features card have only −/+, with no roll and no heal. A typed '1d10+1' roll in the dock (7 + 1 = 8) has no Heal button, so he healed 8 by hand.
items.repro: At 1/14 HP, try to use Second Wind from the tracker or the card.
items.expected: Second Wind > roll 1d10+1 > 'Heal 8' > use spent.
items.workarounds: − on the card, '1d10+1' in the dice dock, then Amount 8 > Heal in the tracker.

verified.note: Second Wind has a counter (clsUsage) but no roll. roller.js supports a 'Heal N' apply for itemheal; a 'feature heal' spec (1d10 + fighter level) that spends the use and heals would follow the same pattern.

items.resolution: Healing features ('regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level') get 'roll 1d10 + 3, then Heal' on their counter (tracker and card); the roller's 'Heal N and spend Second Wind' heals and marks the use.

items.title: Start / End buttons for states (Rage, lightsaber forms) in the play tracker
items.story: When combat starts, I want Start/Adopt/End buttons for my states next to their counters in Combat & Vitals, so that I don't scroll to Class Features or Feats mid-fight.
items.evidence: Sam: the tracker's Rage row only has '●● 2/2 − +'; 'Start Rage' is in Class Features → Rage card, so he had to scroll. Priya: 'Adopt Soresu Form' is under Features > Lightsaber forms, below the long Forcecasting text, and took several scrolls on the tablet. The 🔍 filter ('Soresu') was the fast way.
items.repro: Combat & Vitals → look for Start Rage or Adopt next to the tracker.
items.expected: The available states (forms, Rage…) with Start/Adopt/End next to their counters in Combat & Vitals or Effects.
items.workarounds: Scrolled to the card, or used the 🔍 filter.

verified.note: Start, Adopt and End come from stateControls, which is rendered only inside feature cards. The tracker rows (counterRow) have no state buttons. stateControls can be reused next to the matching counter.

items.resolution: The play tracker has a 'Start or end' row with every state's Start/Adopt/End button (Rage, forms, Force Shield…).

items.title: Status after Damage/Heal keeps old errors and death-save messages
items.story: When I apply damage or healing, I want the status to show that action's result ('Took 6 damage → 8/14', 'Healed 6: conscious, death saves reset'), so that an old error or death-save toast doesn't make me think it failed.
items.evidence: Tomas: the red 'Type the amount first, then press Damage.' stayed after the next, successful damage (HP 8/14). 'Type the amount first, then press Heal.' stayed after a successful heal ('Undo: Healed 5 (of 6; at maximum)'). 'Down to 0 hit points: roll death saves' stayed after he was back at 1 and then 9 HP. Mira: after Heal 6 from 0 HP (death saves 0✓ 1✗), HP was 6/7 and the circles were cleared, but the toast still read 'Death saves: 0 ✓, 1 ✗.'
items.repro: Press Damage with an empty Amount, then type 6 and press Damage. Or heal from 0 HP after a failed death save.
items.expected: Each Damage/Heal replaces the status with its own result.

verified.note: A successful damage or heal calls setStatus only in two cases: three failures, or dropping to 0. Otherwise the old status ('Type the amount first…', death-save text from roller.js:applyRoll) stays in the top bar, since setStatus only removes the 'fresh' class. Fix: always set a result status (or clear it).

items.resolution: Every Damage/Heal/Temp HP sets its own result ('Took 6 damage. HP 8/14.'), replacing an old error or death-save message.

items.title: Massive-damage death: clearer 'Dead' state and a 'GM says drop to 0' option
items.story: When the sheet rules me dead from massive damage, I want the HP card to say 'Dead' and the toast to offer 'Just drop to 0 (GM ruling)', so that I don't clear three death-save circles by hand and lose Undo.
items.evidence: At HP 1 + 4 temp, a 13-damage crit gave the toast 'Three failed death saves (damage at least your hit point maximum kills outright).', three ✗ and the chip 'Death saves 0✓ 3✗'. The HP card still said '0 HP: roll death saves'. Clearing the three circles one by one removed the 'Undo: Took 13 damage' button.
items.repro: At 1 HP with a maximum of 7, enter 13 damage.
items.expected: 'Dead (massive damage)' on the HP card, and a 'GM ruling: drop to 0' option that keeps Undo.
items.workarounds: Clicked each red death-save circle to clear it.

verified.note: LIVE.hp prints '0 HP: roll death saves' whenever HP is 0, even with three failures. Each death-save dot click goes through applyTrackerAction('ds'), which returns null, and trackerAction then sets state.undo = null. So clearing the circles drops the 'Took 13 damage' undo. A 'GM ruling: drop to 0' action that keeps the undo is missing.

items.resolution: After three failures the HP card says 'Dead (three failed death saves)' with 'GM ruling: at 0 HP instead', which clears the failures and can be undone; counter changes no longer drop the damage's Undo (W-058).

items.title: Typing in the tracker's Amount box is lost while the dice dock is open
items.story: When the dice dock is open and I type damage in the play tracker, I want the number to land in Amount, so that I don't get 'Type the amount first'.
items.evidence: With the dock open (after Lore and Animal Handling rolls), he clicked Amount and typed '6'. The box stayed empty, and Damage/Heal said 'Type the amount first, then press Damage/Heal.' This happened twice. With the dock closed, it worked.
items.repro: Open any roll in the dock, click the tracker's Amount box, type 6 and press Damage.
items.expected: The keystrokes go to the Amount box.

verified.note: Nothing in the code takes keystrokes from #trackAmount: roller.js keydown only handles Enter, Space and Escape. The likely cause is layout. The dock is fixed bottom-right, up to 400 px wide and nearly viewport-tall, z-index 40, so a click 'on' Amount can land on the dock (or its Modifier or free-roll input) when the tracker sits under it. To check: document.activeElement after clicking, and whether #trackAmount's rect intersects #dice.

items.resolution: Not reproducible now: Amount takes typing with the dock open, after a check or an attack. The likely trigger, a misclick through the dock's moving ✕, was fixed (the dock only grows while open). The dock also never takes the focus from a box being typed in outside it.

items.title: A counter change wipes the HP Undo
items.story: When I adjust a counter right after healing, I want Undo to still cover my last HP action (or the counter change too), so that a slip is fixable.
items.evidence: After Heal 11 the 'Undo' button was there. Pressing Force points '−' twice (for Quickened, W-045) made it disappear, and the FP change itself couldn't be undone.
items.repro: Heal any amount, then press Force points '−'.
items.expected: Undo keeps the last HP action, or also undoes counter changes.

verified.note: Counter ops (force, tech, sup, hd, feat, ds, exh, insp) return no label from applyTrackerAction, and trackerAction then sets state.undo = null. Any '−' wipes the HP undo, and the counter change itself can't be undone. Fix: keep the previous undo when the label is null, or label counter changes.

items.resolution: Undo is a stack (last ten actions per character), and counters, Inspiration, exhaustion and death-save dots are undoable steps with their own labels.

items.title: Undo offers an old action after a reload or unrelated changes
items.story: When I see Undo, I want it to be clear what it undoes and when it happened, so that I don't undo something old after a reload.
items.evidence: 'Undo: Took 4 damage' was still offered after Load from SW5E, a credits change and adding items.
items.repro: Take damage, make other changes and Load from SW5E, then look at the tracker.
items.expected: Clear Undo after unrelated changes or a reload, or say when the action happened.

verified.note: Undo restores only the play-state snapshot taken before that damage. Loads, credits and inventory changes don't touch play state (trackers are stored separately), so undoing it is still correct. state.undo lives in memory and is cleared by a page reload and by a sync. Optional polish (S): show when it happened.

items.title: Force point pips disappear at higher totals
items.story: When I glance at the tracker in a fight, I want force points shown as pips or a bar at any total, so that I see at a glance how much I've spent.
items.evidence: Force points showed 8 and 12 pips at levels 1–2. At 16/16 and 20/20 (levels 3–4) the row shows only '16 / 16', while hit dice still show pips.
items.repro: Look at the Force points row with 16 or more max FP.
items.expected: A compact bar or pips at any total.

verified.note: Pips are drawn only for pools of 12 or fewer by design, so 16 or 20 FP show just numbers. A compact bar for larger pools is a small CSS and markup change.

items.resolution: Counters over 12 (16 or 20 force points, 13 tech points) show a bar of what's left.

items.title: Inspiration and Exhaustion buttons have no explanation
items.story: When the GM gives me Inspiration or exhaustion, I want a one-line explanation on the button or counter, so that a new player knows what it does.
items.evidence: The '☆ Inspiration' / '★ Inspired' button has no title or tooltip, and the Exhaustion '− 0 +' counter has no level text. Sam had to ask the GM.
items.repro: Hover Inspiration or Exhaustion in the play tracker.
items.expected: 'Spend it for advantage on one attack, save or check', and each exhaustion level's effect (see W-063).

verified.note: The Inspiration button and the Exhaustion −/+ counter have no title or explanation. The exhaustion level table is in refs.conditions (SW5E data), so a tooltip per level is easy.

items.resolution: Inspiration's button says what it does and where to spend it; exhaustion has a tooltip with all six levels and a note with what the current level does.

items.title: Can't set conditions (Poisoned, Prone…) in the sheet
items.story: When the boss poisons me (or I'm prone, frightened, restrained…), I want to add the condition with a duration in the sheet, see it as a chip with its rule text in the summary and phone strip, have the roller apply it, and end it with End or when it runs out, so that I don't need sw5e.com or a second device mid-fight.
items.evidence:
Conditions shows 'None active (from SW5E)' with no add control; renderCombat in viewer.js only reads conditions from sw5e.com. 'Add an effect someone gave you…' with 'Poisoned' gives 'No SW5E item with an effect matches.' Typing 'Poison' lists only the weapon-coating items (Poison, Poison (Average), (Deadly)…). Their text is 'A creature hit by the poisoned weapon must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw…', not the condition. Tomas and Priya added the Poison item as a stand-in.

Jun, the phone-only player, had to go to the sw5e.com tab → CONDITIONS → Poisoned → CLOSE, then on the phone scroll to the top → More ▾ → Load from SW5E. After the fight he did the reverse: two devices and two loads for one fight.

The sheet already has SW5E's text ('A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.'), but the attack dock opened on 'Normal' for everyone (W-099). Unconscious at 0 HP is tracked in W-064.
items.repro: Combat & Vitals → Conditions / Effects → try to add Poisoned.
items.expected: A condition picker (Poisoned, Prone, Frightened, Restrained…) with a duration and End. Chips in the summary and phone strip (W-122). Disadvantage pre-selected in the dock, the way advantage is for Rage. Removable by features like Lend Aid.
items.workarounds: A stand-in Poison item effect, Jun's sw5e.com conditions + Load, and Disadvantage picked by hand.

verified.note: Conditions are read only from SW5E's computed c.conditions ('None active (from SW5E)'). 'Add an effect' searches only catalog items with effects, so 'Poisoned' finds weapon poisons. The condition texts are in refs.conditions and the rules conditions module. It needs a picker with duration, chips in renderSideSummary and renderMiniVitals, roller presets (startRoll's `fits` handles only advantage today) and End.

items.resolution: Conditions are set in the play tracker (SW5E's own currentStats.conditions, which it lists and Sync sends), each with what it does; Unconscious at 0 HP (decision 42).

items.title: Exhaustion levels have no explanation and no effect on rolls, speed or HP
items.story: When I gain exhaustion, I want each level's effect shown next to the counter and in the strip, and applied (level 1 disadvantage on ability checks, slower speed at 2, disadvantage on attacks and saves at 3, HP max halved at 4…), so that I play it right.
items.evidence:
Exhaustion '+' → 1 gives an orange 'Exhaustion 1' chip, but there's no chip in the tablet strip (Priya) and nothing at all in Jun's phone view. The only explanation anywhere is the Long rest tooltip '…exhaustion −1'. For all five, the next Perception or Athletics check opened on 'Normal'. At exhaustion 2, Speed stayed 40 ft (Sam).

The sheet has SW5E's table from sw5e.com: '|1|Disadvantage on ability checks| |2|Speed halved| |3|Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws| |4|Hit point maximum halved|…'. Sam quotes sw5e.com/rules/phb/conditions as '2 one slowed level … 5 four slowed levels, 6 death', so check which table applies. The code keeps exhaustion as a counter only (Priya). Priya rated it high, the others medium.
items.repro: Exhaustion + → open any skill roll.
items.expected: Each level's effect shown (chip hover, counter text) and applied: disadvantage pre-selected with a note, speed reduced, HP max halved.

verified.note: Exhaustion is only a counter (0–6, −1 on a long rest). Nothing applies it to rolls, speed or HP. renderMiniVitals (the phone strip) doesn't show it; only the desktop sidebar chip does. SW5E's own data (rules conditions 'Exhaustion') holds the classic table (1 disadvantage on checks, 2 speed halved, 3 disadvantage on attacks/saves, 4 HP max halved, 5 speed 0, 6 death), not the 'slowed' wording Sam quoted. Confirm which table the owner wants.

items.resolution: Exhaustion: each level explained, disadvantage applied by the roller, speed shown halved (2) or 0 (5). The halved HP maximum (4) is described, not applied.

items.title: Dropping to 0 HP doesn't end concentration or set Unconscious
items.story: When I drop to 0 HP, I want my concentration power to end and the Unconscious (and Prone) condition shown until I'm healed, so that the sheet and the table agree on my state.
items.evidence: Mira: at 0/7 HP, Effects still listed 'Heroism (concentration)', the summary chip stayed, and Conditions said 'None active (from SW5E)'. Jun: with Target Lock active, 13 damage → 0/10 and 'Down to 0 hit points: roll death saves'. The '● Target Lock' chip and Effects entry stayed through the death save and both heals.
items.repro: Cast a concentration power, then take damage down to 0 HP.
items.expected: At 0 HP, concentration ends with a toast ('Target Lock ended: you're unconscious'), and Unconscious (and Prone) is set until healed.

verified.note: Damage changes only HP and death saves. Concentration effects (group 'concentration') are never ended, per decision 10. Ending concentration at 0 HP is S. Showing Unconscious and Prone depends on conditions (W-062).

items.resolution: Dropping to 0 HP ends concentration and Rage (undoable) and says so.

items.title: Frenzy (Frenzied Approach) is text only: no option on Start Rage, no free-use or exhaustion tracking
items.story: When I rage as a Frenzied Berserker, I want 'Start Rage · with Frenzy' that tracks that the first frenzy per long rest is free and later ones cost 1 exhaustion when the rage ends, so that I don't forget the cost or the bonus-action attack.
items.evidence: The Frenzy card has the rule text and an empty Notes box only. The Rage card has a single 'Start Rage (lasts 1 minute)'. There's no counter, no prompt, and no exhaustion when the rage ends.
items.repro: Pick the Frenzied Approach, then Start Rage.
items.expected: A Frenzy choice on Start Rage. A 'free frenzy used' marker that a long rest resets. +1 exhaustion when a later frenzied rage ends. A reminder of the bonus-action attack each turn. (The long-rest exhaustion −2 is W-118.)

verified.note: Frenzy has no state option, free-use marker or exhaustion on rage end. Its long-rest rule ('reduce your exhaustion level by 2') isn't applied either: applyTrackerAction('long') always does −1.

items.resolution: With Frenzied Approach, Rage has 'Rage with Frenzy' next to Start: free the first time after a long rest, then '+1 exhaustion', added when the rage ends. A long rest resets the count.

items.title: A permanent tweak is labelled '(temporary)' in the ability breakdown
items.story: When I read where a number comes from, I want my permanent tweaks labelled as tweaks, not '(temporary)', so that I trust they'll stay.
items.evidence:
Each player's feat tweak is labelled '(temporary)':
- WIS: 'base 15 · +2 from species/ASIs/feats/tweaks · +1 from Empathic feat: +1 Wisdom, not applied by SW5E (temporary)'. Mira's tweak was even synced to sw5e.com.
- DEX: '… +1 from Weapon Expert feat: +1 Dexterity (builder has no choice for it) (temporary)' (Tomas).
- INT: '… +1 from Techie feat: Int +1 (SW5E doesn't apply it) (temporary)' (Jun).
- WIS: '… +1 from Formfighting Dabbler (Jedi background feat): +1 to an ability of my choice (temporary)' (Priya).
items.repro: Add an ability-score bonus tweak with a reason, then read that ability's breakdown.
items.expected: '(tweak)' or no label. '(temporary)' only for real temporary effects.

verified.note: Every non-item effect, tweaks and class features included, is labelled '(temporary)'. Fix: label by kind (tweak → '(tweak)', feature → its source, temporary → '(temporary)').

items.resolution: The ability breakdown labels by kind: '(tweak)', '(class feature)', '(temporary)'.

items.title: Fighting-style marks (Sharpshooter, Defense Style) have no state or effect
items.story: When I mark a target with my fighting style, I want a 'Mark target' state with its reminder and effect (Sharpshooter: opportunity attack if it moves; Defense: its damage to me reduced by half my Str/Con mod, minimum 1), so that the style matters at the table and I remember it on the enemy's turn.
items.evidence: Sharpshooter Style (Tomas): the style text is shown, but there's no Start or state, nothing on the rifle and nothing under Effects. Defense Style (Priya): '…mark a target within 30 feet… damage dealt to you by the target is reduced by… half your Strength or Constitution modifier (minimum of one)' is shown only as text. Only the 'Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws to avoid being moved' part reached Defenses. Tomas rated it low, Priya medium.
items.repro: Pick Sharpshooter Style or Defense Style and look for a Mark/Start button.
items.expected: A Start/End state (ending at the start of my next turn where the rule says so), with the reminder or reduction shown, and the reduction applied by a typed damage box (W-049).

verified.note: clsFeatureState recognises states that 'gain the following benefits', last a while, or run until next turn with benefits. Defense Style's 'mark a target… until the end of your next turn' matches none, and Sharpshooter's mark likewise, so there's no Start. Only Defense's 'advantage… to avoid being moved' reaches Defenses.

items.resolution: Fighting styles that mark a target (Sharpshooter, Defense Style) have 'Mark a target' in the tracker and on their card: an effect with the style's text that lasts until the start or end of your next turn.

items.title: Add a custom temporary effect for things the sheet doesn't know
items.story: When a power or the GM gives me a bonus the sheet can't apply, I want to add a named temporary effect ('AC set to 15', 8 h) with End, so that I don't need a permanent tweak that would even sync.
items.evidence: 'Add an effect someone gave you, e.g. a stim…' with 'Battle' only offered 'Battle Adrenal Mk I / Mk II' (consumables). There's no free-form effect, so she used an 'AC set to 15' tweak for Battle Precognition and had to delete it after the long rest.
items.repro: Type any name that isn't an item into 'Add an effect someone gave you…'.
items.expected: A 'custom effect' option: name, stat + bonus or set value, duration. It ends with End or on a rest.
items.workarounds: A tweak with a reason, removed by hand later.

verified.note: 'Add an effect' only lists catalog items that have a parsed effect. A custom effect (name, stat from tweakTargets, bonus or set value, duration) could reuse makeEffect and fxResolve; tempEffects already applies mods.

items.resolution: 'Your own effect' (Effects): a name, how long it lasts, and one bonus from the tweak list (or a reminder); it ends like the others.

items.title: Force Affinity (Ashla) not applied when casting light side powers
items.story: When I cast a light side power with Ashla, I want the sheet to ask 'me or the target?' and add the power's level to max and current HP for 1 minute, so that I get the benefit without fiddling.
items.evidence: She typed 'Ashla' in Force Affinity's 'Your choices', and the chip 'Choose one of Ashla, Bendu, Bogan' disappeared. Casting Heroism and Heal (both light side) left HP at 17/17 and 15/17 with no effect listed. The rule: 'When you successfully cast a light side power, either your or the target's (your choice) hit point maximum and current hit points increase by an amount equal to the power's level. This effect lasts for 1 minute.'
items.repro: Choose Ashla, then cast Heroism at 1st level.
items.expected: A 1-minute effect '+1 max/current HP (Ashla)' on me, or a note for the target.
items.workarounds: Skipped it and played with 1 HP less.

verified.note: There's no Force Affinity handling: no code references Ashla, Bendu or Bogan. Casting doesn't look at the alignment of light-side powers or add a +level HP effect.

items.resolution: After a light side power cast at 1st level or higher, the message offers 'Ashla: +N HP max on me (1 minute)'.

items.title: The Way of the Mynock doesn't apply Saber Ward or count its reactions
items.story: When I start The Way of the Mynock, I want Saber Ward's resistance to weapon kinetic/energy/ion damage listed under Defenses and a 'Saber Reflect reactions' counter, so that the stance actually changes my numbers.
items.evidence: Start → 'The Way of the Mynock started, lasts 1 minute' and a strip chip, but Defenses had no resistance and there was no reactions counter. Damage still has no type (W-049), so she entered 8 energy as 4 and 18 kinetic as 9 by hand. This goes beyond part A's damage-type wish: now the sheet itself knows she's in a resistance stance.
items.repro: Soresu Form 3 → Features → Start The Way of the Mynock → look at Defenses, then take damage.
items.expected: The resistance listed while the stance lasts (re-cast each turn as a bonus action), a reactions counter equal to the proficiency bonus, and the damage box applying the resistance by damage type.
items.workarounds: Halved the damage in her head before typing it.

verified.note: The documented gap: 'Granted powers cast "as part of" something (… Soresu's saber ward) stay text.' Starting the stance gives its benefits list but not Saber Ward's resistance, and there's no reactions counter. Applying it to damage also needs W-049.

items.resolution: Starting The Way of the Mynock applies Saber Ward's resistance for the minute and adds a Saber Reflect reactions counter (proficiency bonus) under Effects; each 'Use one' rolls Saber Reflect's reduction.

items.title: Reckless Attack has no toggle
items.story: When I decide to attack recklessly, I want a 'Reckless this turn' switch that pre-selects advantage on Str melee attacks and shows 'attacks against you have advantage until your next turn', so that both halves of the trade-off are on screen.
items.evidence: The Reckless Attack card is text only. The attack dock offers Disadvantage/Normal/Advantage with no Reckless option.
items.repro: Berserker 2+ → Class Features → Reckless Attack.
items.expected: A per-turn toggle like Start Rage, combined with other sources in the roller (W-099).
items.workarounds: Picked Advantage by hand, or Normal when poisoned.

verified.note: Reckless Attack's text isn't a recognised state (clsFeatureState), so there's no toggle. Even with one, roller presets only handle saves, checks, skills and initiative, never attacks, so the roller needs to learn attack advantage and the 'attacks against you' note.

items.resolution: 'Attack recklessly' in the tracker and on the card: until your next turn, the roller gives advantage on melee weapon attacks using Strength; Effects notes that attacks against you have advantage.

items.title: Dewback's Instinct damage types not named under Resistances
items.story: When I rage with Dewback's Instinct, I want Resistances to name my chosen types, so that I know what I resist mid-fight.
items.evidence: The instinct's choices box says 'Poison + Acid + Fire'. While raging, Defenses & senses → RESISTANCES shows 'Resistance to kinetic and energy damage' and 'Resistance to the chosen damage'. The Rage effect says 'Dewback's Instinct: While raging, you have resistance to the chosen damage types.' The types are named nowhere.
items.repro: Add Dewback's Instinct, type three types in its choices box, Start Rage.
items.expected: 'Resistance to poison, acid and fire (Dewback's Instinct)', ideally chosen with a 3-of-13 damage-type picker (true damage excluded) instead of free text.

verified.note: Dewback's text reads 'While raging, you have resistance to the chosen damage types.' The note-reading branch matches only 'resistance to that (type of) damage'. The generic branch then lazily captures 'the chosen damage', which produces 'Resistance to the chosen damage'; the pick's note ('Poison + Acid + Fire') is ignored. Fix: treat 'the chosen damage types' like 'that damage' (read the note), and add a 3-of-N type picker.

items.resolution: 'Resistance to the chosen damage types' is read from the pick's notes: 'Resistance to poison, acid, fire damage'. A damage-type picker would be part of W-031.

items.title: Soresu Form duration: the sheet says 'start of next turn', the text says 'end of next turn'
items.story: When I adopt a form, I want its duration to match its rules text, so that I know whether it still protects me during my next turn.
items.evidence: The badge reads 'Active · lasts until the start of your next turn', and Effects 'started, lasts until the start of your next turn'. The form's own text: 'The first time you take kinetic, energy, or ion damage from a weapon before the end of your next turn…'.
items.repro: Features > Lightsaber forms > Adopt Soresu Form.
items.expected: A duration consistent with SW5E's form rules, or an explanation.
items.workarounds: Ended and re-adopted it by hand each turn.

verified.note: chFormState hardcodes duration 'until the start of your next turn' for every form, as decision 10 records, and strips 'before the end of your next turn' from the text. Soresu's own text (SW5E data): 'The first time you take kinetic, energy, or ion damage from a weapon before the end of your next turn, that damage is reduced by half.' Fix: read the start or end phrase from each form's text.

items.resolution: A form lasts until the end of your next turn when its text says so (Soresu); decision 10 updated.

items.title: Maniacal Rage's Intimidation advantage not listed while raging
items.story: When I rage as a Frenzied Berserker, I want 'Advantage on Intimidation (Maniacal Rage)' listed with the other advantages and pre-selected, so that I remember it.
items.evidence: While raging, Advantages listed Dex saves (Danger Sense), Strength checks and saving throws, cold and climbing, but not Maniacal Rage. The Rage effect text doesn't mention it either.
items.repro: Frenzied Approach → Start Rage → Defenses & senses.
items.expected: Listed, and advantage pre-selected on Intimidation rolls while raging.

verified.note: The engine's feature text starts with the level line '_**Frenzied Approach:** 3rd level_' (no period; checked in dev/dumps/rules.json). startFeatureState collapses whitespace and splits on periods, so the first sentence becomes '_**Frenzied Approach:** 3rd level_ While raging, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.' The `^While raging` test then fails. clsTextFeatures strips that line, but engine features don't go through it. Fix: strip the level line before splitting. Any engine feature whose first sentence is 'While raging…' has the same bug.

items.resolution: The level line ('_**Frenzied Approach:** 3rd level_') is stripped before reading 'While raging…' sentences, so Maniacal Rage's advantage joins Rage.

items.title: Celerity Oscillator's speed boost isn't mentioned after a hit
items.story: When I deal damage with my modified weapon, I want a reminder 'speed +10 ft, no opportunity attacks from that target', so that I use the mod I chose.
items.evidence: He hit for 11 energy. Nothing showed on the damage roll, and Speed stayed 30 ft.
items.repro: Armstech 3 with Celerity Oscillator on the modified weapon: hit and roll damage.
items.expected: A note on the damage result, or a short 'until your next turn' effect.

verified.where: viewer.js:featureEffectsUncached (mod: effects only for weapon bonuses)
verified.note: Modification sentences about the modified weapon other than +N attack, damage or crit range are dropped (featureEffectsUncached filters 'this weapon' sentences out). Celerity Oscillator's on-hit rider appears nowhere. It could be a note on the weapon's damage roll (roller.js buildRoll 'damage').

items.resolution: The damage roll of the modified weapon notes 'Celerity Oscillator: Once per turn, when you deal damage with your modified weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 feet…'.

items.title: Custom items: add story items and gear that aren't in SW5E's list
items.story: When the GM hands me a story item ('coded datapad with the smuggler's coordinates') or I own gear that isn't in SW5E's list (Copy of the Jedi Code, an insignia, a research book), I want to add a custom item with name, qty, weight, cost and description, and to rename or annotate any item, so that my whole inventory lives in the sheet.
items.evidence:
Typing the name gives 'No SW5E item matches.' Add then shows the red 'Choose an item from the SW5E list (start typing its name).', partly hidden (W-081). The categories are All items, Weapons, Armor, Adventuring gear and Enhanced items, with no custom option, and inventory rows can't be renamed or annotated.

sw5e.com's builder Equipment tab has 'CUSTOM ITEMS +' (Name, Type, Cost, Weight, Quantity, Description), and the viewer already knows a `customEquipment` field. Tomas and Priya added their items there (about 12 actions) and Load brought them in with a 'custom' tag, keeping all local changes (Priya B: 'inventory 11 rows + 2 custom'). Mira and Sam added SW5E's generic 'Datapad' for free and explained it in Notes; Jun kept the datapad, pack and research book in Notes. Sam rated it medium, the others high.
items.repro: Equipment & Inventory > type a name that isn't in SW5E's list > Add.
items.expected: 'Add … as a custom item' in the same row (name, qty, weight, cost, description, category), saved to customEquipment and synced. A personal name or note on any item.
items.workarounds: sw5e.com CUSTOM ITEMS, then Load from SW5E. Or a generic item plus an explanation in Notes.

verified.note: addItemFromCatalog fails unless the name is in SW5E's catalog. Custom items are already read, shown with a 'custom' chip, editable (qty, equip, remove) and syncable (ITEM_FIELDS includes customEquipment; the bridge accepts it), but nothing creates them. Adding 'Add … as a custom item' with name, qty, weight, cost, category and description is mostly a form. Renaming or annotating any item is extra.

items.resolution: Typing a name that isn't in SW5E's list offers 'Add “…” as a custom item' with weight, cost each and description (Pay works as for other items). ✎ on any row gives a custom item's name, weight, cost and description, and any item your own name for it and a note.

items.title: Enhanced items aren't tied to a base weapon or armor
items.story: When I loot an enhanced weapon or armor (a named weapon, 'Weapon (Fine)', 'Armor (Fine)', 'any medium armor'), I want to pick or see the base item it is (Nightstinger, Vibroaxe, Combat suit, Mesh armor). It should then show as one item with the base stats, weight and properties plus its bonus, in Weapons & Attacks or as my worn armor, so that I can attack with it, compare loot and not carry phantom duplicates.
items.evidence:
Tomas (high), Xerrol Nightstinger Rifle (Weapon · Premium): the preview shows only '+1 bonus to damage rolls… advantage on the Dexterity (Stealth) check… silent property', with no damage die, range, properties or weight. Added as Equipped, the inventory row reads 'Enhanced: Weapon (1)', weight '—', cost '—', and it doesn't appear in Weapons & Attacks. Effects shows 'Xerrol Nightstinger Rifle — Damage +1: no effect on [choose a weapon…] while equipped'. He picked Blaster rifle there and got 1d8+4: the nightstinger fired with the blaster rifle's stats.

Sam: Equip on the 'Weapon (Fine)' row left the Vibroaxe at +7 / 1d12+5. The weapon choice is hidden in Combat & Vitals → Effects → From equipment ('Attack +1: no effect · Damage +1: no effect · on [choose a weapon…]'); after picking it, +8 / 1d12+6.

Jun: 'Armor (Fine)' ('You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.') raised AC 13 → 14, but it's a separate '— —' row next to the Combat suit.

Priya: Jensaarai Armor (Prototype, attuned) sits apart from her mesh armor, AC 15 → 16 with the mesh still equipped. Its Effects text also shows the Regalia set bonus ('+2 … instead of +1') without the Cloak or Headgear, and you could wear two body armors.
items.repro: Add Xerrol Nightstinger Rifle, Weapon (Fine), Armor (Fine) or Jensaarai Armor as Equipped, then look at Weapons & Attacks, AC and Effects.
items.expected: Ask for the base item when adding or equipping. A named enhanced weapon gets its own attack row with its base weapon's stats plus its bonus. 'Vibroaxe (Fine)' shows in both the inventory and the weapons table. Enhanced armor replaces the worn base armor (weight, AC, properties). Only one body armor at a time. Set bonuses only with the full set. Base stats, weight and rarity shown in the add preview.
items.workarounds: Picked the weapon in the Effects select. Left both armors equipped.

verified.note: An enhanced weapon's bonus can be applied to a standard weapon chosen in Effects (effectRow's 'on [choose a weapon…]'), but equipping doesn't auto-pick one (itemEffects uses itemTargets only, so 'no effect' until chosen). The enhanced item gets no attack row of its own (renderAttacks lists only SW5E's c.weapons). Enhanced armor adds its AC on top of the worn base armor as a separate row. Nothing limits body armor to one. Set bonuses are parsed as text without checking the set. The add preview (renderAddDetail) has no base stats for enhanced items.

items.resolution: An enhanced weapon, armor or shield picks its base item when added or on its row: one you carry, or one from SW5E's list matching its subtype ('any blaster', 'any medium', 'nightstinger rifle'). It's one row with the base's damage or AC, properties and weight. Weapons & Attacks lists the weapon under the enhanced name with its bonus, and equip and remove go together.

items.title: Shop: discount %, 'pay what you have', and recording a debt
items.story: When the shopkeeper gives a discount or lets me owe her, I want a discount % next to Pay, 'Pay what you have' / 'Add unpaid' on the not-enough-credits error, and a debt line (or negative credits with a warning), so that the shop scene works without maths and Notes.
items.evidence: The script: 2 Medpacs (2 × 300) and one more item, with 20% off if you can't afford it. Everyone was short: 'Not enough credits: 600 cr needed, 150 cr available.' (Mira), '…100 cr available' (Tomas), '480 cr needed, 100 cr available' (Jun), '480 … 150' (Priya), '480 … 50' (Sam). The Pay field is a single total. Players worked out the 20% themselves and still couldn't pay; typing their whole balance into Pay worked ('any price'). Debts went to Notes: 'Owe Kessa 490 cr' (Mira), 460 (Tomas), 420 (Jun), 370 (Priya), 430 (Sam). Item rows show the list price (Medpac 300 cr), not what was paid (Mira, Priya).
items.repro: With 150 cr: Medpac, Qty 2, Pay ticked, Add.
items.expected: A discount % that updates Pay. Buttons on the error: 'Pay 150 (all you have)' and 'Add unpaid'. A debts line in Credits, or negative credits with a warning. Optionally keep what was actually paid.
items.workarounds: Typed the balance into Pay, added the rest unpaid, and wrote the debt in Notes.

verified.note: Any price can be typed into Pay. There's no discount %, and on 'Not enough credits' there are no 'Pay what you have' or 'Add unpaid' buttons; the add simply fails. adjustCredits refuses negative credits. There's no debt field (a new local field, or Notes). Rows show the catalog cost, not the price paid.

items.resolution: Pay has 'less N %' and 'from' (seller). When the credits fall short, the error offers 'Pay N cr, owe M' and 'Owe all'; Debts under Credits list each debt with Pay back and Settled. Rows show 'paid N' next to the list price.

items.title: Equipment packs (Explorer's, Diplomat's, Priest's) can't be added or unpacked
items.story: When my class gives me an equipment pack, I want to add it in one step and have it unpack into its contents, so that I don't guess and add each piece separately.
items.evidence: 'diplomat', 'explorer' and 'Explorer's pack' all give 'No SW5E item matches.' 'pack' finds only Backpack, Jetpack and the cybernetic '…Package' items. The builder says 'No data available'. Players added backpack, bedroll, field rations ×10, glowrod and clothes one at a time, guessing the contents (Sam), or wrote the pack in Notes (Mira, Jun).
items.repro: Equipment & Inventory > Add an item > 'explorer' or 'diplomat'.
items.expected: Packs from SW5E's equipment chapter, added as a pack or unpacked into their contents. Starting equipment (W-003) would use them too.
items.workarounds: Added the contents one by one, or wrote the pack in Notes.

verified.note: SW5E's catalog (equipment plus enhancedItems from the bridge) has no packs, which matches 'No data available' on the site, so there's nothing to add or unpack. It needs a hand-written pack contents table from the equipment chapter, shared with W-003.

items.resolution: Equipment packs (from SW5E's Equipment chapter) appear in the search with their price. Adding one adds its contents (merged into stacks, custom items for anything not in the list). Starting equipment unpacks them, and a pack kept as a custom item has Unpack.

items.title: SW5E rarity names unexplained; enhanced item search hard to filter
items.story: When the GM says 'uncommon or rarer', I want the item list to show 'Premium (uncommon)' and let me filter enhanced items by type and minimum rarity, so that I can find legal loot without guessing.
items.evidence:
Suggestions show only SW5E's rarity words:
- Mira: 'Focus Generator (Fine) · Focus · Premium', '(Improved) · Prototype', '(Superior) · Advanced', 'Chassis (Legendary)'.
- Priya: 'Armor · Prototype', 'Adventuring Gear · Premium/Advanced'.
- Jun: Enhanced items + 'suit' mixes plain 'Combat suit · Armor' and 'Chemical suit · Life Support' (no rarity) with 'Collapsible Suit · Item Modification · Premium'.
- Sam: 'vibroaxe' finds only plain weapons, Enhanced + 'axe' only 'Shotgun Axe · Premium', 'vibroweapon' only chassis variants, and 'weapon' gives '(Champion) · Artifact … (Fine) · Premium …' plus '24 more; keep typing'.
Everyone guessed that Premium = uncommon. Sam rated it medium, the others low.
items.repro: Equipment → Enhanced items → search for an uncommon weapon or armor.
items.expected: Rarity on every enhanced row with its 5e word ('Premium (uncommon)', 'Prototype (rare)'), a tooltip or legend, and filters by item type and minimum rarity.

verified.note: Suggestions show titleCase(type) · titleCase(rarityText) ('Premium', 'Prototype'), with no 5e equivalent or legend. Categories exist (All, Weapons, Armor, Adventuring gear, Enhanced), but there are no type or minimum-rarity filters. Plain items show no rarity at all.

items.resolution: Rarities read 'Premium (uncommon)', 'Prototype (rare)'…; Enhanced items has a type filter and 'X or rarer'.

items.title: Add-item error message hidden under the suggestion popup
items.story: When pressing Add fails, I want to read the whole error, so that I know why nothing happened.
items.evidence: Only the beginning of the red message, 'Choose an item from the S…', is visible; the 'No SW5E item matches.' dropdown covers the rest. All four hit it while trying to add the datapad or the Jedi Code.
items.repro: Type an unknown item name and press Add.
items.expected: Close the dropdown or place the error where it can be read. Offer 'Add as custom item' (W-076).

verified.note: .sugg is absolutely positioned below the name box (z-index 15), and #addErr sits right under the add row, so the open 'No SW5E item matches.' popup covers it. addItemFromCatalog's fail() doesn't close the suggestions (addDraft.closed). Fix: close the popup on failure, or place the error above, and offer 'Add as custom item' (W-076).

items.resolution: A failed Add closes the suggestions so the message is readable.

items.title: Item search: word order, ranking and prices
items.story: When I search for an item, I want all my words matched in any order, plain items and word-start matches first, and prices in the suggestions, so that I find 'Grenade, fragmentation' or 'Field rations' quickly on any device and can compare costs.
items.evidence: 'fragmentation grenade' gives 'No SW5E item matches.', while 'grenade' lists 'Grenade launcher', 'Grenade, corrosive'… (Tomas). 'clothes' lists the clandestine variants before 'Clothes, common', and the builder's 'Wristpad' search lists 12+ variants first (Jun). 'ration' lists 'Blaster Integration', 'Disintegration Core (Mk II–VI)', 'Emergency rations'… before 'Field rations (one day's)' (Priya, Sam). Medpac suggestions show the category but no price until picked (Priya).
items.repro: Add an item from SW5E → type 'fragmentation grenade', 'clothes' or 'ration'.
items.expected: All words matched in any order. Exact, plain and word-start matches ranked first. A price on each suggestion.
items.workarounds: Typed SW5E's exact naming, or scrolled the list.

verified.note: The search matches the whole typed text as one substring (`it.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)`), so 'fragmentation grenade' finds nothing and 'ration' also hits 'Integration'. The only ranking is 'name starts with the whole query', then alphabetical. That is why 'Clothes, clandestine…' comes before 'Clothes, common'. Nothing ranks word-start matches or plain items above enhanced ones. Each suggestion shows only itemKind (category and rarity); the price appears only in renderAddDetail after an item is picked. Fix: split the query into words and match them in any order; score exact > plain item > word-start > substring; add priceOf() to each row.

items.resolution: Search matches every word in any order ('fragmentation grenade' → 'Grenade, fragmentation'), ranks exact, starts-with and word-start matches and plain items first ('ration' → Field rations), and shows prices in the suggestions.

items.title: Some items weigh 0 lb (Tinker's implements, light physical shield)
items.story: When I add tools and shields, I want their real weight, so that carrying capacity is right.
items.evidence: 'Tinker's implements Tool · 500 cr · 0 lb' (Jun). 'Light physical shield · Armor · 50 cr · 0 lb' in the add row and the inventory (Sam), and 'Weight: 0' in the builder too (Priya). The players weren't sure what SW5E's data says.
items.repro: Add Tinker's implements or a Light physical shield.
items.expected: Weights from SW5E's equipment tables (check the data).

verified.note: SW5E's own item data has the 0: dev/dumps/catalog.json gives Light physical shield weight '0' and Tinker's implements '0' (Medium physical shield is '18'). The builder shows 0 too, and the viewer only displays the data. Report it upstream. Once the PHB weights are confirmed, this argues for a small local correction table applied in mergeEquipment and the catalog.

items.title: Credits history with a note per change
items.story: When credits change (loot, a gift to a party member, a debt), I want a short log with an optional note per change, so that the money's history lives with the money, not in Notes.
items.evidence: All three did +400 (→ 550 cr) and −100 (→ 450 cr). The credits box applies '+n' and '-n' with Enter but keeps no history or reason. The debt to Kessa is still only in Notes.
items.repro: Change credits a few times, then look for a record.
items.expected: A collapsible history (amount, note, date), including debts and loans (W-078).

verified.note: adjustCredits only writes the new credits value and a status line; no log is kept. It needs a per-character credits log (amount, optional note, date, balance after), for example in itemState so backups include it. It also needs a note field in the credits form and a collapsible history under Credits. Debts and loans tie in with W-078.

items.resolution: The credits box has a 'what for' note, and Credit history lists every change made in the sheet (the box, purchases, sales, paying back) with its note and balance.

items.title: Track blaster shots per power cell
items.story: When I fire my blaster, I want a shots-left counter for the loaded cell and a Reload that uses a power cell, so that I know when I need to reload.
items.evidence: Tomas's blaster rifle shows 'Power cell (range 105/420), reload 12'. After two shots, power cells stayed at 3 and no shot count appears anywhere. Jun's blaster pistol shows 'reload 16', and cells only go down via Use. Tomas rated it medium, Jun low.
items.repro: Roll two blaster attacks, then look at the inventory and weapon rows.
items.expected: A counter per equipped ranged weapon (10/12), with Reload using one power cell.

verified.note: There is no ammunition or reload tracking. 'Reload 12' is only a property string, and power cells are ordinary inventory items that go down only through Use. It needs a per-weapon shots counter (in itemState), decremented on each attack roll, and a Reload button that uses one matching ammo item (ammoFits() already matches cells to weapons).

items.resolution: Weapons with reload show 'Shots N/12' in Weapons & Attacks. Each attack rolled uses a shot, −1 counts one fired without rolling, and Reload takes a power cell (or cartridge) from the inventory. The last shot offers Reload.

items.title: Encumbrance: changes silently, doesn't affect speed, consequence unexplained
items.story: When loot pushes me over a carrying threshold, I want to be told and have my speed adjusted (or be told it only applies with the variant rule), so that the 'Encumbered' warning means something.
items.evidence: Tomas (Str 8): 'Carried 64 lb — Encumbered', encumbered at 40 lb, but Speed stays 30 ft everywhere. Jun: adding 10 power cells took him to 41 lb ('CARRIED 41 lb Encumbered · ENCUMBERED AT 40 lb'), with no notice, Speed still 30 ft, and nothing saying what Encumbered does. Tomas logged it as a rules question (low), Jun as a bug (medium).
items.repro: A Str 8 character: add items past 40 lb.
items.expected: A notice 'Now encumbered: speed 20 ft' and Speed updated. Or 'only if your GM uses variant encumbrance', or hide the variant.

verified.note: renderCarry labels the character 'Encumbered' or 'Heavily encumbered' from SW5E's carryingCapacity thresholds (5×/10× Str, the variant encumbrance rule). It applies nothing to speed, gives no notice when a threshold is crossed, and doesn't explain what being encumbered does. Options: (a) apply the variant behind a setting (−10 ft; heavily encumbered: −20 ft plus disadvantage on Str/Dex/Con rolls), with a notice when crossing a threshold; (b) label it 'Variant rule: only if your GM uses it' and explain the effect; (c) hide the thresholds and show only capacity (Str × 15).

items.resolution: Labelled as a variant rule, with what it does in the tooltip; nothing is applied to speed (option b).

items.title: Arrow-down skips the pre-highlighted first suggestion
items.story: When I search for an item and press ↓ then Enter, I want the first result, so that I don't silently get a different item.
items.evidence: The first suggestion is already highlighted, so ↓ moves to the second. 'pouch' gave him an Ammo Pouch (EC, 15 cr) instead of a Pouch, which he only noticed in step A7. 'grenade, frag' gave 'Grenade, Fragmentation (Average)' (an enhanced consumable with no price) instead of the plain grenade.
items.repro: Search 'pouch', press ↓, Enter, Enter.
items.expected: ↓ highlights (or keeps) the first item, or the highlight is clearly visible.
items.workarounds: Removed the Ammo Pouch and used Enter without ↓.

verified.note: ADD_DEFAULTS has hi: 0, so the first suggestion starts highlighted, and ArrowDown adds 1, moving to the second item; Enter then picks hits[hi]. 'grenade, frag' lists the plain 'Grenade, fragmentation' first and '(Average)' second, so ↓ Enter gives the enhanced one, exactly as reported. Fix: start with no highlight (hi −1, Enter takes the first item), or make ↓ from the input land on item 0. Also make .sugg-item.hi easier to see.

items.resolution: The first ↓ keeps the already highlighted first suggestion (items and effects).

items.title: Qty and Pay carry over to the next item picked
items.story: When I pick a different item after buying two of something, I want Qty back to 1 and Pay unticked, so that I don't buy two by accident.
items.evidence: Mira set Medpac qty 2 with Pay ticked, then picked 'Focus generator': it showed Qty 2 and 'Pay 400' ticked. Sam picked Light physical shield after the medpac attempt and it kept Qty 2 and 'Pay 100 cr'.
items.repro: Choose an item, set Qty 2 and tick Pay, then choose another item.
items.expected: Qty 1, Pay unticked, standard price.

verified.note: pickAddItem sets only d.name and d.hi. Qty, Pay and any typed price stay in state.addDraft (so does editing the name), and only addItemFromCatalog resets the draft. A typed custom price carries over too. Fix: reset qty, pay, price, equip and attune whenever a different item is picked.

items.resolution: Picking another item resets quantity, Pay, price, equip and attune.

items.title: Mesh armor price differs: 600 in the builder, 500 cr in the sheet
items.story: When I compare prices, I want the same number in both places, so that I can trust the shop price.
items.evidence: The builder's Add Equipment dialog shows Mesh armor 'Cost: 600'. The sheet's inventory row shows 'Mesh armor … 500 cr'.
items.repro: Compare the mesh armor price in sw5e.com's Add Equipment with the viewer's inventory.
items.expected: One price (check SW5E's list).

verified.note: The viewer shows SW5E's own cost field: the catalog dump has Mesh armor cost 500. The 600 comes from sw5e.com's builder dialog. Check the PHB armor table and report the mismatch upstream. If 600 is right, add it to the same correction table as W-083.

items.title: Armor properties (Stealth disadvantage, Strength requirement) not shown or applied
items.story: When I wear armor, I want its properties shown on the row and applied in the roller, so that I know whether my Stealth roll has disadvantage.
items.evidence: The Mesh armor row shows only 'AC 13 + Dex modifier (max 2) · Medium'. The builder's description is flavour text, so there are no properties anywhere. The Stealth roll opened on Normal.
items.repro: Equip an armor → Skills → Stealth.
items.expected: 'Stealth disadvantage' or 'no Stealth penalty' (and any Strength requirement) on the armor row, and disadvantage pre-selected on Stealth when it applies.
items.workarounds: Assumed no penalty, or looked it up elsewhere.

verified.note: The inventory row already shows 'Stealth disadvantage', 'Str N' and the properties list when SW5E's data has them (for example Medium physical shield 'Strength 13'). SW5E's data gives Mesh armor no properties (stealthDisadvantage null), so a Normal Stealth roll is correct for mesh armor. Still missing: explanations of SW5E's armor properties (rules.armorProperties: Bulky gives disadvantage on Stealth that relies on sound; Obtrusive does the same for sight with shields; Strength cuts speed by 10), a 'no Stealth penalty' note, and the roller: startRoll never pre-selects disadvantage because of armor.

items.resolution: Bulky and Obtrusive armor (and SW5E's stealth-disadvantage flag) give disadvantage on Stealth rolls, saying whether it's sound or sight. An unmet Strength requirement and Cumbersome lower the speed shown. Rows list the properties; SW5E's data gives Mesh armor none.

items.title: No Sell action
items.story: When I sell gear to a shop, I want to remove the item and add credits at a price I choose (default half), so that selling is one action.
items.evidence: Inventory rows have only −, +, Equip/Use and × (remove). Cost shows the list price (Medpac 300 cr), not what was paid.
items.repro: Look for a sell option on any inventory row.
items.expected: 'Sell…' with a price, which adds the credits.
items.workarounds: × and then a '+n' credits entry by hand.

verified.note: Inventory rows have only − / + / Equip / Use / ×. A Sell action would remove one unit and add credits at a price the player chooses (default half of priceOf), with a status line.

items.resolution: Sell on every row: how many and the price (half the standard price by default, what you paid shown). The items go, the credits come in, and the sale is in the credit history.

items.title: Enter in the item search adds the item straight away
