items.story: When I type an item name and press Enter, I want it to select the suggestion first (showing qty, price and Pay) and only add on a second Enter, so that I don't add or buy something by accident.
items.evidence: Typing 'Weapon (Fine)' + Enter added it straight away (Items 11 → 12), without showing the Pay/qty row.
items.repro: Equipment → Add an item → type a full name → Enter.
items.expected: Enter selects; a second Enter (or Add) adds.

verified.note: Works as designed. The code comment says 'once the name is a SW5E item, Enter … adds it': addSuggestions returns [] for an exact catalog name, so Enter calls addItemFromCatalog. The claim that the Pay row never showed is only half right: renderAddDetail redraws on input, so the Pay row appears the moment the exact name is typed, and Qty is always visible. Options: keep it (fast for free loot); always select first and add on a second Enter; or need a second Enter only when Pay is ticked.

items.resolution: Kept: Enter adds an item once its exact SW5E name is typed (fast for loot); the Qty and Pay row is visible meanwhile.

items.title: An open item Description jumps to another item after the list changes
items.story: When an item I had expanded is used up or the list changes, I want the expanded state to stay with that item, so that a random other item doesn't open.
items.evidence: He opened the Strength Stim's Description and used the stim up: the Grenade, fragmentation's description was then open. After adding the nightstinger, the Mesh armor's description was open.
items.repro: Expand an item's Description, then use up its last unit (or add an item above it).
items.expected: Keep the open/closed state per item, not per row position.

verified.note: An open <details> is remembered by section + summary text + which occurrence it is. Every item's summary is 'Description', so the open state is tied to the row position, not the item. When an item is used up or added above, it moves to whichever item now sits in that position. Fix: include the item name in the key (a data attribute or a label).

items.resolution: An item's open Description is remembered by item name, not by row position.

items.title: Remove × sits right next to Use on consumables, with no confirm
items.story: When I use a stim on my phone, I want the remove × set apart from Use (or confirmed, or undoable), so that a slip doesn't delete the item.
items.evidence: The Strength Stim row reads '[−] 1 [+] [Use] [×]', with × immediately to the right of Use and no confirmation.
items.repro: Phone frame → Equipment → any consumable row.
items.expected: × set apart, or behind a confirm or undo.

verified.note: Removal already asks first. The first click on × turns it into 'Remove?' (state.confirmRemove), only a second click removes, and the status then offers 'Revert to SW5E's copy'. Jun's 'no confirmation' is wrong; he likely never pressed it. What remains is layout: on phones × sits right next to Use. Move it apart, or add an Undo toast.

items.resolution: Removing already asks first ('Remove?'), and now also offers Undo.

items.title: Active powers' bonus dice not offered in the roller (Guidance, Target Lock, Battle Meditation)
items.story: When a power that adds dice is active, I want the dice dock to offer that die pre-ticked on the right rolls and to end one-shot powers like Guidance once used, so that I neither forget the bonus nor forget to end the power.
items.evidence: With Guidance active ('Cast Guidance. Concentrating.'), the Persuasion dock showed only Normal / Roll. Mira added +d4 herself (18 + 4 + 3 = 25), and so did Priya (4 + 4 + 2 = 10). Guidance stayed in Effects until they pressed End, though its text says 'Once before the power ends… The power then ends.' With Target Lock active ('you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack'), the blaster pistol's damage was '8 Energy (6 + 2 damage bonus)' and nothing was offered. Jun tapped +d6 → 9 'amended', and praised being able to add a die after the roll. Battle Meditation's '+d4 to attack rolls and saving throws' isn't offered either (Mira-B5). Jun rated it high, Mira and Priya medium.
items.repro: Cast Guidance and roll any skill, or cast Target Lock, hit with a weapon and roll damage.
items.expected: '+1d4 Guidance' offered on ability checks, ending Guidance once used. '+1d6 Target Lock' ticked on weapon damage, the way Rage damage is. The same for other active powers that add a die to rolls.
items.workarounds: Added the die with the +d4 / +d6 buttons, and ended Guidance from Effects.

verified.note: castPower starts power effects with mods: [] and only a text note, so nothing reaches the roller. The dock's options come only from m.alts (conditional mods of items and features) and from class riders. The Rage-damage rider in buildRoll('damage') is the pattern to copy. Needed: per-power riders read from the power text or a small table (Guidance +1d4 on ability checks, one use, then the effect ends; Target Lock +1d6 on weapon damage; Battle Meditation +1d4 on attacks and saves), pre-ticked on the matching rolls.

items.resolution: Dice from active powers are ticked on the rolls they apply to: Guidance's d4 on ability checks (then the power ends), Battle Meditation's d4 on attacks and saves, Target Lock's 1d6 on weapon damage.

items.title: Spend class resources from the dice dock (Force-Empowered Strikes, maneuvers, Close Call)
items.story: When I use a feature that spends a resource to add a die to an attack or damage roll, I want a toggle in the dock that adds the die and spends the resource in the same click (like the Sneak Attack checkbox), so that I don't add dice by hand and then decrement the tracker somewhere else.
items.evidence:
Force-Empowered Strikes (Priya, high): 'Hit: roll damage' rolled only 1d6+3 / 1d6+4. The 'Class dice: Focused Strikes 2d8' chip opens a bare '2d8' roll (5 + 5 = 10): not named, no choice of 1 or 2 points, not added to the weapon damage, no FP spent. She pressed FP − twice (9 → 7, 7 → 5) and typed 2d8 in round 3.

Precision Attack / Return Fire (Tomas): the attack dock has +d4…+d20 but no maneuver option, and superiority dice (2/2) are only on the tracker.

Armstech's Close Call on a miss (Jun; a 6 with disadvantage): no option. He tapped +d4 (1 → 7 'amended'), then went to Combat > Potent Aptitude − (2/2 → 1/2).

The damage dock's '☐ Sneak Attack +1d6' checkbox shows the pattern already exists; Tomas praised it.
items.repro: Guardian 2+: hit with the lightsaber and roll damage. Fighter with Precision Attack: attack with the blaster rifle. Armstech 3: miss with the modified weapon.
items.expected: 'Force-Empowered Strikes: +1d8 (1 FP) / +2d8 (2 FP)' on melee damage (same damage type, dice doubled on a crit). '☐ Precision Attack (+d4, spends a superiority die)' on attacks, and Return Fire on damage. 'Close Call: add Potent Aptitude (d4), 2 left' on a miss with the modified weapon. The tracker updates in the same click.
items.workarounds: +dN buttons by hand, plus '−' on the tracker.

verified.note: Already there: Sneak Attack, Rage and splash riders as damage checkboxes; a superiority-die roll with 'Spend a superiority die'; class-table chips (Focused Strikes 2d8) that roll bare dice. Missing: riders inside the attack and damage dock that also spend the resource. That means Force-Empowered Strikes (1d8 per FP, up to Focused Strikes, doubled on a crit, spends FP), maneuvers adding the superiority die to attack or damage (Precision Attack, Return Fire), and Close Call (Potent Aptitude added on a miss with the modified weapon). Each should update the tracker in the same click.

items.resolution: The dice roller offers what a roll can spend, unticked: maneuvers that add the superiority die to the attack or its damage, Force-Empowered Strikes (+1d8 per force point up to the Focused Strikes column) on melee damage, Close Call with the modified weapon. Ticking one spends it, even after the roll; unticking gives it back.

items.title: Use Inspiration from the roller (and show it in the strip)
items.story: When I'm Inspired and roll a d20, I want a 'Use Inspiration (advantage)' option in the dock that also spends it, and an 'Inspired' chip in the phone/tablet strip, so that one click does both and I don't forget it.
items.evidence: With '★ Inspired' on (and the 'Inspired' chip in the summary), the Stealth dock offered only Disadvantage / Normal / Advantage. All five picked Advantage (11/16 → 18, 3/12 → 15, 14/1 → 16, 16/6 → 17, 9/7 → 10), then went back to Combat & Vitals to turn Inspiration off. The tablet strip shows nothing for Inspiration (Priya).
items.repro: Turn Inspiration on, then roll Stealth.
items.expected: A 'Use Inspiration' option that sets advantage and spends Inspiration, plus an 'Inspired' chip in the strip.
items.workarounds: Picked Advantage by hand, then toggled Inspiration off.

verified.note: hasInspiration is only toggled in the tracker and shown as a chip in the desktop summary (renderSideSummary). roller.js never reads it, and renderMiniVitals lists only temporary effects. Add 'Use Inspiration (advantage)' to d20 roll cards that sets advantage and calls trackerAction('insp'), plus an 'Inspired' chip in the strip.

items.resolution: '★ Use Inspiration' on a d20 roll card sets advantage and spends it; the phone strip shows ★ while inspired.

items.title: Dice dock: the × moves, the dock covers buttons, and closing it clicks through
items.story: When I close the dice dock or reach for a button behind it, I want the × to stay put, the dock not to cover End/Use/Cast buttons, and closing it not to trigger what's underneath, so that I don't start unwanted rolls or miss End mid-fight.
items.evidence: The dock is anchored to the bottom and changes height (result, recent rolls), so its × moves. Tomas twice clicked where the × had been and opened 'Lore (INT)' and 'Animal Handling (WIS)' rolls he never wanted, and Escape only closes the dock when focus is inside it. Priya (tablet): three taps on × missed after the page or dock reflowed, and the dock covered Effects, Conditions and the tracker's Mynock row. Mira (desktop, 1568 px): End on Guidance behind the dock hit the dock, so she pressed Esc and then End. Jun (phone): after ×, a tooltip opened over Medicine ('Without tweaks or effects: 1 → now 3…'). His × also moved up when a damage roll made the dock taller.
items.repro: Roll an attack and its damage, then click where the × was a moment before. Or scroll Effects so a row sits behind the dock and click End.
items.expected: The × stays in a fixed place (a top-anchored dock), and Escape closes the dock from anywhere. The page gets padding while the dock is open, or the dock sits beside the content or can be minimised. No click-through on close.
items.workarounds: Esc, and a fresh screenshot before every close.

verified.note: #dice is position: fixed with bottom: 16px and grows upward as the result, damage and recent rolls are added, so the ✕ in .dice-head moves. A click where it used to be lands on the page and starts whatever roll is underneath. After the dock closes, the element under the pointer gets a mouseover, which is the tooltip Jun saw. The dock overlays the page; only body padding-bottom is added. Escape: the handler closes the dock from anywhere except while typing in a field outside it, so 'only when focus is inside' is mostly wrong. Fix: anchor the dock's head at a fixed spot, add a minimise state, and briefly ignore clicks after closing.

items.resolution: The dock never shrinks while open (its ✕ can't move down under the pointer), has a ▾ minimise button that leaves one line with the last result, and focus never lands on 'Roll again'.

items.title: Roller ignores active conditions and doesn't combine advantage/disadvantage sources
items.story: When I'm Poisoned (or Reckless while poisoned), I want the dock to pre-select the resulting mode and list why ('Reckless: advantage, Poisoned: disadvantage → they cancel, roll one d20'), so that I roll correctly under pressure and learn the rule.
items.evidence: Jun had Poisoned loaded from sw5e.com, and Conditions showed 'Poisoned — A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.' Tapping the blaster's '+4' still opened the dock on 'Normal'; he picked Disadvantage by hand (2 / 19 → 6). Sam: the Vibroaxe attack dock knows neither Reckless Attack nor Poisoned, and he needed the GM to tell him they cancel. Mira, Tomas and Priya also picked Disadvantage by hand while poisoned (W-062). Exhaustion is in W-063 and armor Stealth in W-090. Jun rated it high, Sam medium.
items.repro: Have Poisoned active (loaded from SW5E) and open any attack. Or be poisoned and use Reckless Attack.
items.expected: The mode pre-selected from all active sources, each listed with its reason, the way Rage pre-selects advantage.
items.workarounds: Picked the mode by hand after asking the GM.

verified.note: startRoll pre-selects advantage only, only from the advantage lists of m.effects, and only for save/check/skill/initiative rolls. Attack rolls never get a preset. SW5E's conditions (c.conditions, e.g. Poisoned) are never read, nothing ever pre-selects disadvantage, and there is no 'advantage and disadvantage cancel' logic. Needed: one resolver that collects sources (conditions, states such as Reckless, exhaustion, armor), applies the cancel rule and lists each reason.

items.resolution: The roller combines advantage and disadvantage from features, states, conditions, exhaustion and War Caster (they cancel out), and marks automatic failures (Stunned: Strength and Dexterity saves).

items.title: Force Visions (Way of the Seer): no foretelling dice
items.story: When I finish a long rest, I want the sheet to roll and keep my two foretelling d20s, and the dock to offer 'use foretelling 13' on any d20 roll (mine or someone else's) and cross it off, so that my archetype's main feature works at the table.
items.evidence: The Force Visions card has only a 'Your choices' text box (placeholder 'What you chose (e.g. Persuasion + Forgery kit)'). Mira rolled 2d20 in the dock (11, 13) and typed 'Foretelling rolls: 11, 13'. In the fight she used 11 on the boss's Dex save and 13 on her own concentration save, and the dock knew nothing. The long rest ('Long rest: regained 16 HP, 10 force points, one level of exhaustion gone.') didn't refresh them, so she rolled 2d20 again (1, 9) and retyped the note.
items.repro: Pick Way of the Seer at Consular 3 and take a long rest.
items.expected: Two foretelling dice on the tracker, rolled on each long rest. A 'replace with foretelling X' option in the dock (before rolling, once per turn), plus a manual 'used' tick for a creature I can see.
items.workarounds: Rolled 2d20 in the dock and kept the numbers in the feature's note box.

verified.note: SW5E's rules text describes two foretelling d20s rolled after each long rest, but the Force Visions card has only the generic notes box. Needed: a foretelling pool on the tracker, rolled on Long rest; a 'replace with foretelling N' option on d20 roll cards (before rolling, once per turn); and a 'used' tick for another creature's roll.

items.resolution: Force Visions rolls two foretelling d20s on each long rest (or Roll 2d20 in the tracker, where they're listed). A d20 roll offers 'Use N' before rolling, which replaces the die and uses that number up.

items.title: Natural 1 still highlights 'Hit: roll damage'
items.story: When my attack roll is a natural 1, I want the dock to say it's a miss rather than highlight 'Hit: roll damage', so that nobody rolls damage by habit.
items.evidence: The red 'Natural 1' badge appears ('3 · Natural 1' for Mira, d20 1 → 6 for Tomas, '6 · Natural 1' for Priya), but the yellow/gold 'Hit: roll damage' default and 'Critical damage' are still offered.
items.repro: Roll weapon attacks until you get a natural 1.
items.expected: 'Miss (natural 1)', with the damage buttons dimmed.

verified.note: 'Hit: roll damage' gets the primary style whenever the roll isn't a crit. A natural 1 only adds the 'Natural 1' chip, and renderDice('next') then focuses that primary damage button. In SW5E, as in 5e, a natural 1 on an attack roll always misses. Fix: on a natural 1 show 'Miss (natural 1)', dim the damage buttons and move the focus.

items.resolution: A natural 1 on an attack shows 'Miss (natural 1)' and no damage button is the default (decision 31).

items.title: Roll breakdown hard to read (missing '+', dice not named, bonuses lumped)
items.story: When I read a roll's breakdown, I want each die and bonus named ('d20 18 + d4 4 + 3 modifier', '+4 Str +2 Rage'), so that I can check the total and learn what each feature adds.
items.evidence: A skill check with +d4 shows '18 4 + 3 modifier' (Mira) and '4 4 + 2 modifier' (Priya). Raging Vibroaxe damage shows '14 Kinetic · 8 + 6 damage bonus'; Sam wants to see '+4 Str +2 Rage'.
items.repro: Roll a skill with +d4, or roll damage while raging.
items.expected: 'd20 18 + d4 4 + 3 modifier', with the damage bonus split by source.

verified.note: rollBreakdown puts the kept d20 and the other dice into separate parts joined by spaces, so the extra die gets no '+' ('18 4 + 3 modifier'), and the dice aren't named (d20, d4, condition). On damage, 'damage bonus' is SW5E's single w.damageBonus. The missing '+' and the die names are S. Splitting the damage bonus by source (Str, Rage, Brute Force) needs bumpSources-style data and is M.

items.resolution: Every part is named and signed, and a damage roll's bonus is split by source: '1d8 1 + 3 DEX modifier + 2 Brute Force + 1 Xerrol Nightstinger Rifle' (Kadro); Rage and other states, features, items and tweaks by name, the rest as 'other (weapon, style…)'.

items.title: Recent rolls aren't kept with the character (lost on reload, separate per page/device)
items.story: When I reload or switch between desktop and phone during a session, I want my character's recent rolls still there, so that 'what did you roll?' can be answered at the table.
items.evidence: Session 1's rolls were gone at the start of part B (Mira, Tomas; Sam noticed it too but logged no wish). In the phone frame, 'Recent rolls for this character' had only the phone's rolls, not the desktop rolls from minutes before: Mira's 'Vibrostaff attack 19'; Tomas's 8 at 16:53 vs the desktop rolls from 16:27–16:34. After a reload, Priya had only the new roll (14 at 18:25); initiative, Stealth, attacks, the 2d8s and damage were gone.
items.repro: Roll on desktop, then reload or open the phone frame and open the dock.
items.expected: The last N rolls stored with the character's data, at least for the last session.

verified.note: A plain reload does keep rolls: they are saved to chrome.storage 'rolls' and loaded at startup. The real causes: one log for all characters, capped at 50 (ROLL_LOG_MAX), so five players' rolls push each other out; and each page writes its whole in-memory list with no merge and no onChanged listener. A second open page, or a phone frame loaded earlier, overwrites the other page's rolls. Fix (S): merge on write, cap per character, listen for changes. Rolls across devices need the log stored in the character's data (M).

items.resolution: Rolls are merged across tabs and capped per character, and now also kept with the character: Sync to SW5E sends the latest 15 as its rollLog, and loading it elsewhere adds them to the log (tested: Kadro's rolls removed locally came back with Load from SW5E).

items.title: Versatile weapons: no two-handed damage option
items.story: When I swing a versatile weapon two-handed, I want the damage roll to offer its versatile dice (2d4), so that I roll the right dice when I drop my shield.
items.evidence: The Vibrostaff shows '1d6−1 Kinetic · Versatile (2d4)', but 'Hit: roll damage' rolled only d6: 1 − 1 = 0 Kinetic (Mira). The Lightsaber is 'versatile (2d4)', but the dock rolled only 1d6+3 (Priya). There's no one-/two-handed choice.
items.repro: Weapons & Attacks > a versatile weapon > roll > Hit: roll damage.
items.expected: A one-handed / two-handed toggle, with a warning for two-handed while a shield is equipped (W-149).
items.workarounds: Swapped dice in the dock, or typed 2d4+3.

verified.note: The damage roll uses only damageNumberOfDice and damageDieType. 'Versatile (2d4)' is just text in the weapon's properties. Add a one-handed / two-handed toggle that reads the versatile dice from the property, with a warning when a shield is equipped (armorState knows about shields).

items.resolution: A versatile weapon's attack offers 'Two-handed (2d4)' next to 'Hit: roll damage', rolling the versatile dice.

items.title: Weapon Expert: damage advantage not offered
items.story: When I hit with a blaster or vibroweapon and my feat lets me roll damage with advantage once per turn, I want the roller to roll the weapon dice twice and keep the higher set, so that I don't do it in my head.
items.evidence: Weapon Expert says '…once per turn when you would roll weapon damage using a blaster, you can choose to have advantage.' The damage roll has no Advantage option. Pressing +d8 added the die to the sum: '1 + 7 + 3 damage bonus' = 11 ('amended'), while the right result is max(1, 7) + 3 = 10. Nothing about it appears on the weapon rows either.
items.repro: Attack with the blaster rifle, then Hit: roll damage, then +d8.
items.expected: An 'Advantage (Weapon Expert)' option on blaster and vibroweapon damage that keeps the higher set, once per turn (W-051).
items.workarounds: Took the higher die in his head.

verified.note: Advantage exists only for d20 rolls (setMode returns unless the roll's kind is 'd20'), and +d8 just adds to the sum. Needed: an advantage mode for weapon damage that rolls the weapon dice twice and keeps the higher set, offered on blaster damage when Weapon Expert's alternative benefit applies (rules text: 'once per turn when you would roll weapon damage using a blaster, you can choose to have advantage').

items.resolution: Weapon Expert adds an 'Advantage (Weapon Expert)' button to blaster damage rolls: the weapon's dice are rolled twice and the higher set counts.

items.title: Mercantile's conditional expertise not offered on business Persuasion
items.story: When I make a business Persuasion check as a Sullustan, I want 'business (Mercantile): expertise' offered in the roller, so that I get my species bonus.
items.evidence: Mercantile: 'Whenever you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check related to conducting business, you are considered to have expertise'. The Persuasion dock shows only Disadvantage/Normal/Advantage and 'Roll +0'. The README says conditional bonuses show as alternatives (e.g. 'vs poison').
items.repro: Skills → Persuasion on a Sullustan.
items.expected: A 'business (Mercantile)' option that adds expertise.

verified.note: Species traits are never turned into effects: featureEffectsUncached reads only class and archetype features, and defensesOf reads species text only for defenses and senses. So Mercantile's conditional expertise never becomes a 'business' alternative (fx.conds → m.alts) that the roller could offer.

items.resolution: Persuasion checks offer 'business (Mercantile)' with the expertise bonus.

items.title: Shift-click to roll selects page text
items.story: When I shift-click a number to roll straight away, I don't want half the page selected in blue.
items.evidence: Shift-clicking Initiative rolled it (8 + 2 = 10) but highlighted the stat cards, and later most of the Play tracker, as a text selection (Mira). Shift-clicking the Vibroaxe '+6' rolled 11 + 6 = 17 and highlighted the weapons table and the Combat & Vitals text (Sam).
items.repro: Click somewhere, then shift-click Initiative or a to-hit number.
items.expected: Roll without a text selection.
items.workarounds: Clicked empty space to clear it.

verified.note: Shift-click rolls straight away (now: e.shiftKey), but nothing stops the browser's own shift-click, which extends the text selection from the last click. There is no preventDefault on shift+mousedown and no user-select: none on .rollable. Fix: preventDefault on shift+mousedown over [data-roll], or clear the selection afterwards.

items.resolution: Shift-mousedown on a rollable is prevented, so no text gets selected.

items.title: Sneak Attack offered on an attack rolled with disadvantage
items.story: When I attack with disadvantage, I want the damage dock to flag Sneak Attack as unavailable, so that I don't add damage I'm not owed.
items.evidence: Round 3: Disadvantage chosen in the same dock (17/15 → 20), and 'Hit: roll damage' still offered '☐ Sneak Attack +1d6'. The rule: 'You don't need advantage… if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it… and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.'
items.repro: Blaster rifle attack with Disadvantage → hit → damage dock.
items.expected: Hide or strike out Sneak Attack, or show a hint, when the attack had disadvantage and no advantage.

verified.note: 'Hit: roll damage' passes only the ticked options to the damage roll, not the attack's advantage mode, so the Sneak Attack checkbox can't know the attack had disadvantage. It is unticked by default, so this is a hint, not a wrong number. Pass the mode along and strike out Sneak Attack (with the rule text) when the attack had disadvantage.

items.resolution: After an attack rolled with disadvantage, Sneak Attack is dimmed in the damage roll with 'not after an attack rolled with disadvantage' (it can still be ticked).

items.title: Show the critical range on the attack dock
items.story: When I roll an attack with Improved Critical, I want the dock to say 'crit 19–20', so that I know a 19 is a crit before I look at the die.
items.evidence: Effects shows 'Improved Critical — Critical on 19–20', but the Blaster rifle attack dock says nothing about 19–20 before or after a roll that isn't a crit (he rolled 12).
items.repro: Assault Specialist → Weapons → Blaster rifle +5.
items.expected: 'Crit 19–20' next to the d20.

verified.note: buildRoll('attack') already works out the crit range and its source (Improved Critical and others), but the dock shows it only in the tooltip of the 'Critical hit (19)' chip, after a crit. Show 'Crit 19–20 (Improved Critical)' next to the d20 before rolling.

items.resolution: The attack roll says 'Critical hit on 19–20 · Improved Critical' before you roll.

items.title: 'Roll again' appears exactly where 'Roll' was
items.story: When I roll initiative on my phone, I want a double tap not to re-roll, so that my first result stands.
items.evidence: After Roll +2 (17 → 19), 'Roll again' appeared in the same spot as 'Roll +2'.
items.repro: Phone frame: roll initiative and tap twice quickly.
items.expected: Move or delay 'Roll again', or ask for confirmation within a second of the first roll.

verified.note: The dock is anchored to the bottom, so its last row stays put: 'Roll +2' turns into 'Roll again' in the same spot. renderDice('next') also focuses 'Roll again' when a roll has no damage or apply button (initiative), so a double tap or a second Enter rolls again. Move the button, delay it, or don't focus it.

items.resolution: 'Roll again' sits next to the result, and focus goes to the next step or the result, never to 'Roll again'.

items.title: DC box in the roller with Success / Failure
items.story: When the GM says 'DC 15', I want to enter it in the roller and see Success or Failure, so that as a beginner I know what my roll means.
items.evidence: Persuasion 16 + 2 = 18 and Insight 14/12 → 15: the dock shows only the total. A known DC would also let the concentration save say pass or fail (W-050).
items.repro: Roll any check.
items.expected: An optional DC field with a result badge.

verified.note: Roll cards have no DC field. Add an optional DC per card with a Success / Failure badge; it would also let concentration saves say pass or fail (W-050).

items.resolution: A DC box on d20 rolls shows Success or Failure.

items.title: Critical-damage rule choice is shared by all characters
items.story: When I roll critical damage, I want the crit rule to be my character's own (or SW5E's default, double dice), so that another player's choice doesn't change my damage.
items.evidence: On her new character's first attack, 'Critical: Double dice / Max + roll' already had Max + roll selected. She never chose it.
items.repro: A new character → weapon attack → critical damage options.
items.expected: Default to double dice per character, or say where the choice was set.

verified.note: Works as designed. The crit choice is stored once for the whole browser (roller.js comment: 'Kept until changed (chrome.storage, all characters)'), and the default is 'double', which is SW5E's rule. The panel shares one browser, so another player's choice showed up. If wanted, store it per character and show where it was set.

items.title: Long rest doesn't end effects shorter than the rest (Strength Stim, Battle Precognition)
items.story: When I take an 8-hour long rest, I want effects that last 1 minute, 1 hour or 8 hours to end (or the rest notice to ask 'End Strength Stim?'), so that a stale buff doesn't stay on my numbers the next morning.
items.evidence: All five used a Strength Stim (Basic) ('lasts 1 hour') and then took a long rest, and the stim stayed active with STR +2: Mira STR +0 instead of −1; Tomas STR 10; Jun's chip still in the strip and Str 10; Priya Str 18 and lightsaber +6; Sam Str 20 and axe +8. Mira's 'Battle Precognition · cast, lasts 8 hours' stayed as well. The rest messages (e.g. 'Long rest: regained 27 HP, uses of Second Wind, Action Surge, one level of exhaustion gone.') say nothing about effects.
items.repro: Use a Strength Stim on yourself, then take a long rest.
items.expected: Effects lasting 8 hours or less end on a long rest (1 hour or less on a short rest) and are listed in the rest notice. Or ask: 'Strength Stim (1 hour) has run out. End it?'
items.workarounds: Pressed End on each effect, and removed Mira's AC tweak by hand.

verified.note: Rests reset only the tracker counters. Temporary effects (state.itemState[key].effects: stims, powers with a duration, feature states) are never touched, and the rest message doesn't mention them. Fix: a long rest ends effects lasting 8 hours or less (including concentration), a short rest those lasting 1 hour or less, and the message lists what ended (or asks first).

items.resolution: Rests end temporary effects that would have run out (short: ≤ 1 hour; long: ≤ 8 hours and concentration) and list them; Undo brings them back (decision 25).

items.title: Hit-die roll looks like grey helper text and is a tiny target
items.story: When I want to spend a hit die, I want an obvious 'Roll d10+3' button with a decent hit area, so that I find it and hit it the first time.
items.evidence: The grey 'roll d6 +1, then Heal' next to 'Hit dice (d6)' is the button (aria label 'Roll a hit die: roll d6 +1'). Clicks on the label, on 'then Heal' or just to the right of the words did nothing. Only a click exactly on 'roll d6 +1', 'roll d10' or 'roll d12 +2' opened the dock.
items.repro: Combat & Vitals > Play tracker > click 'Hit dice (d…)' or 'then Heal'.
items.expected: A real button with a bigger target.
items.workarounds: Clicked exactly on the small words.

verified.note: The roll is there: the faint 'roll d6 +1' inside the 'Hit dice' row note is a rollable span (counterRow note = rollable('hitdie|…') + ', then Heal'). Only those words respond, and they look like helper text. Make it a real button, and give rollables a bigger target on touch screens.

items.resolution: Rolls inside counter notes (hit die, Second Wind) are styled as accent-coloured links with a bigger target.

items.title: Healing at or near full HP wastes a hit die or a medpac without warning
items.story: When I'm at or near full HP, I want to see how many HP I'm missing before I roll a hit die or use a medpac, and be warned (or not charged) when little or nothing would be healed, so that I don't waste my only hit die or a 300 cr medpac.
items.evidence: Priya rolled her hit die at 11/12 (4 + 2 = 6) and pressed 'Heal 6 and spend the d10'. The badge said '✓ Healed 6, spent the die' → 12/12, so only 1 HP was restored, and hit dice went to 0/1. Sam, at 14/14, was offered 'Heal 6 and spend the d12'. Tomas used Medpac > On me at 14/14: it rolled 1 + 3 = 4, said 'At full hit points: nothing to heal.', and still consumed the medpac (2 → 1). Sam's medpac at 11/14: '✓ Healed 3 (of 12; at maximum)'.
items.repro: At full HP or 1 HP down: roll a hit die and Heal, or use a Medpac on yourself.
items.expected: 'N HP missing' shown before rolling. 'Healed 1 (of 6)' afterwards. Disabled or confirmed at full HP, with no consumption when nothing is healed, and a confirmation before spending the last die for a tiny heal.
items.workarounds: Didn't press Heal at full HP.

verified.note: applyButtons offers 'Heal N and spend the dX' at any HP. 'hdheal' spends the die even when no HP is restored, and the badge says 'Healed {total}', not what was actually healed (Priya: 1 of 6). Medpacs are used up on Use by design (open-decisions #23: 'The item is used up when you press Use, whether or not you then press Heal'); applyButtons says 'At full hit points' only afterwards. Fix: show the HP missing before Use or Roll, disable or confirm at full HP, and report the actual amount healed.

items.resolution: A hit die at full HP isn't offered ('nothing to heal; the die isn't spent'); near full it says 'Heal 1 (of 6)' and the badge reports what was healed; Use → 'On me' says how many HP are missing and is off at full HP (decision 28).

items.title: Short rest doesn't offer Force Recovery
items.story: When I finish a short rest with force points spent, I want the sheet to offer Force Recovery (half consular level + Wis or Cha mod, minimum 1) and add the points, so that I don't do it by hand.
items.evidence: At FP 6/8 with Force Recovery 1/1, Short rest said: 'Nothing to regain on a short rest. To heal, roll hit dice ('roll d…' in the tracker).' Spending the Force Recovery counter (1 → 0) didn't add any FP. The feature text: 'When you finish a short rest, you can regain a number of force points equal to half your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).'
items.repro: A Consular with spent FP and Force Recovery available > Short rest.
items.expected: 'Use Force Recovery: +4 FP (0 + Wis 4)?'. Spending the use adds the FP.
items.workarounds: Force Recovery −, then Force points + twice (6 → 8).

verified.note: A short rest resets only tech points, superiority dice and short-rest uses. Force Recovery is just a counter, and spending it adds nothing. Rules text: 'regain a number of force points equal to half your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one)'. On a short rest with FP spent, offer 'Use Force Recovery: +N FP', which spends the use and gives back the points.

items.resolution: After a short rest, features that give points back are offered: 'Use Force Recovery (+6 force points)' (decision 27).

items.title: Short rest doesn't offer to spend hit dice
items.story: When I take a short rest while hurt, I want it to ask 'Spend hit dice? (1 left, d12+2) [Roll]', so that a new player doesn't miss healing on a rest.
items.evidence: Short rest says 'Nothing to regain on a short rest. To heal, roll hit dice ('roll d…' in the tracker).' (Sam). The button only restores points and uses; spending hit dice is a separate row ('Hit dice (d8) roll d8 +2, then Heal') (Jun). Jun rated it low, Sam medium.
items.repro: Take damage, then press Short rest.
items.expected: Inline hit-dice spending in the rest flow when HP is below max.
items.workarounds: Used the 'roll d… ' text on the hit-dice row.

verified.note: A short rest only prints 'To heal, roll hit dice ("roll d…" in the tracker)'. When HP is below maximum and hit dice are left, offer an inline 'Spend a hit die? (n left, dX+Con) [Roll]' in the rest message or tracker.

items.resolution: After a short rest with HP missing, the message offers 'Roll a hit die (d8)'.

items.title: Frenzied Approach: a long rest should remove 2 exhaustion, not 1
items.story: When a feature changes the rest rules (Frenzied: a long rest removes 2 exhaustion), I want the Long rest button to apply it and say so, so that I don't carry extra exhaustion.
items.evidence: Exhaustion 2 → Long rest → 'Long rest: regained one level of exhaustion gone.' → 1. Frenzy: 'When you finish a long rest, you reduce your exhaustion level by 2, instead of 1.' The Long rest tooltip also says 'exhaustion −1'.
items.repro: Frenzied Approach, exhaustion 2, Long rest.
items.expected: Exhaustion 2 → 0, with the message citing Frenzy.

verified.note: The long rest hard-codes exhaustion − 1, and the button tooltip says 'exhaustion −1'. Frenzied Approach's text in SW5E's rules ('When you finish a long rest, you reduce your exhaustion level by 2, instead of 1. Additionally, any effect that removes exhaustion reduces your exhaustion by 1 additional level') is never read. Read it from the archetype and name Frenzy in the rest message.

items.resolution: A long rest removes what a feature says (Frenzy: two levels), named in the message and the button's tooltip.

items.title: Long rest message reads oddly when only exhaustion changes
items.story: When only exhaustion changes on a rest, I want a clear sentence, so that the message reads right.
items.evidence: 'Long rest: regained one level of exhaustion gone.'
items.repro: At full HP and uses, with exhaustion 2, take a long rest.
items.expected: 'Long rest: one level of exhaustion gone (nothing else to regain).'

verified.note: restGains puts 'regained ' in front of everything, and the exhaustion entry is 'one level of exhaustion gone', which gives 'Long rest: regained one level of exhaustion gone.' Keep the exhaustion clause outside the 'regained' list.

items.resolution: 'Long rest: regained 10 HP; 2 levels of exhaustion gone (Frenzy).'

items.title: Phone page scrolls sideways: the long tool-proficiency chip doesn't wrap
items.story: When I use the sheet on a 390 px phone, I want the page never to scroll horizontally, so that it doesn't wobble when I swipe.
items.evidence: In /dev/phone.html?w=390&h=844 there's a horizontal scrollbar under the frame. The viewer document is 554 px wide in a 375 px viewport (scrollWidth 554, clientWidth 375). The culprit is span.chip.rollable 'Two of your choice of artisan's implements, gaming sets, or musical instruments' in Proficiencies & Languages (left 114, right 554), which no overflow container clips. Jun's layout never overflowed at 390 px, but his tool text was the short 'One of your choice'.
items.repro: Open the phone frame on a character whose background tool is the 'Two of your choice…' sentence (e.g. Force Adept) and check the document's scrollWidth.
items.expected: Chips wrap (white-space: normal, max-width: 100%), and the sentence becomes a picker (W-025).

verified.note: .chip is white-space: nowrap. The wrapping rule `:is(.chips, …) > .chip` doesn't reach tool chips, because renderProficiencies nests them as .chips > span.rollable > span.chip. A long tool sentence therefore can't wrap and widens the page. Fix the selector (also cover .rollable > .chip). The tool picker is W-025.

items.resolution: Tool chips inside a rollable wrap; no sideways scroll at 390 px.

items.title: AC disappears from the phone strip while a state is active
items.story: When I'm concentrating or in a state during a fight, I want my AC to stay in the pinned strip, so that I can answer 'does 14 hit?' without scrolling.
items.evidence: Without a state the strip shows '♥ 10/10 AC 13'. With Target Lock active it shows '♥ 10/10 ● Target Lock', and AC is gone.
items.repro: Cast Target Lock on the phone.
items.expected: HP, AC and the state chip all visible (e.g. smaller chip text).

verified.note: Deliberate. viewer.css hides AC when something is active: `@media (max-width: 430px) { .mvitals:has(.mstate) .ac { display: none; } }`, with the comment 'Something active: it takes the AC's place on phones'. Options: keep it; shrink the state chip (an icon or a few letters) and keep AC; or put AC and HP on a second line.

items.resolution: Kept (a state takes AC's place on phones); Inspiration now shows as a ★ next to HP.

items.title: Conditions don't appear in the phone strip
items.story: When I'm Poisoned, I want a chip in the pinned strip, as concentration has, so that I see it on every screen.
items.evidence: With Poisoned in Conditions (loaded from sw5e.com), the strip showed only '♥ 11/24 ● Target Lock'. Exhaustion and Inspiration have no strip chip either (W-063, W-097).
items.repro: Have a condition active on the phone and look at the strip.
items.expected: A '● Poisoned' chip that jumps to Conditions.

verified.note: The strip lists only temporary effects. SW5E conditions (c.conditions), exhaustion and Inspiration never reach it. Add chips that link to Conditions in Combat & Vitals.

items.resolution: The phone strip shows conditions first (red), then states; the desktop summary lists them too.

items.title: Phone notice covers HP and the filter while syncing
items.story: When I sync from my phone, I want the status notice not to cover my HP and the filter, so that I can keep playing.
items.evidence: After tapping Sync to SW5E in the phone banner, the notice 'Opening sw5e.com in a background tab…' sat over the strip (♥ HP, 🔍, 🎲) for about 5 s, followed by 'Recalculating with your active effects…'.
items.repro: In the 390 px frame, change HP and tap Sync to SW5E.
items.expected: The notice below the strip, or smaller, never hiding HP.

verified.note: On phones the toast is fixed at top: calc(var(--navbar-h) + 8px), which assumes the strip is pinned at the very top. At the top of the page, where the 'Sync to SW5E' banner is tapped, the top bar (position: static) sits above the strip, so the toast lands on the strip and covers HP, 🔍 and 🎲. Position it from the strip's actual bottom edge, or at the bottom of the screen.

items.resolution: On phones the notice is placed under the strip's current position, so it never covers HP, 🔍 or 🎲.

items.title: Class table scrolls sideways on the phone
items.story: When I check my class table on my phone, I want it as a list, so that I don't swipe sideways inside a card.
items.evidence: Classes card → Class table: 'PROFICIENCY BONUS | FEATURES | TECH…' is cut off at the right edge with a horizontal scrollbar. The README says 'tables turn into lists' on phones.
items.repro: Phone frame → Classes & Progression → Class table.
items.expected: A list layout ('Now (1): +2 · Techcasting, Potent Aptitude · 6 powers · 2 points…').

verified.note: Only table.inv and table.tweaks become lists on phones. The Class table in renderClasses is a plain <table> in .table-wrap, so it scrolls sideways; the README's 'tables turn into lists' overstates it. Give it a stacked 'Now (n): … / Next (n+1): …' layout.

items.resolution: On phones the class table is a list: each column with this level's value → the next level's.

items.title: Tracker −/+ buttons too small on the phone
items.story: When I adjust tech points or uses mid-fight, I want thumb-sized buttons, so that I don't mis-tap.
items.evidence: The play tracker's −/+ buttons for tech points, hit dice, Potent Aptitude and Repair Droid are about 26 × 22 px in the 390 px frame.
items.repro: Phone frame → Combat → Play tracker.
items.expected: Tap targets of about 44 px.

verified.note: On real touch screens the tracker buttons are already about 40×32 px (.btn.sm min-height 32px; .trk-btns .btn min-width 40px). The dev phone frame runs with a mouse pointer, so it shows the desktop size (about 26×22). That is still below 44 px: raise .trk-btns .btn (and the death-save dots and hit-die roll) for coarse pointers.

items.resolution: At 600 px or less (the phone frame too), the tracker's −/+ buttons are at least 40 × 34 px.

items.title: Re-renders and notices shift the layout: clicks are lost or hit the wrong button
items.story: When I click or tap right after a change (while the sheet recalculates, or as a notice appears or fades), I want the click to land on what I aimed at, or be ignored with a visible busy state, so that I don't miss a rest, end the wrong effect or silently change my inventory.
items.evidence:
Tomas (high): he clicked the Medpac row's 'Use' during a recalculation ('Opening sw5e.com in a background tab…' after ending Poison), and the click landed on '+' because the row had been redrawn. Medpac went 1 → 2 (a free 300 cr item) and weight 0.5 → 1 lb, with no toast and no undo; he only noticed because he zoomed in.

Mira: her first click on Long rest just after 'Recalculated with your changes · 16:02:43' only focused the button (HP stayed 1/17). A click on Load from SW5E was lost the same way earlier.

Jun (phone): after Personality → Done, a recalculation moved the page about 80 px before his tap on Notes Edit. In part B, when 'Down to 0 hit points: roll death saves…' faded, the tracker moved up about 40 px and his tap on death-save 'Roll' landed on 'Temp HP'.

Priya (tablet): Heal, then End on Soresu Form; the first tap was lost. After each item Add, a 'TOTALS — AC, attacks and other numbers update when SW5E recalculates with your changes' card appeared, pushed 'Items' to a second row, then disappeared; it happened again in part B on +400 cr.
items.repro: Change something that triggers a recalculation (end an effect, add an item, edit XP), then within a second or two click an inventory row's Use/−/+, Long rest or End.
items.expected: Don't move or replace buttons under the pointer during a re-render: keep each row and update it in place. Notices float over the content instead of pushing it. Briefly ignore clicks after a redraw, or show a busy state. A toast with Undo for quantity changes ('Medpac 1 → 2 · Undo').
items.workarounds: Took a fresh screenshot, clicked again and checked the toast. Tomas pressed − to give back the free medpac.

verified.where: viewer.js:renderAll, renderEquipment (m.stale 'Totals' stat), renderPending, anchorFor/restoreAnchor, inventoryAction('qty')
verified.note: Every change redraws the whole sheet (renderAll replaces #sheet innerHTML), and the layout changes during a recalculation. While numbers are stale, renderEquipment puts a 'Totals' card into the credits grid, which pushes 'Items' to a new row and the inventory down, then removes it. The 'Not synced' banner appears at the top. restoreAnchor keeps only the last-used control (from the last 4 s) or the top element in place, so other rows move under the pointer. There is no click guard or busy state, and inventory −/+ changes show no message or Undo. That explains the free medpac. Fix: give Totals a fixed slot outside the grid, update rows in place, briefly ignore clicks after a redraw, and add Undo toasts for inventory changes.

items.resolution: The sheet compares the control under the pointer before and after each redraw. A click is ignored only when a different control moved there in the last 0.7 s, and the sheet says so, keeping Undo. A click on the same button is no longer lost. Section jumps are instant, so nothing moves while you aim.

items.title: Action confirmations vanish or are replaced by the recalculation status
items.story: When I buy something, change credits, rest or use a medpac on an ally, I want a confirmation I can read ('Bought 2 × Medpac for 100 cr', 'Used 1 Medpac on someone else (0 left) · Undo'), kept apart from the recalculation status, so that I know it worked without scrolling to check.
items.evidence:
Medpac → Use → On someone else:
- Priya: the code's message ('Used Medpac on someone else. They regain one die the size of their Hit Die + their Constitution modifier…') was replaced within a second by 'Opening sw5e.com…' and then 'Recalculated with your changes · 18:05:50'.
- Jun: he saw only 'Opening sw5e.com…'.
- Sam: the Medical group simply disappeared, with no message and no Undo (18:46:59). He also wants the ally's healing roll (their Hit Die + Con) offered.
With the 🔍 filter on, the used-up row vanished, which looked like a jump (Jun, Priya).

Other actions:
- Buying with Pay showed only 'Opening sw5e.com…', and credits went to 0 silently (Jun).
- Credits '+150' + Enter emptied the box, but '0 cr' stayed for about 2 s (Mira).
- Short rest took tech points 2/6 → 6/6, but the notice was gone in about 2 s; Long rest showed only 'Long rest: done.' (Jun).
items.repro: Medpac → Use → On someone else, or buy an item with Pay ticked, and watch the status line.
items.expected: Action messages stay visible for a few seconds (until tapped on phones) or in a small message history, separate from the recalculation status: '+150 cr → 150 cr', '+4 tech points'. Undo where possible, and an optional healing roll for the ally.
items.workarounds: Scrolled to check credits or HP.

verified.note: Each action does write a message ('Credits A → B cr', 'Added 2 × Medpac for … cr', 'Used Medpac on someone else. They regain …', short-rest gains). But there is only one status line: setEditedFields and item-state changes schedule a recalculation 1.2 s later, and recomputeDerived passes setStatus as onStatus. So 'Opening sw5e.com…' and then 'Recalculated with your changes · time' overwrite the action's message, and phone toasts last only 5 s. Needed: action messages kept apart from the recalculation status (or a short message history), Undo for item and credit changes, and an optional healing roll for the ally.

items.resolution: Notices stay 6 s, 10 s with a button (Undo) and 12 s for errors. Recent messages (More ▾, ☰ on phones) lists the last 15 with their times. Background recalculation messages don't replace an action's notice (W-020).

items.title: After removing or ending a row, the next row's button slides under the pointer
items.story: When I remove a power or maneuver or end an effect, I want the next row's × or End not to land exactly under my mouse or thumb (or an Undo), so that a double click doesn't remove or end a second one.
items.evidence: After × on Haywire, Hologram's × moved to exactly where Jun had tapped, and after that Homing Rockets'. After Tomas removed a maneuver, the next maneuver's × slid under the mouse (seen 3 times). After End on Poison, the Strength Stim's End button moved under the pointer (Tomas, Priya). Forgetting a power can't be undone (Jun).
items.repro: Have two temporary effects or two picks, then End or × the first.
items.expected: A short click guard after removals, or rows that close up after a delay or with an animation. An Undo notice ('Forgot Haywire · Undo'), or 'End all expired'.
items.workarounds: Moved the pointer away before clicking again.

verified.note: Forgetting a power, removing a choice and ending an effect all apply at once and redraw, so the next row's ×/End closes up under the pointer. There is no click guard and no Undo; only the inventory × asks first. The buttons also identify entries by list index (data-arg 'idx|field|i'), so a quick second click on a button that hasn't been redrawn yet can remove a different entry. Add a short guard, an Undo notice, and remove by name.

items.resolution: After removing a row or ending an effect, a quick second click on the next row's button (now under the pointer) is ignored with a message, and Undo stays. The same guard as W-126.

items.title: Raw data shown on cards (Chosen ASI JSON, background tables as Markdown)
items.story: When I read my species and background cards, I want plain text and rendered tables, so that the sheet looks finished and I can use the tables.
items.evidence: The Species card shows 'Chosen ASI {"Dexterity":1}' (Tomas) and 'Chosen ASI {"Strength":1}' (Priya). Background tables appear as raw Markdown: Soldier's Specialty 'Roll a d8… |d8|Specialty| |:---:|:----------:| |1|Officer| …' (Tomas), Scientist's Field of Research '| d8 | Field of Research | |:-----:|:----------| | 1 | Biology | | 2 | Artificial Intelligence | …' (Jun).
items.repro: Load a Zabrak Soldier or a Scientist and open Species and Background.
items.expected: 'Chosen increase: Dexterity +1', and rendered d8 tables (maybe with a picker that stores the choice).

verified.note: renderSpecies prints 'Chosen ASI' with JSON.stringify(asi). renderBackground renders the background's table field (ref.flavorDescription) with mdInline, which has no table support (md() has it), so '|d8|Specialty|…' stays raw. Use md() and format the increase ('Dexterity +1'). A picker that stores the rolled or chosen entry would be a follow-up.

items.resolution: 'Chosen increase: Dexterity +1'; background fields with Markdown tables are rendered as tables.

items.title: Section strip on phone/tablet: too few pills, wrong highlight, scrolls under the finger
items.story: When I jump between sections on a phone or tablet, I want a fast way to reach any section, a highlight that matches what's on screen, and a strip that doesn't slide sideways just before I tap, so that I don't swipe a dozen times per fight or land on the wrong section.
items.evidence: Jun (390 px): only 2–3 pills fit between the '♥ 10/10 AC 13' chip and 🔍/🎲, and only one ('Overview') while a state chip like '● Target Lock' shows. He swiped the strip about 15 times in session 1, and jumping to Skills highlighted 'Abilities'. Priya (tablet): Skills on screen but 'Abilities' highlighted, Personality on screen but 'Equipment'. The strip auto-scrolls sideways as the page moves, so a tap aimed at 'Combat' landed on 'Background'. Jun rated it medium, Priya low.
items.repro: Phone frame 390×844 or tablet 800×1000: scroll the page and try to go from Notes to Skills to Equipment to Tech.
items.expected: A '☰ sections' menu or a second row. The highlight matches the section on screen. No sideways jump just before a tap.
items.workarounds: Swiping the strip. The HP chip jumps to Combat. Checking again before each tap.

verified.note: The strip exists as horizontally scrolling pills; there is no sections menu. setupScrollSpy highlights the first section that reaches into a band from 70 px below the top to 45% of the screen height, so the section above the one on screen can stay highlighted. Each time the highlight changes, it smooth-scrolls the strip sideways (strip.scrollTo), moving the pills under the finger. Fix: add a ☰ sections menu, choose the section at the strip's bottom edge, and don't auto-scroll the strip while a touch is in progress.

items.resolution: ☰ in the strip lists every section (one tap, no swiping). The highlight is the section at the reading line, or the one jumped to. The strip doesn't slide sideways within 2 s of touching it, and moves without animation.

items.title: Concentration chip in the desktop summary isn't clickable
items.story: When I see 'Guidance (concentration)' in the summary on desktop, I want clicking it to jump to the effect and its End button, so that I can end it quickly.
items.evidence: Clicking the green 'Guidance (concentration)' chip in the desktop summary did nothing, though the README says the phone strip's chip jumps to Effects. The sidebar jump also scrolls smoothly, so her first End click landed while the page was still moving (see W-134).
items.repro: Cast a concentration power on desktop and click the summary chip.
items.expected: Jump to the effect with its End button.

verified.note: The desktop summary renders active effects as plain chip() spans. Only the phone strip (renderMiniVitals) makes it a link to #effects. Make the summary chips links to the effect and its End button.

items.resolution: Active effects in the desktop summary link to Effects.

items.title: Sidebar 'Overview' jump scrolls past the 'Not synced' banner
items.story: When I jump to Overview, I want to see the 'Not synced to SW5E: …' banner, so that I notice unsynced class choices before levelling on the site.
items.evidence: Clicking Overview in the sidebar puts the Overview card at the top. The banner 'Not synced to SW5E: Class choices, Feature notes, Inventory, Credits, XP · Sync to SW5E · Revert to SW5E's copy' sits above it and is only visible after scrolling up by hand. It matters because unsynced class choices freeze the class level (W-011).
items.repro: Make any change, then click Overview in the sidebar.
items.expected: The jump includes the banner, or the banner is sticky or shown in the summary.

verified.note: The 'Not synced to SW5E' banner is drawn above the first section, and the Overview link targets #sec-overview, so the jump scrolls past the banner. Move the banner into Overview, make it sticky, or point the Overview link at the top of the sheet.

items.resolution: The 'not synced' banner is part of the Overview section, so jumping to Overview shows it.

items.title: Filter leaves empty group headers and always shows the Settings card
items.story: When I filter for one thing ('Medpac', 'Mynock', 'Lightsaber'), I want only matching groups shown, so that the results fit on screen and the counts make sense.
items.evidence: Filter 'Medpac' still showed 'Weapon (2)', 'Armor (2)', 'Clothing (1)'… with column headers and no rows. In part B it happened in Class features too: 'Mynock' left 'Guardian (6)', 'Guardian: Guardian Auras (1)', 'Fighting styles (1)', 'Lightsaber forms (2)' with no rows. The Settings, Tweaks & Data card stays under every filter; on the phone, 'Lightsaber' put it below the results. Jun found the collapsed headers acceptable.
items.repro: 🔍 'Medpac' or 'Mynock'.
items.expected: Hide groups with no matching rows, and hide the Settings card unless it matches.

verified.note: applyFilter hides only the listed units (.card, tbody tr…). Group <h3> headings and table heads aren't among them, so empty groups keep their headers. The Settings section never disappears because renderData includes the raw and computed character JSON in <details>. visibleText reads closed details too, and that JSON contains every item and feature name, so any query matches. Fix: hide headers whose table has no visible rows, and skip pre.json in visibleText.

items.resolution: Headings of groups left empty by the filter are hidden, and the raw JSON is no longer searched, so Settings only shows when it matches.

items.title: First click right after a sidebar jump is ignored
items.story: When I jump to a section and click a button, I want the click to work the first time, so that I don't double-click things like rests mid-fight.
items.evidence: Tomas: right after jumping to Combat & Vitals, the first click on Short rest did nothing and the second worked. The same happened with the Stealth row after jumping to Skills (the page was still scrolling), and again in part B on Blaster rifle '+5'. Sam: right after Notes → Done, clicking 'Combat & Vitals' in the side list changed the URL to #sec-combat but the page stayed at Notes; the second click scrolled.
items.repro: Click a sidebar entry, then immediately click a button in that section. Or save a form and then click a side-list entry.
items.expected: Clicks land on what's under the pointer (shorter or no smooth scroll), and the side list scrolls on the first click.

verified.note: Sidebar jumps scroll smoothly. A click made while the page is still moving can press on one element and release over another, and the browser then sends no click (Tomas's 'first click does nothing'). A redraw that finishes during the jump (for example the recalculation after Notes → Done, whose restoreAnchor calls scrollBy instantly) can stop the smooth scroll, which fits Sam's '#sec-combat in the URL but the page stayed'. To check: turn off smooth scrolling for sidebar jumps and retest; skip restoreAnchor while a jump is under way.

items.resolution: Section jumps are instant (no smooth scroll that a click could land in), and a background redraw no longer swallows a click on the same button.

items.title: The app icon looks like a ☰ menu button on the phone
items.story: When I see the striped orange icon at the top left of the phone layout, I want it either to be a sections menu or not to look like one, so that I don't tap it expecting navigation.
items.evidence: He tapped it and nothing happened; it's .
items.repro: Phone frame: tap the icon at the top left.
items.expected: Make it the sections menu (W-130) or restyle it.

verified.note: The icon is a plain (icons/icon32.png), not a control. Options: make it the sections menu (W-130), or restyle or hide it on phones so it doesn't look like ☰.

items.resolution: Decided (decision 102, to confirm): on phones and tablets, where the strip's ☰ is the real menu, the app icon is hidden; wider screens keep it.

items.title: More ▾ scrolls away on the phone
items.story: When I need Load from SW5E or Export mid-session, I want More ▾ reachable without scrolling to the very top, so that a mis-tap doesn't open something else.
items.evidence: Only the strip is pinned; More ▾ scrolls off with the header. His scroll-up didn't reach the top, and his 'More' tap landed on the Insight row and opened the dice dock. Later, the first tap on More ▾ after scrolling up twice did nothing and the second opened it. He needed More ▾ repeatedly mid-fight for the Poisoned workaround (W-062).
items.repro: Phone frame: scroll down, then try to reach More ▾.
items.expected: More ▾ in the pinned strip, or a ⋯ next to 🎲.
items.workarounds: Scrolled to the very top first.

verified.note: More ▾ is in the top bar, which scrolls away on phones and tablets; the pinned strip has only 🔍 and 🎲. Add a ⋯ button to the strip that opens the same menu.

items.resolution: ☰ in the pinned strip has Load from SW5E, Import, New character, Recent messages, Export all, Compact cards and the theme.

items.title: Restore a version from the local version history
items.story: When a Load or Sync goes wrong (as level 3 did), I want 'Restore this version' with a comparison, so that I can undo it without files or code.
items.evidence: Settings > Local version history ('8 / 25') lists versions such as '17:08:44 Loaded from SW5E' and '17:39:05 Synced to SW5E', each with only 'Export'. When level 3 was undone in B1 (W-011), there was no way back inside the sheet to the 17:08:44 version that had Engineer 3. 'Last full backup: today' doesn't say which characters, or who exported it. Jun couldn't export a backup himself, because a download needs the user's OK.
items.repro: Settings, Tweaks & Data → Local version history.
items.expected: Restore and Compare for each version. The backup line names the characters and the time.

verified.note: Each version in the history has only Export, which downloads that version's raw data. Add Restore (taken in as the current copy and recorded as a new history entry) and Compare (a diff against the current copy). The 'Last full backup' line could also name the characters and the time.

items.resolution: Each version in Local version history has Compare (what differs from the character now: 'Classes: Fighter 2 / Operative 1 → Fighter 3 (Assault Specialist) / Operative 1', 'Credits: 100 → 450', items added or removed…) and Restore (the version's fields become local changes, play state stays, Undo puts it back, Sync sends it). The backup line names this character's last backup and the last full backup with its time and number of characters.

items.title: Backup: 'Export all' includes everyone's characters; no per-character backup named as such
items.story: When I back up my character, I want a clearly named 'Back up this character' (snapshot, edits, history, reasons, play state) and labels that say what each export contains, so that I don't save or hand around other players' characters and a 1 MB file.
items.evidence: Tomas ran More ▾ → Export all (backup): 'Exported a backup of 12 characters.', file 'sw5e-sheet-backup-2026-10-17 1651.json', 1.15 MB, including other players' characters and the owner's. More ▾ also has 'Export SW5E character (.json)' and 'Export sheet snapshot (.json)'. Neither is called a backup, and neither player was sure the snapshot includes edits and history. Priya read in the code that 'Export all' writes every snapshot, tracker, edit and history in the browser; she didn't run it.
items.repro: More ▾ → look at the three export options.
items.expected: 'Back up this character' next to 'Export all', plus clear labels for each export.

verified.note: 'Export SW5E character' is SW5E's data with the local edits, but without reasons, effects, play state or history. 'Export sheet snapshot' is only the snapshot: SW5E's copy plus the computed numbers, with none of the local edits, play state, reasons or history. The players were right to doubt it. 'Export all (backup)' writes everything for every character. Add 'Back up this character' (exportBackup limited to one character) and labels that say what each export contains.

items.resolution: More ▾ has 'Back up this character' (its data and changes, play state, reasons, effects, history and recent rolls, in a file named after it) and 'Back up all characters'; the other exports are now 'Export for sw5e.com' and 'Export SW5E's copy with its numbers', each with a hover saying what it holds. Importing a character backup restores it.

items.title: 'Last full backup: never' not refreshed after an export
items.story: When I export a backup, I want the Settings card to say 'today' right away, so that I trust the backup happened.
items.evidence: Right after 'Exported a backup of 12 characters.', the Settings → Local version history card still said 'Last full backup: never', although state.lastBackup was set. A freshly loaded viewer (the phone frame) said 'today'.
items.repro: More ▾ → Export all (backup) → look at Settings, Tweaks & Data → Local version history.
items.expected: Redraw the card after the export.

verified.note: exportBackup sets state.lastBackup and saves it, but the save carries this page's writer stamp, so the onChanged listener ignores it, and nothing redraws the history card. Redraw after the export (refreshTracked or renderAll).

items.resolution: The sheet redraws after an export, so 'Last full backup' updates.

items.title: Species traits that grant or let you choose a skill or tool proficiency aren't applied
items.story: When my species grants a skill or tool proficiency (Togruta Wild Hunters: Survival; Wookiee Menacing: Intimidation) or lets me choose one (Zabrak Coercive: Persuasion or Intimidation; Crafters: one artisan's implements), I want it applied, with a picker for the choice, so that my skills are right without tweaks.
items.evidence:
Priya: 'Wild Hunters. You have proficiency in the Survival skill.', but Survival is +2 and not proficient (it should be +4), on sw5e.com too. The viewer does read Montral Reception (Tremorsense 30 ft) from trait text, just not this skill.

Tomas: the Coercive and Crafters cards have an orange 'Your choices' box. He typed 'Persuasion' and 'Tinker's implements' and the sheet recalculated (13:01:12), but Persuasion stayed +1 and no tool appeared. The README says notes in a feature's 'Your choices' apply proficiencies, but that doesn't work for species traits. The builder only asks for the species +1 ability.

Sam (umbrella wish): sw5e.com's sheet misses Wookiee Hide AC (11 vs 14), Brawny Str (17 vs 18) and Athletics, Menacing's Intimidation (+0) and Claws (unarmed '+5 4 Kinetic' instead of 1d4+3). The extension should fill in what the engine misses. Details are tracked in W-026, W-144 and W-147.
items.repro: Load a Togruta (Survival) or Wookiee (Intimidation). On a Zabrak, type 'Persuasion' into Coercive's 'Your choices' and Tab away.
items.expected: Fixed species skill and tool proficiencies applied like class features. Species traits with a choice get a picker limited to the allowed options.
items.workarounds: Proficient tweaks with reasons; the tool in Notes.

verified.note: Species traits are never turned into effects: featureEffectsUncached covers class and archetype features and class options only. So the orange 'Your choices' box that featureNoteBox shows on Coercive and Crafters stores the note and does nothing. Even with a species pass, the proficiency parser only matches 'gain proficiency in/with…'. It misses 'You have proficiency in the Survival skill' (Wild Hunters, Menacing) and 'You have proficiency with Persuasion or Intimidation (your choice)' (Coercive). Needed: a species pass, 'have proficiency' patterns, and pickers limited to the allowed options.

items.resolution: Species traits' proficiencies apply ('You have proficiency in the Survival skill', Menacing, Pilot; Coercive and Crafters from the trait's notes). The umbrella's other parts are W-143, W-144, W-147, W-150 (decision 33).

items.title: Darkvision shows 'Normal', and Kel Dor necrotic resistance isn't shown
items.story: When my species has darkvision or a resistance, I want Vision to say 'Darkvision 60 ft' and the resistance listed under defenses, so that I don't forget them in a dark hangar or a fight.
items.evidence: Combat & Vitals shows 'Vision: Normal' for a Kel Dor, a Zabrak, a Sullustan and a Wookiee. Their Darkvision traits read 'You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light…', and sw5e.com's feature list also has DARKVISION. Mira found the cause in classes.js: the darkvision regex needs 'darkvision … 60 feet' in one sentence. The defenses parser skips any trait containing 'while', so the Kel Dor's 'Life in the Void. You have resistance to necrotic damage, and while exposed to the vacuum of space…' never shows either. Caveat: Tomas notes sw5e.com's Zabrak species page doesn't mention darkvision, although the character data has the trait. Priya's Togruta has the same data-only trait (W-153), so check which species really have darkvision.
items.repro: Load a Kel Dor, Sullustan or Wookiee and look at Combat & Vitals > Vision / Effects.
items.expected: 'Darkvision 60 ft' under Vision, and 'Resistance to necrotic damage' under defenses.

verified.where: viewer.js:renderCombat (Vision = c.vision), defensesOf; classes.js:clsFeatureEffects (darkvision regex, while/when filter)
verified.note: 'Vision' shows SW5E's c.vision, which says 'normal'. defensesOf does read species trait text, but the darkvision pattern needs the word 'darkvision', and the trait text says 'You can see in dim light within 60 feet…'; the word appears only in the trait name, which isn't passed. Defenses skip any sentence containing while/when/if, and Life in the Void's sentence has 'while exposed…', so the necrotic resistance is dropped too. Caveat: SW5E's species traits list Darkvision for Kel Dor, Sullustan and Wookiee but not Togruta or Zabrak, while its features data lists it for all five; base the fix on the species traits (see W-153).

items.resolution: Darkvision is read from the species trait ('see in dim light within 60 feet…') and shown under Senses and as Vision; 'resistance to necrotic damage, and while…' keeps the resistance.

items.title: Species languages missing (Kel Dor, Sullestese, Togruti, Shyriiwook)
items.story: When my species speaks its own language, I want it listed under Languages (Wookiee: Galactic Basic as understood only), so that the sheet is complete and I roleplay correctly.
items.evidence:
Proficiencies & Languages lists only 'Galactic Basic' for each of these species:
- Kel Dor: 'You can speak, read, and write Galactic Basic and Kel Dor.'
- Sullustan: 'Galactic Basic, Sullestese, and one more language of your choice.'
- Togruta: 'Galactic Basic and Togruti'; the Jedi background adds 'Languages: One of your choice'.
- Wookiee: 'You can speak, read, and write Shyriiwook. You can understand spoken and written Galactic Basic, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.'
Tomas saw Zabraki missing as well (W-025). There is no way to add a language. Jun and Priya rated it medium, Mira and Sam low.
items.repro: Load any of these species and open Proficiencies & Languages.
items.expected: Species languages listed automatically (Wookiee: Shyriiwook, with Galactic Basic marked understand-only), plus pickers for 'of your choice' (W-025).

verified.note: Languages come only from SW5E's c.languages (here only Galactic Basic) plus raw.customLanguages. The species language (ref.language: Kel Dor, Togruti, Shyriiwook…) appears only in the Species card's 'Language' line, and there is no way to add a language. Add species languages automatically (Wookiee: Galactic Basic marked understand-only) and pickers for 'of your choice' (W-025).

items.resolution: The species' language is filled in for SW5E's engine (it adds it only when recorded; created characters record it), and 'one more language of your choice' is a picker (decision 39).

items.title: Zabrak Toughness (+1 HP per level) not applied; a flat tweak has to be re-edited every level
items.story: When my species raises my HP maximum by 1 per level, I want it applied automatically, so that my HP is right now and after every level-up without editing a tweak.
items.evidence: Toughness says 'Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.' The builder and the sheet both show HP 13/13 at level 1 (10 + Con 3); it should be 14. The gap grows with each level: the site's HP was 30 at level 3 (should be 33) and 39 at level 4 (should be 43). Tomas edited his 'HP maximum' bonus tweak 1 → 3 → 4 by hand, and nothing reminded him, although the tweak's own reason says '+1 HP per level'.
items.repro: Build a Zabrak Fighter 1 with Con 16, level it up on sw5e.com, Load, and compare HP max with class HP + Con × level + level.
items.expected: Species traits that scale with level applied like class features, or a tweak that can scale with level.
items.workarounds: An 'HP maximum +N' tweak, edited after every level-up.

verified.note: Neither SW5E's engine nor the sheet applies Toughness. Species traits aren't processed, the parser has no pattern for 'hit point maximum increases by 1 … every time you gain a level', and tweaks are flat numbers that don't scale with level. Add a level-scaled HP-maximum effect from species and feat text.

items.resolution: 'Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level' applies at the character's level (decision 40).

items.title: AC ignores Wookiee Hide (14), and the sheet doesn't say which AC formula it used
items.story: When my species and my class both give an unarmored AC formula, I want AC to use the better one and the hover to list both and mark the one used, so that I trust my AC.
items.evidence: Wookiee Hide: 'While you are unarmored or wearing light armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier'. Berserker Unarmored Defense is 10 + Dex + Con. With Dex 13 and Con 15, that's Hide 14 vs Unarmored Defense 13. The builder showed AC 11. The sheet shows AC 13 'Unarmored', with the hover 'Without tweaks or effects: 11 → now 13 · +2 AC + CON · Unarmored Defense Berserker feature', and Hide isn't mentioned anywhere. With a light physical shield it should be 15.
items.repro: Wookiee Berserker, Dex 13, Con 15, no armor: read AC.
items.expected: AC 14, with the hover listing both formulas and marking the one used.
items.workarounds: An AC +1 tweak 'Wookiee Hide (13 + Dex) is 1 better than Unarmored Defense (10 + Dex + Con)'. At first it was a 'set to' tweak, which then ignored the shield (W-160).

verified.note: Wookiee Hide ('While you are unarmored or wearing light armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier') is never read: species traits aren't processed, and the AC-formula parser knows only '10 + Dex + X'. Unarmored Defense is applied as a plain AC change. Needed: collect every AC formula (species, class, armor), use the best one that applies, and list them all in the hover with the one used marked.

items.resolution: Species AC traits (Wookiee Hide 13 + Dex, unarmored or in light armor) are AC formulas; the best one counts (Rorrwaak: Hide +3 over Unarmored Defense +2). In light armor the formula adds what it beats the armor by. The AC hover lists the formula that wasn't used. A tweak made for Hide is flagged as counting twice.

items.title: Remarkable Athlete (Assault Specialist) not applied
items.story: When I take Assault Specialist, I want Remarkable Athlete's half proficiency on Str/Dex/Con checks, initiative included, so that my initiative and skills are right.
items.evidence: The feature: 'You can add half your proficiency bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus.' The sheet still shows Initiative +3 (should be +4), Acrobatics +3 (+4), Sleight of Hand +3 (+4) and Athletics −1 (+0). Effects → From class features lists Brute Force and Improved Critical, but not Remarkable Athlete. sw5e.com's engine doesn't apply it either. The README says half-proficiency features (Led by the Force) are applied.
items.repro: Fighter 3 with the Assault Specialist archetype: check Initiative and the Str/Dex/Con skills he isn't proficient in.
items.expected: Half proficiency (rounded down; +1 at proficiency +2) added to Str/Dex/Con checks without proficiency, initiative included, and listed under Effects.

verified.note: Tomas is Fighter 3, and SW5E's Assault Specialist text makes Remarkable Athlete a 7th-level feature ('_Assault Specialist: 7th level_'), so Initiative +3 is correct. The card appears only because SW5E's features data lists Remarkable Athlete at levels 3 and 7, a data error the engine passes on. Two problems remain for 7th level: the half-proficiency pattern matches only Led by the Force's 'any ability check' wording, and applyEffects gives half proficiency to all skills, not just Str/Dex/Con ones. Fix both and flag the data error.

items.title: Aura of Presence isn't added to my own saving throws
items.story: When I have Aura of Presence, I want my saves (and the roller) to include my Wis modifier while I'm conscious, so that I don't forget my best defensive feature.
items.evidence: The aura's text: 'Whenever you or a friendly creature within 5 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature can add your Wisdom modifier to the saving throw.' Her saves stayed Con +4, Cha +2, Str +3/+4. The aura appears only as text under Features; nothing in Defenses or the roller.
items.repro: Pick Aura of Presence in Classes → Guardian Auras, then look at the saves and roll one.
items.expected: Saves show +3, or the roller offers '+3 Aura of Presence' pre-ticked on every save.

verified.note: The Guardian Auras pick is processed, but its text ('… the creature can add your Wisdom modifier to the saving throw') matches no pattern; the 'Wisdom modifier' pattern needs 'a bonus to … equal to'. Add it as a bonus on all saves, or a pre-ticked roller option, since the aura works only while you're conscious.

items.resolution: 'Whenever you or a friendly creature within 5 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature can add your Wisdom modifier' adds that modifier to your own six saves (Aura of Presence).

items.title: Species unarmed strikes (Zabrak Unarmed Combatant, Wookiee Claws) not applied
items.story: When my species gives my unarmed strikes 1d4 (and finesse), I want the attack line to use them, so that I can trust the number I roll.
items.evidence: The Zabrak trait: 'Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have the finesse property.' The sheet shows 'Unarmed Strike +1, 0 Kinetic, Strength'; with finesse and Dex 17 it should be +5 to hit and 1d4+3. A tweak can set the die (now '+1, 1d4 Kinetic'), but nothing can switch the attack to Dex. Sam's Wookiee Claws ('your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 kinetic damage', shown as Unarmed '+5 · 4 Kinetic') is the same kind of trait; it's logged in his feat/species wish (W-026, W-140).
items.repro: On a Zabrak with Str 8 / Dex 17: Weapons & Attacks > Unarmed Strike.
items.expected: +5 to hit, 1d4+3 kinetic, Dexterity.
